Participants will solve medium-difficulty problems from the LiveCodeBench dataset, while the tool records fine-grained interaction logs, effectiveness metrics (e.g., pass rate, all-pass completion), efficiency indicators (e.g., time-to-pass), and iteration behaviors. The study aims to analyze how human intervention in specification and test refinement influences the quality and dynamics of LLM-generated code. The results will provide empirical insights into the design of next-generation development environments that align human reasoning with model-driven code generation.
comment: This paper is a Stage 1 Registered Report. The study protocol and analysis plan were peer reviewed and accepted at SANER 2026 with a Continuity Acceptance (CA) score for Stage 2

title: What Matters For Safety Alignment?
authors: Xing Li, Hui-Ling Zhen, Lihao Yin, Xianzhi Yu, Zhenhua Dong, Mingxuan Yuan
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive empirical study on the safety alignment capabilities. We evaluate what matters for safety alignment in LLMs and LRMs to provide essential insights for developing more secure and reliable AI systems. We systematically investigate and compare the influence of six critical intrinsic model characteristics and three external attack techniques. Our large-scale evaluation is conducted using 32 recent, popular LLMs and LRMs across thirteen distinct model families, spanning a parameter scale from 3B to 235B. The assessment leverages five established safety datasets and probes model vulnerabilities with 56 jailbreak techniques and four CoT attack strategies, resulting in 4.6M API calls. Our key empirical findings are fourfold. First, we identify the LRMs GPT-OSS-20B, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Thinking, and GPT-OSS-120B as the top-three safest models, which substantiates the significant advantage of integrated reasoning and self-reflection mechanisms for robust safety alignment. Second, post-training and knowledge distillation may lead to a systematic degradation of safety alignment. We thus argue that safety must be treated as an explicit constraint or a core optimization objective during these stages, not merely subordinated to the pursuit of general capability. Third, we reveal a pronounced vulnerability: employing a CoT attack via a response prefix can elevate the attack success rate by 3.34x on average and from 0.6% to 96.3% for Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct. This critical finding underscores the safety risks inherent in text-completion interfaces and features that allow user-defined response prefixes in LLM services, highlighting an urgent need for architectural and deployment safeguards. Fourth, roleplay, prompt injection, and gradient-based search for adversarial prompts are the predominant methodologies for eliciting unaligned behaviors in modern models.

title: FLNet: Flood-Induced Agriculture Damage Assessment using Super Resolution of Satellite Images
authors: Sanidhya Ghosal, Anurag Sharma, Sushil Ghildiyal, Mukesh Saini
abstract: Distributing government relief efforts after a flood is challenging. In India, the crops are widely affected by floods; therefore, making rapid and accurate crop damage assessment is crucial for effective post-disaster agricultural management. Traditional manual surveys are slow and biased, while current satellite-based methods face challenges like cloud cover and low spatial resolution. Therefore, to bridge this gap, this paper introduced FLNet, a novel deep learning based architecture that used super-resolution to enhance the 10 m spatial resolution of Sentinel-2 satellite images into 3 m resolution before classifying damage. We tested our model on the Bihar Flood Impacted Croplands Dataset (BFCD-22), and the results showed an improved critical "Full Damage" F1-score from 0.83 to 0.89, nearly matching the 0.89 score of commercial high-resolution imagery. This work presented a cost-effective and scalable solution, paving the way for a nationwide shift from manual to automated, high-fidelity damage assessment.
comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the 10th International Conference on Computer Vision and Image Processing (CVIP 2025)

title: Feature-Aware One-Shot Federated Learning via Hierarchical Token Sequences
authors: Shudong Liu, Hanwen Zhang, Xiuling Wang, Yuesheng Zhu, Guibo Luo
abstract: One-shot federated learning (OSFL) reduces the communication cost and privacy risks of iterative federated learning by constructing a global model with a single round of communication. However, most existing methods struggle to achieve robust performance on real-world domains such as medical imaging, or are inefficient when handling non-IID (Independent and Identically Distributed) data. To address these limitations, we introduce FALCON, a framework that enhances the effectiveness of OSFL over non-IID image data. The core idea of FALCON is to leverage the feature-aware hierarchical token sequences generation and knowledge distillation into OSFL. First, each client leverages a pretrained visual encoder with hierarchical scale encoding to compress images into hierarchical token sequences, which capture multi-scale semantics. Second, a multi-scale autoregressive transformer generator is used to model the distribution of these token sequences and generate the synthetic sequences. Third, clients upload the synthetic sequences along with the local classifier trained on the real token sequences to the server. Finally, the server incorporates knowledge distillation into global training to reduce reliance on precise distribution modeling. Experiments on medical and natural image datasets validate the effectiveness of FALCON in diverse non-IID scenarios, outperforming the best OSFL baselines by 9.58% in average accuracy.

title: Local Interpolation via Low-Rank Tensor Trains
authors: Siddhartha E. Guzman, Egor Tiunov, Leandro Aolita
abstract: Tensor Train (TT) decompositions provide a powerful framework to compress grid-structured data, such as sampled function values, on regular Cartesian grids. Such high compression, in turn, enables efficient high-dimensional computations. Exact TT representations are only available for simple analytic functions. Furthermore, global polynomial or Fourier expansions typically yield TT-ranks that grow proportionally with the number of basis terms. State-of-the-art methods are often prohibitively expensive or fail to recover the underlying low-rank structure. We propose a low-rank TT interpolation framework that, given a TT describing a discrete (scalar-, vector-, or tensor-valued) function on a coarse regular grid with $n$ cores, constructs a finer-scale version of the same function represented by a TT with $n+m$ cores, where the last $m$ cores maintain constant rank. Our method guarantees a $\ell^{2}$-norm error bound independent of the total number of cores, achieves exponential compression at fixed accuracy, and admits logarithmic complexity with respect of the number of grid points. We validate its performance through numerical experiments, including 1D, 2D, and 3D applications such as: 2D and 3D airfoil mask embeddings, image super-resolution, and synthetic noise fields such as 3D synthetic turbulence. In particular, we generate fractal noise fields directly in TT format with logarithmic complexity and memory. This work opens a path to scalable TT-native solvers with complex geometries and multiscale generative models, with implications from scientific simulation to imaging and real-time graphics.

title: IndexTTS 2.5 Technical Report
authors: Yunpei Li, Xun Zhou, Jinchao Wang, Lu Wang, Yong Wu, Siyi Zhou, Yiquan Zhou, Jingchen Shu
abstract: In prior work, we introduced IndexTTS 2, a zero-shot neural text-to-speech foundation model comprising two core components: a transformer-based Text-to-Semantic (T2S) module and a non-autoregressive Semantic-to-Mel (S2M) module, which together enable faithful emotion replication and establish the first autoregressive duration-controllable generative paradigm. Building upon this, we present IndexTTS 2.5, which significantly enhances multilingual coverage, inference speed, and overall synthesis quality through four key improvements: 1) Semantic Codec Compression: we reduce the semantic codec frame rate from 50 Hz to 25 Hz, halving sequence length and substantially lowering both training and inference costs; 2) Architectural Upgrade: we replace the U-DiT-based backbone of the S2M module with a more efficient Zipformer-based modeling architecture, achieving notable parameter reduction and faster mel-spectrogram generation; 3) Multilingual Extension: We propose three explicit cross-lingual modeling strategies, boundary-aware alignment, token-level concatenation, and instruction-guided generation, establishing practical design principles for zero-shot multilingual emotional TTS that supports Chinese, English, Japanese, and Spanish, and enables robust emotion transfer even without target-language emotional training data; 4) Reinforcement Learning Optimization: we apply GRPO in post-training of the T2S module, improving pronunciation accuracy and natrualness. Experiments show that IndexTTS 2.5 not only supports broader language coverage but also replicates emotional prosody in unseen languages under the same zero-shot setting. IndexTTS 2.5 achieves a 2.28 times improvement in RTF while maintaining comparable WER and speaker similarity to IndexTTS 2.

title: Spectral Manifold Regularization for Stable and Modular Routing in Deep MoE Architectures
authors: Ibrahim Delibasoglu
abstract: Mixture of Experts (MoE) architectures enable efficient scaling of neural networks but suffer from expert collapse, where routing converges to a few dominant experts. This reduces model capacity and causes catastrophic interference during adaptation. We propose the Spectrally-Regularized Mixture of Experts (SR-MoE), which imposes geometric constraints on the routing manifold to enforce structural modularity. Our method uses dual regularization: spectral norm constraints bound routing function Lipschitz continuity, while stable rank penalties preserve high-dimensional feature diversity in expert selection. We evaluate SR-MoE across architectural scales and dataset complexities using modular one-shot adaptation tasks. Results show that traditional linear gating fails with increasing depth (accuracy drops up to 4.72% due to expert entanglement), while SR-MoE maintains structural integrity (mean interference -0.32%). Our spectral constraints facilitate positive knowledge transfer, enabling localized expert updates without global performance decay. SR-MoE provides a general solution for building high-capacity, modular networks capable of stable lifelong learning.

title: Smooth Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control Using Deterministic Samples
authors: Markus Walker, Marcel Reith-Braun, Tai Hoang, Gerhard Neumann, Uwe D. Hanebeck
abstract: Sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) is effective for nonlinear systems but often produces non-smooth control inputs due to random sampling. To address this issue, we extend the model predictive path integral (MPPI) framework with deterministic sampling and improvements from cross-entropy method (CEM)--MPC, such as iterative optimization, proposing deterministic sampling MPPI (dsMPPI). This combination leverages the exponential weighting of MPPI alongside the efficiency of deterministic samples. Experiments demonstrate that dsMPPI achieves smoother trajectories compared to state-of-the-art methods.
zh_title: 基于确定性采样的平滑采样式模型预测控制
translation: 采样式模型预测控制（MPC）对非线性系统是有效的，但由于随机采样，通常会产生不平滑的控制输入。为了解决这个问题，我们通过结合确定性采样以及交叉熵方法（CEM）-MPC的改进（例如迭代优化），扩展了模型预测路径积分（MPPI）框架，提出了确定性采样MPPI（dsMPPI）。这种组合利用了MPPI的指数加权以及确定性采样的效率。实验表明，与现有最先进的方法相比，dsMPPI实现了更平滑的轨迹。
tldr: 针对采样式MPC控制输入不平滑的问题，本文提出了dsMPPI，它结合了MPPI的指数加权和确定性采样的效率，实验证明能实现更平滑的轨迹。
ai_comments: 本文解决了采样式MPC在实际应用中一个关键的局限性——控制输入的不平滑性。通过将MPPI强大的指数加权机制与确定性采样的高效率相结合，作者提供了一种既能保持非线性系统控制效果又能显著提高轨迹平滑度的方法。dsMPPI的创新点在于其混合框架，有望提高基于采样的控制算法在机器人和自主系统中的实际部署能力。
motivation: 采样式模型预测控制（MPC）对非线性系统有效，但由于随机采样，通常会产生不平滑的控制输入。
method: 通过结合确定性采样和交叉熵方法（CEM）-MPC的改进（如迭代优化），扩展了模型预测路径积分（MPPI）框架，提出了确定性采样MPPI（dsMPPI）。该方法利用了MPPI的指数加权和确定性采样的效率。
results: 实验证明，与现有最先进的方法相比，dsMPPI实现了更平滑的轨迹。
conclusion: 所提出的dsMPPI方法成功解决了传统采样式MPC带来的控制输入不平滑问题，实现了更平滑的轨迹。

title: Adaptive-Boundary-Clipping GRPO: Ensuring Bounded Ratios for Stable and Generalizable Training
authors: Chi Liu, Xin Chen
abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a popular algorithm for reinforcement learning with large language models (LLMs). However, upon analyzing its clipping mechanism, we argue that it is suboptimal in certain scenarios. With appropriate modifications, GRPO can be significantly enhanced to improve both flexibility and generalization. To this end, we propose Adaptive-Boundary-Clipping GRPO (ABC-GRPO), an asymmetric and adaptive refinement of the original GRPO framework. We demonstrate that ABC-GRPO achieves superior performance over standard GRPO on mathematical reasoning tasks using the Qwen3 LLMs. Moreover, ABC-GRPO maintains substantially higher entropy throughout training, thereby preserving the model's exploration capacity and mitigating premature convergence. The implementation code is available online to ease reproducibility https://github.com/chi2liu/ABC-GRPO.
zh_title: 自适应边界裁剪 GRPO：确保有界比率以实现稳定和可泛化的训练
translation: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）已成为大型语言模型（LLMs）强化学习中常用的一种算法。然而，在分析其裁剪机制后，我们认为它在某些场景下是次优的。通过适当的修改，GRPO可以得到显著增强，以提高灵活性和泛化能力。为此，我们提出了自适应边界裁剪 GRPO (ABC-GRPO)，这是对原始GRPO框架的一种非对称且自适应的改进。我们证明了ABC-GRPO在使用Qwen3 LLMs的数学推理任务上，性能优于标准GRPO。此外，ABC-GRPO在整个训练过程中保持了更高的熵，从而保留了模型的探索能力并减轻了过早收敛。实现代码已在线提供，以方便重现性：https://github.com/chi2liu/ABC-GRPO。
tldr: 针对LLM强化学习中的GRPO算法，本文提出了ABC-GRPO，这是一种非对称且自适应的裁剪机制改进。它在数学推理任务上超越了标准GRPO，并能保持更高的训练熵，提高探索能力和泛化性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了ABC-GRPO，通过引入非对称和自适应的裁剪机制，解决了传统GRPO在LLM强化学习中可能存在的次优裁剪问题。其重要性在于，通过保持更高的训练熵，该方法不仅提高了模型在特定任务（如数学推理）上的性能，还显著增强了模型的探索能力和泛化性，这对于处理复杂、高维度的LLM策略空间至关重要。代码的公开也有利于社区对RLHF方法的进一步研究和复现。
motivation: 现有的Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 算法的裁剪机制在某些情况下是次优的，限制了其灵活性和泛化能力。因此，需要对GRPO进行适当修改，以显著增强其性能。
method: 提出了“自适应边界裁剪 GRPO (Adaptive-Boundary-Clipping GRPO, ABC-GRPO)”，这是对原始GRPO框架的一种非对称且自适应的改进。
results: ABC-GRPO在使用Qwen3 LLMs的数学推理任务上，性能优于标准GRPO。此外，ABC-GRPO在整个训练过程中保持了更高的熵，从而保留了模型的探索能力并减轻了过早收敛。

title: Lightweight and perceptually-guided voice conversion for electro-laryngeal speech
authors: Benedikt Mayrhofer, Franz Pernkopf, Philipp Aichinger, Martin Hagmüller
abstract: Electro-laryngeal (EL) speech is characterized by constant pitch, limited prosody, and mechanical noise, reducing naturalness and intelligibility. We propose a lightweight adaptation of the state-of-the-art StreamVC framework to this setting by removing pitch and energy modules and combining self-supervised pretraining with supervised fine-tuning on parallel EL and healthy (HE) speech data, guided by perceptual and intelligibility losses. Objective and subjective evaluations across different loss configurations confirm their influence: the best model variant, based on WavLM features and human-feedback predictions (+WavLM+HF), drastically reduces character error rate (CER) of EL inputs, raises naturalness mean opinion score (nMOS) from 1.1 to 3.3, and consistently narrows the gap to HE ground-truth speech in all evaluated metrics. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of adapting lightweight voice conversion architectures to EL voice rehabilitation while also identifying prosody generation and intelligibility improvements as the main remaining bottlenecks.
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Audio samples available at https://spsc-tugraz.github.io/lw-elvc-icassp26/ Preprint submitted to ICASSP
zh_title: 轻量级、感知引导的电喉语音转换
translation: 电喉 (EL) 语音的特点是音高恒定、韵律有限和机械噪声，这降低了其自然度和可懂度。我们提出了一种对现有最先进的StreamVC框架的轻量级改编，以适应这种场景，方法是移除音高和能量模块，并将自监督预训练与在并行EL和健康 (HE) 语音数据上的监督微调相结合，并以感知和可懂度损失作为指导。跨不同损失配置的客观和主观评估证实了它们的影响：基于WavLM特征和人类反馈预测的最佳模型变体 (+WavLM+HF) 显著降低了EL输入的字符错误率 (CER)，将自然度平均意见得分 (nMOS) 从1.1提高到3.3，并在所有评估指标上持续缩小与HE真值语音之间的差距。这些发现证明了将轻量级语音转换架构应用于EL语音康复的可行性，同时也指出了韵律生成和可懂度改进是主要的剩余瓶颈。
tldr: 我们为机械化的电喉语音设计了一个轻量级、高效的语音转换器（StreamVC改编版）。该模型采用特殊的感知和可懂度损失，将自然度 (nMOS) 从1.1提升到3.3，并提高了清晰度，证明了轻量级AI在EL语音康复中的潜力。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于将先进的StreamVC语音转换框架进行轻量化改编，并针对电喉语音的特殊挑战性，引入了感知和可懂度损失来指导训练。其重要性在于为语音康复技术提供了显著的改进（nMOS从1.1提高到3.3）。论文明确指出了主要限制，即韵律生成和可懂度改进仍是瓶颈，为未来的研究指明了方向。
motivation: 电喉 (EL) 语音具有音高恒定、韵律有限和机械噪声的特点，降低了自然度和可懂度。本文旨在通过语音转换改善EL语音质量。
method: 提出了一种对现有StreamVC框架的轻量级改编，移除了音高和能量模块。结合了自监督预训练和在并行EL/HE数据上的监督微调，并以感知和可懂度损失作为指导。最佳变体使用了WavLM特征和人类反馈预测 (+WavLM+HF)。
results: 最佳模型 (+WavLM+HF) 显著降低了EL输入的字符错误率 (CER)，将自然度平均意见得分 (nMOS) 从1.1提高到3.3，并在所有评估指标上持续缩小与健康语音 (HE) 真值之间的差距。
conclusion: 结果证明了将轻量级语音转换架构应用于电喉语音康复的可行性，并指出韵律生成和可懂度改进是主要的剩余瓶颈。

title: Implementing Binary Search Trees in GP 2 (Extended Abstract)
authors: Ziad Ismaili Alaoui, Detlef Plump
abstract: We present an approach to implement binary search trees in the rule-based graph programming language GP 2. Our implementation uses GP 2's rooted graph transformation rules to be fast and supports insertion, deletion and query operations. We argue that the worst-case runtime for each of the operations is O(n) for a tree with n nodes. In addition, we expect that, on average, the operations run in time O(log(n)). Hence the implementation would match the time complexity of binary search trees implementations in imperative languages.
zh_title: 在GP 2中实现二叉搜索树（扩展摘要）
translation: 我们提出了一种在基于规则的图编程语言GP 2中实现二叉搜索树的方法。我们的实现使用GP 2的有根图转换规则以实现快速操作，并支持插入、删除和查询操作。我们认为，对于具有n个节点的树，每个操作的最坏情况运行时为O(n)。此外，我们预期这些操作的平均运行时间为O(log(n))。因此，该实现将与命令式语言中二叉搜索树实现的时间复杂度相匹配。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在基于规则的图编程语言GP 2中使用有根图转换规则实现二叉搜索树的方法，该实现支持插入、删除和查询操作，并声称其最坏情况运行时为O(n)，平均运行时为O(log(n))，与命令式语言实现的时间复杂度相匹配。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将传统上在命令式语言中实现的复杂数据结构（二叉搜索树）移植到基于规则的图编程范式GP 2中，并证明了其时间复杂度（平均O(log(n))）可以与传统实现相媲美。这对于展示图转换系统在实现复杂算法和数据结构方面的实用性和效率具有重要意义。局限性在于O(n)的最坏情况性能可能是由于图转换规则的全局匹配或遍历成本，这表明在最坏情况下，图编程范式的开销可能高于指针操作。
motivation: 在基于规则的图编程语言GP 2中实现二叉搜索树（BST）。
method: 使用GP 2的基于规则的图编程和有根图转换规则来实现二叉搜索树。
results: 实现支持插入、删除和查询操作。每种操作的最坏情况运行时为O(n)，平均预期运行时为O(log(n))。
conclusion: 该实现在时间复杂度上与命令式语言中二叉搜索树的实现相匹配。

title: Parsing Hypergraphs using Context-Free Positional Grammars
authors: Gennaro Costagliola, Federico Vastarini
abstract: We present a novel work-in-progress approach to the parsing of hypergraphs generated by context-free hyperedge replacement grammars. This method is based on a new LR parsing technique for positional grammars, which is also under active development. Central to our approach is a reduction from hyperedge replacement to positional grammars with additional structural constraints, enabling the use of permutation-based operations to determine the correct ordering of hyperedges on the right-hand side of productions. Preliminary results also reveal a distinction between ambiguity in graph generation and ambiguity in graph recognition. While the exact class of hyperedge replacement languages parsable under this method remains under investigation, the approach provides a promising foundation for future generalisations to more expressive grammar formalisms. Graph parsing remains a broadly relevant problem across numerous domains, and our contribution aims to advance both the theoretical and practical understanding of this challenge.
zh_title: 使用上下文无关位置文法解析超图
translation: 我们提出了一种新颖的、仍在进行中的方法，用于解析由上下文无关超边替换文法生成的超图。该方法基于一种新的针对位置文法的LR解析技术，该技术也正在积极开发中。我们方法的关键在于将超边替换文法归约为带有额外结构约束的位置文法，从而能够使用基于置换的操作来确定产生式右侧超边的正确顺序。初步结果还揭示了图生成中的歧义和图识别中的歧义之间的区别。虽然通过该方法可解析的超边替换语言的确切类别仍在调查中，但该方法为未来推广到更具表达力的文法形式提供了一个有前景的基础。图解析在众多领域仍然是一个普遍相关的问题，我们的贡献旨在推进对这一挑战的理论和实践理解。
tldr: 本文提出了一种使用新的LR解析技术解析超图的方法，通过将超边替换文法归约为受限位置文法来实现，初步揭示了歧义的区别，并为未来的图解析泛化奠定了基础。
ai_comments: 创新点在于提出了一种将超边替换文法（HRG）归约为受限位置文法（PG）的解析方法，并应用了正在开发中的新型LR解析技术来处理超图的非线性结构。这为图解析这一基础问题提供了新的理论框架。然而，摘要明确指出该工作和所依赖的LR解析技术均处于“正在进行中”或“积极开发中”的状态，且该方法可解析的超边替换语言的确切类别“仍在调查中”，这些是其主要的局限性。
motivation: 图解析在众多领域仍然是一个普遍相关的问题。本文旨在推进对这一挑战的理论和实践理解。
method: 该方法是一种新颖的、基于正在开发中的针对位置文法的新型LR解析技术的解析方法。核心在于将超边替换归约为带有额外结构约束的位置文法，并使用基于置换的操作来确定产生式右侧超边的正确顺序。
results: 初步结果揭示了图生成中的歧义和图识别中的歧义之间的区别。该方法为未来推广到更具表达力的文法形式提供了一个有前景的基础。
conclusion: 该方法为未来推广到更具表达力的文法形式奠定了有前景的基础，旨在推进图解析挑战的理论和实践理解。

title: Introducing The Maximum Common Bigraph Problem
authors: Kyle Burns, Michele Sevegnani, Ciaran McCreesh, James Trimble
abstract: Bigraph reactive systems offer a powerful and flexible mathematical framework for modelling both spatial and non-spatial relationships between agents, with practical applications in domains such as smart technologies, networks, sensor systems, and biology. While bigraphs theoretically support the identification of bisimilar agents, by simulating and comparing their corresponding minimal contextual transition systems, no known algorithm exists for computing the maximum shared structure between two bigraphs, an essential prerequisite for determining the set of possible transitions for a given agent state. In this work, we provide a definition of the maximum common bigraph problem, and present an adaptation of the McSplit maximum common induced subgraph algorithm to compute the maximum common bigraph between two bigraph states. Our approach opens a path toward supporting bisimulation checking in bigraph-based tools, which have been leveraged in other modelling paradigms for simplification, optimisation, and verification of models.
zh_title: 引入最大公共双图问题
translation: 双图反应系统提供了一个强大而灵活的数学框架，用于建模代理之间的空间和非空间关系，在智能技术、网络、传感器系统和生物学等领域具有实际应用。虽然双图理论上支持通过模拟和比较其相应的最小上下文转换系统来识别双模拟代理，但目前尚不存在用于计算两个双图之间最大共享结构的已知算法，而该结构是确定给定代理状态的一组可能转换的基本先决条件。在这项工作中，我们提供了最大公共双图问题的定义，并提出了对McSplit最大公共诱导子图算法的改编，用于计算两个双图状态之间的最大公共双图。我们的方法为支持基于双图的工具中的双模拟检查开辟了道路，这些工具已被其他建模范式用于模型的简化、优化和验证。
tldr: 本文定义了“最大公共双图问题”，并提出了一种基于McSplit算法的变体来计算两个双图之间的最大共享结构，从而为在双图工具中支持双模拟检查（bisimulation checking）铺平道路。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于正式提出了“最大公共双图问题”，填补了双图理论在实际应用中的一个关键算法空白。通过借鉴并改编成熟的McSplit算法，作者提供了一个实用的计算方法，使得双图反应系统能够实现之前理论上可行但算法上缺失的双模拟检查功能。这对于提升双图建模范式的实用性和验证能力具有重要意义。
motivation: 双图反应系统是建模智能技术、网络和生物学等领域中代理间关系的重要框架。尽管双图理论上支持双模拟代理的识别，但缺乏计算两个双图之间最大共享结构的已知算法，而该结构是确定代理状态可能转换的先决条件。
method: 1. 提供了最大公共双图问题的正式定义。 2. 提出了对McSplit最大公共诱导子图算法的改编，用于计算两个双图状态之间的最大公共双图。
results: 该方法能够计算两个双图之间的最大公共双图。
conclusion: 本方法为在基于双图的工具中支持双模拟检查开辟了道路，这对于模型的简化、优化和验证至关重要。

title: Towards Safe Autonomous Driving: A Real-Time Motion Planning Algorithm on Embedded Hardware
authors: Korbinian Moller, Glenn Johannes Tungka, Lucas Jürgens, Johannes Betz
abstract: Ensuring the functional safety of Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) requires motion planning modules that not only operate within strict real-time constraints but also maintain controllability in case of system faults. Existing safeguarding concepts, such as Online Verification (OV), provide safety layers that detect infeasible planning outputs. However, they lack an active mechanism to ensure safe operation in the event that the main planner fails. This paper presents a first step toward an active safety extension for fail-operational Autonomous Driving (AD). We deploy a lightweight sampling-based trajectory planner on an automotive-grade, embedded platform running a Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). The planner continuously computes trajectories under constrained computational resources, forming the foundation for future emergency planning architectures. Experimental results demonstrate deterministic timing behavior with bounded latency and minimal jitter, validating the feasibility of trajectory planning on safety-certifiable hardware. The study highlights both the potential and the remaining challenges of integrating active fallback mechanisms as an integral part of next-generation safeguarding frameworks. The code is available at: https://github.com/TUM-AVS/real-time-motion-planning
comment: 7 pages, submitted to the IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV 2026), Detroit, MI, United States
zh_title: 迈向安全的自动驾驶：嵌入式硬件上的实时运动规划算法
translation: 确保自动驾驶汽车（AVs）的功能安全，要求运动规划模块不仅要在严格的实时约束下运行，而且在系统发生故障时仍需保持可控性。现有的安全保障概念，例如在线验证（OV），提供了检测不可行规划输出的安全层。然而，它们缺乏在主规划器失效时确保安全运行的主动机制。本文提出了迈向故障可运行（fail-operational）自动驾驶（AD）主动安全扩展的第一步。我们在运行实时操作系统（RTOS）的汽车级嵌入式平台上部署了一个轻量级的基于采样的轨迹规划器。该规划器在受限的计算资源下持续计算轨迹，为未来的紧急规划架构奠定了基础。实验结果证明了确定的时序行为，具有有界的延迟和最小的抖动，验证了在安全认证硬件上进行轨迹规划的可行性。该研究强调了将主动回退机制作为下一代安全保障框架组成部分的潜力和尚存的挑战。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/TUM-AVS/real-time-motion-planning
tldr: 为解决现有自动驾驶安全机制缺乏主动故障处理能力的问题，本文在嵌入式硬件和RTOS上部署了一个轻量级采样轨迹规划器。实验证明该规划器具有确定的时序行为和低延迟/抖动，为未来故障可运行（fail-operational）的紧急规划架构奠定了基础。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将传统上计算密集型的运动规划任务，成功部署到资源受限的实时嵌入式硬件上，并证明其满足严格的时序要求（低延迟和最小抖动）。这为实现故障可运行（fail-operational）的自动驾驶系统提供了一个关键的基础组件，解决了现有安全框架中缺乏主动故障恢复机制的痛点。未来的挑战在于如何将此“第一步”扩展为一个完整的、具有充分安全保障的紧急规划架构。
motivation: 现有自动驾驶（AVs）的安全保障概念（如在线验证OV）只能检测不可行的规划输出，但缺乏在主规划器失效时确保安全运行的主动机制。本文旨在迈出实现故障可运行（fail-operational）自动驾驶的主动安全扩展的第一步。
method: 部署了一个轻量级的基于采样的轨迹规划器。该规划器运行在汽车级嵌入式平台和实时操作系统（RTOS）上，并在受限的计算资源下持续计算轨迹。
results: 实验结果证明了该规划器具有确定的时序行为（deterministic timing behavior），其延迟（latency）有界且抖动（jitter）最小。这验证了在安全认证硬件上进行轨迹规划的可行性。
conclusion: 该研究强调了将主动回退机制作为下一代安全保障框架组成部分的潜力和挑战，并为未来的紧急规划架构奠定了基础。

title: Unleashing the Potential of Neighbors: Diffusion-based Latent Neighbor Generation for Session-based Recommendation
authors: Yuhan Yang, Jie Zou, Guojia An, Jiwei Wei, Yang Yang, Heng Tao Shen
abstract: Session-based recommendation aims to predict the next item that anonymous users may be interested in, based on their current session interactions. Recent studies have demonstrated that retrieving neighbor sessions to augment the current session can effectively alleviate the data sparsity issue and improve recommendation performance. However, existing methods typically rely on explicitly observed session data, neglecting latent neighbors - not directly observed but potentially relevant within the interest space - thereby failing to fully exploit the potential of neighbor sessions in recommendation. To address the above limitation, we propose a novel model of diffusion-based latent neighbor generation for session-based recommendation, named DiffSBR. Specifically, DiffSBR leverages two diffusion modules, including retrieval-augmented diffusion and self-augmented diffusion, to generate high-quality latent neighbors. In the retrieval-augmented diffusion module, we leverage retrieved neighbors as guiding signals to constrain and reconstruct the distribution of latent neighbors. Meanwhile, we adopt a training strategy that enables the retriever to learn from the feedback provided by the generator. In the self-augmented diffusion module, we explicitly guide the generation of latent neighbors by injecting the current session's multi-modal signals through contrastive learning. After obtaining the generated latent neighbors, we utilize them to enhance session representations for improving session-based recommendation. Extensive experiments on four public datasets show that DiffSBR generates effective latent neighbors and improves recommendation performance against state-of-the-art baselines.
comment: This paper has been accepted by KDD 2026
zh_title: 释放邻居的潜力：基于扩散的潜在邻居生成用于会话推荐
translation: 基于会话的推荐旨在根据匿名用户当前的会话交互来预测他们可能感兴趣的下一个项目。最近的研究表明，检索邻居会话来增强当前会话可以有效地缓解数据稀疏性问题并提高推荐性能。然而，现有方法通常依赖于显式观察到的会话数据，忽略了潜在邻居——即未直接观察到但在兴趣空间中可能相关的邻居——从而未能充分利用邻居会话在推荐中的潜力。为了解决上述限制，我们提出了一种新颖的、基于扩散的潜在邻居生成模型用于会话推荐，名为DiffSBR。具体来说，DiffSBR利用两个扩散模块来生成高质量的潜在邻居，包括检索增强扩散和自我增强扩散。在检索增强扩散模块中，我们利用检索到的邻居作为指导信号来约束和重构潜在邻居的分布。同时，我们采用了一种训练策略，使检索器能够从生成器提供的反馈中学习。在自我增强扩散模块中，我们通过对比学习注入当前会话的多模态信号，从而明确指导潜在邻居的生成。在获得生成的潜在邻居后，我们利用它们来增强会话表示，以改进基于会话的推荐。在四个公共数据集上进行的大量实验表明，DiffSBR生成了有效的潜在邻居，并提高了推荐性能，优于最先进的基线方法。
tldr: 针对会话推荐中缺乏潜在邻居的问题，我们提出了DiffSBR，它使用检索增强和自我增强的扩散模型来生成高质量的潜在邻居，从而显著提升了推荐性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将扩散模型引入会话推荐领域，用于显式地生成“潜在邻居”，解决了现有方法过度依赖显式观察数据的局限性。通过结合检索增强和对比自增强策略，DiffSBR构建了一个强大的混合生成框架，充分挖掘了邻居在兴趣空间中的潜力，是解决数据稀疏性和提升推荐精度的重要进展。
motivation: 现有的会话推荐方法依赖于显式观察到的会话数据，忽略了潜在邻居（在兴趣空间中相关但未直接观察到的），未能充分利用邻居的潜力。
method: 提出DiffSBR模型，通过基于扩散的潜在邻居生成来增强会话表示。模型包含两个扩散模块：1. 检索增强扩散：利用检索到的邻居作为指导信号来约束和重构潜在邻居的分布，并让生成器向检索器提供反馈。2. 自我增强扩散：通过对比学习注入当前会话的多模态信号来指导潜在邻居的生成。
results: 在四个公共数据集上进行的大量实验表明，DiffSBR能生成有效的潜在邻居，并提升了推荐性能，优于最先进的基线方法。
conclusion: 通过基于扩散的方法生成潜在邻居，可以有效地增强会话表示，从而显著改善会话推荐的性能。

title: Exact Continuous Reformulations of Logic Constraints in Nonlinear Optimization and Optimal Control Problems
authors: Jad Wehbeh, Eric C. Kerrigan
abstract: Many nonlinear optimal control and optimization problems involve constraints that combine continuous dynamics with discrete logic conditions. Standard approaches typically rely on mixed-integer programming, which introduces scalability challenges and requires specialized solvers. This paper presents an exact reformulation of broad classes of logical constraints as binary-variable-free expressions whose differentiability properties coincide with those of the underlying predicates, enabling their direct integration into nonlinear programming models. Our approach rewrites arbitrary logical propositions into conjunctive normal form, converts them into equivalent max--min constraints, and applies a smoothing procedure that preserves the exact feasible set. The method is evaluated on two benchmark problems, a quadrotor trajectory optimization with obstacle avoidance and a hybrid two-tank system with temporal logic constraints, and is shown to obtain optimal solutions more consistently and efficiently than existing binary variable elimination techniques.
comment: 8 pages, 11 figures, submitted for publication to Automatica
zh_title: 逻辑约束在非线性优化和最优控制问题中的精确连续重构
translation: 许多非线性最优控制和优化问题涉及结合了连续动力学和离散逻辑条件的约束。标准方法通常依赖于混合整数规划，这带来了可扩展性挑战并需要专业的求解器。本文提出了一种广泛逻辑约束的精确重构方法，将其表示为无二值变量的表达式，其可微分性与基础谓词一致，从而能够将其直接整合到非线性规划模型中。我们的方法将任意逻辑命题重写为合取范式，将其转换为等效的max-min约束，并应用保留精确可行集的平滑过程。该方法在两个基准问题（带避障的四旋翼飞行器轨迹优化和带时序逻辑约束的混合双罐系统）上进行了评估，结果显示它比现有的二值变量消除技术能更一致、更高效地获得最优解。
tldr: 本文提出了一种将复杂的逻辑约束精确地、无二值变量地重构为连续表达式的方法，从而可以直接整合到非线性规划模型中，并在最优控制问题上展现出比现有技术更高的一致性和效率。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提供了一种绕过混合整数规划（MIP）限制的方法，解决了逻辑约束在连续优化中的整合难题。通过将逻辑约束转化为具有与基础谓词相同可微分性的连续、无二值变量表达式，它极大地提高了求解复杂最优控制问题的可扩展性和效率。这种精确重构（保留了精确可行集）对于需要高精度解的工程应用尤其重要。
motivation: 许多非线性最优控制和优化问题涉及结合了连续动力学和离散逻辑条件的约束。标准方法（如混合整数规划）引入了可扩展性挑战并需要专业的求解器。
method: 提出了一种将广泛的逻辑约束精确重构为无二值变量表达式的方法，其可微分性与基础谓词一致。具体步骤包括：将任意逻辑命题重写为合取范式（CNF），将其转换为等效的max-min约束，并应用保留精确可行集的平滑过程。
results: 该方法在两个基准问题（带避障的四旋翼飞行器轨迹优化和带时序逻辑约束的混合双罐系统）上进行了评估，结果显示它比现有的二值变量消除技术能更一致、更高效地获得最优解。
conclusion: 这种精确连续重构方法能够将复杂的逻辑约束有效地整合到非线性规划模型中，并在一致性和效率上优于现有的二值变量消除技术。

title: Current Agents Fail to Leverage World Model as Tool for Foresight
authors: Cheng Qian, Emre Can Acikgoz, Bingxuan Li, Xiusi Chen, Yuji Zhang, Bingxiang He, Qinyu Luo, Dilek Hakkani-Tür, Gokhan Tur, Yunzhu Li, Heng Ji, Heng Ji
abstract: Agents built on vision-language models increasingly face tasks that demand anticipating future states rather than relying on short-horizon reasoning. Generative world models offer a promising remedy: agents could use them as external simulators to foresee outcomes before acting. This paper empirically examines whether current agents can leverage such world models as tools to enhance their cognition. Across diverse agentic and visual question answering tasks, we observe that some agents rarely invoke simulation (fewer than 1%), frequently misuse predicted rollouts (approximately 15%), and often exhibit inconsistent or even degraded performance (up to 5%) when simulation is available or enforced. Attribution analysis further indicates that the primary bottleneck lies in the agents' capacity to decide when to simulate, how to interpret predicted outcomes, and how to integrate foresight into downstream reasoning. These findings underscore the need for mechanisms that foster calibrated, strategic interaction with world models, paving the way toward more reliable anticipatory cognition in future agent systems.
zh_title: 当前智能体未能将世界模型用作预见性工具
translation: 基于视觉-语言模型构建的智能体日益面临需要预测未来状态而非依赖短期推理的任务。生成式世界模型提供了一种有前景的补救措施：智能体可以将其用作外部模拟器，在行动前预见结果。本文实证检验了当前智能体是否能将此类世界模型作为工具来增强其认知能力。在各种智能体和视觉问答任务中，我们观察到一些智能体很少调用模拟（少于1%），频繁误用预测的推演结果（约15%），并且在模拟可用或强制执行时经常表现出不一致甚至性能下降（高达5%）。归因分析进一步表明，主要瓶颈在于智能体决定何时模拟、如何解释预测结果以及如何将预见性整合到后续推理中的能力。这些发现强调了需要建立促进与世界模型进行校准和战略性交互的机制，从而为未来智能体系统中更可靠的预见性认知铺平道路。
tldr: 当前智能体在使用生成式世界模型进行预见性推理时表现不佳。它们很少调用模拟，经常误用预测结果，甚至导致性能下降。主要瓶颈在于智能体缺乏战略性地整合和解释预见结果的能力。
ai_comments: 这篇论文强调了世界模型（作为预见性的外部模拟器）的理论潜力与它们在当前智能体架构中实际效用之间的关键差距。具体的量化观察结果（例如，调用率低于1%，误用率15%，性能下降5%）提供了强有力的实证证据，表明仅仅*提供*一个强大的工具是不够的；智能体必须经过训练或设计，学会战略性地*使用*它。这项工作将焦点从构建更好的世界模型转移到构建能够有效利用现有世界模型的智能体上，特别是关于元认知（知道何时模拟）和整合/解释能力方面。
motivation: 智能体面临日益增长的需要预测未来状态的任务，但目前的智能体依赖于短期推理。生成式世界模型有望作为外部模拟器提供预见性，因此需要实证检验现有智能体是否能够有效利用它们。
method: 在各种智能体任务和视觉问答任务上进行实证检验。方法包括观察模拟调用频率、预测结果的误用情况，以及在模拟可用或强制执行时的性能变化，并进行归因分析。
results: 智能体很少调用模拟（少于1%），经常误用预测的推演结果（约15%），并且在模拟可用时经常表现出不一致甚至性能下降（高达5%）。
conclusion: 主要瓶颈在于智能体决定何时模拟、如何解释预测结果以及如何将预见性整合到后续推理中的能力。这些发现强调了需要建立促进与世界模型进行校准和战略性交互的机制，从而实现更可靠的预期认知。

title: Decide Then Retrieve: A Training-Free Framework with Uncertainty-Guided Triggering and Dual-Path Retrieval
authors: Wang Chen, Guanqiang Qi, Weikang Li, Yang Li, Deguo Xia, Jizhou Huang
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge, but existing approaches indiscriminately trigger retrieval and rely on single-path evidence construction, often introducing noise and limiting performance gains. In this work, we propose Decide Then Retrieve (DTR), a training-free framework that adaptively determines when retrieval is necessary and how external information should be selected. DTR leverages generation uncertainty to guide retrieval triggering and introduces a dual-path retrieval mechanism with adaptive information selection to better handle sparse and ambiguous queries. Extensive experiments across five open-domain QA benchmarks, multiple model scales, and different retrievers demonstrate that DTR consistently improves EM and F1 over standard RAG and strong retrieval-enhanced baselines, while reducing unnecessary retrievals. The code and data used in this paper are available at https://github.com/ChenWangHKU/DTR.
zh_title: 先决定后检索：一个带有不确定性引导触发和双路径检索的免训练框架
translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过整合外部知识来增强大型语言模型（LLM），但现有方法不加区分地触发检索并依赖单路径证据构建，这通常会引入噪声并限制性能提升。在这项工作中，我们提出了“先决定后检索”（DTR），这是一个免训练框架，它能自适应地确定何时需要检索以及如何选择外部信息。DTR利用生成不确定性来指导检索触发，并引入了带有自适应信息选择机制的双路径检索机制，以更好地处理稀疏和模糊的查询。在五个开放域问答基准、多种模型规模和不同检索器上进行的广泛实验表明，DTR相较于标准RAG和强大的检索增强基线，持续提高了EM和F1分数，同时减少了不必要的检索。本文使用的代码和数据可在https://github.com/ChenWangHKU/DTR获取。
tldr: 检索增强生成（RAG）存在过度检索和证据单一的问题。本文提出DTR（先决定后检索），这是一个免训练框架，它利用生成不确定性来决定是否需要检索，并采用双路径检索机制来更好地选择信息，从而在开放域问答任务中提高了性能并减少了不必要的检索。
ai_comments: DTR的创新点在于其核心的两个组件：1）不确定性引导的触发机制，它将RAG从“始终开启”的系统转变为自适应系统，提高了效率；2）双路径检索，增强了对复杂（稀疏/模糊）查询的鲁棒性。作为一个免训练框架，它具有高实用性，易于集成到现有RAG流程中。其重要性在于定义了一种更智能、更具条件的RAG范式。
motivation: 现有的检索增强生成（RAG）方法会不加区分地触发检索，并依赖于单路径证据构建，这通常会引入噪声并限制性能提升。
method: 提出了“先决定后检索”（DTR）的免训练框架。该框架利用生成不确定性来指导检索触发（决定何时检索），并引入了带有自适应信息选择机制的双路径检索机制（决定如何选择信息）。
results: DTR在五个开放域问答基准、多种模型规模和不同检索器上，相较于标准RAG和强大的检索增强基线，持续提高了EM和F1分数，同时减少了不必要的检索。
conclusion: DTR框架通过自适应地确定何时检索以及如何选择外部信息，成功解决了现有RAG方法中不加区分检索和单路径证据构建的局限性，实现了性能的持续提升和不必要检索的减少。

title: An Event-Based Opto-Tactile Skin
authors: Mohammadreza Koolani, Simeon Bamford, Petr Trunin, Simon F. Müller-Cleve, Matteo Lo Preti, Fulvio Mastrogiovanni, Lucia Beccai, Chiara Bartolozzi
abstract: This paper presents a neuromorphic, event-driven tactile sensing system for soft, large-area skin, based on the Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS) integrated with a flexible silicone optical waveguide skin. Instead of repetitively scanning embedded photoreceivers, this design uses a stereo vision setup comprising two DVS cameras looking sideways through the skin. Such a design produces events as changes in brightness are detected, and estimates press positions on the 2D skin surface through triangulation, utilizing Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) to find the center of mass of contact events resulting from pressing actions. The system is evaluated over a 4620 mm2 probed area of the skin using a meander raster scan. Across 95 % of the presses visible to both cameras, the press localization achieved a Root-Mean-Squared Error (RMSE) of 4.66 mm. The results highlight the potential of this approach for wide-area flexible and responsive tactile sensors in soft robotics and interactive environments. Moreover, we examined how the system performs when the amount of event data is strongly reduced. Using stochastic down-sampling, the event stream was reduced to 1/1024 of its original size. Under this extreme reduction, the average localization error increased only slightly (from 4.66 mm to 9.33 mm), and the system still produced valid press localizations for 85 % of the trials. This reduction in pass rate is expected, as some presses no longer produce enough events to form a reliable cluster for triangulation. These results show that the sensing approach remains functional even with very sparse event data, which is promising for reducing power consumption and computational load in future implementations. The system exhibits a detection latency distribution with a characteristic width of 31 ms.
comment: Accepted for publication in Frontiers in Neuromorphic Engineering. 23 pages, 9 figures
zh_title: 基于事件的光学触觉皮肤
translation: 本文提出了一种神经形态、事件驱动的触觉传感系统，用于软体、大面积皮肤，该系统基于动态视觉传感器（DVS）并与柔性硅胶光学波导皮肤集成。与重复扫描嵌入式光电接收器不同，该设计采用包含两个DVS相机侧视皮肤的立体视觉设置。当检测到亮度变化时，这种设计会产生事件，并利用三角测量法估计2D皮肤表面上的按压位置，同时使用基于密度的带噪声应用空间聚类（DBSCAN）来寻找按压动作产生的接触事件的质心。该系统在4620 mm²的皮肤探测区域上使用蛇形光栅扫描进行了评估。对于95%的对两个相机都可见的按压，按压定位实现了4.66 mm的均方根误差（RMSE）。结果突出了该方法在软体机器人和交互式环境中的宽区域柔性且响应迅速的触觉传感器方面的潜力。此外，我们检查了当事件数据量被大幅减少时系统的性能。通过随机降采样，事件流被减少到其原始大小的1/1024。在这种极端减少下，平均定位误差仅略微增加（从4.66 mm到9.33 mm），并且系统仍能为85%的试验产生有效的按压定位。这种通过率的下降是预期的，因为一些按压不再产生足够的事件来形成可靠的三角测量簇。这些结果表明，即使在事件数据非常稀疏的情况下，该传感方法仍能保持功能，这对于未来实施中降低功耗和计算负荷是有希望的。该系统表现出特征宽度为31 ms的检测延迟分布。
tldr: 该文提出了一种基于DVS相机和柔性硅胶光波导皮肤的神经形态事件驱动触觉传感系统。它通过立体视觉和三角测量实现按压定位，在4620 mm²的区域上实现了4.66 mm的RMSE。即使将事件数据量减少到1/1024，系统仍能保持功能，证明了其在低功耗应用中的潜力。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于将神经形态的DVS技术与柔性光学波导皮肤相结合，创建了一种事件驱动、高响应性的触觉传感器。其重要性在于解决了传统触觉传感器在大面积、柔性集成和低功耗方面的挑战。特别是系统在事件数据被极大稀释后仍能保持功能（1/1024的事件量仍能有效工作）的发现，极具价值，预示着未来在资源受限的软体机器人或可穿戴设备中实现高效、低计算负荷传感的可能性。主要限制可能包括三角测量的精度受限于光学波导材料的均匀性以及DBSCAN对噪声和集群形态的依赖性。
motivation: 旨在开发一种用于软体、大面积皮肤的神经形态、事件驱动的触觉传感系统，以提供宽区域、柔性且响应迅速的触觉传感器，适用于软体机器人和交互式环境。
method: 该系统将动态视觉传感器（DVS）与柔性硅胶光学波导皮肤集成。它采用包含两个DVS相机的立体视觉设置，通过侧视皮肤检测亮度变化（事件）。使用三角测量法和基于密度的带噪声应用空间聚类（DBSCAN）算法来确定接触事件的质心，从而估计2D皮肤表面的按压位置。
results: 在4620 mm²的探测区域上，对于95%的可见按压，按压定位的均方根误差（RMSE）为4.66 mm。当事件流通过随机降采样减少到原始大小的1/1024时，平均定位误差仅略微增加到9.33 mm，并且系统仍能为85%的试验产生有效的按压定位。系统检测延迟分布的特征宽度为31 ms。

title: When Models Decide and When They Bind: A Two-Stage Computation for Multiple-Choice Question-Answering
authors: Hugh Mee Wong, Rick Nouwen, Albert Gatt
abstract: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) is easy to evaluate but adds a meta-task: models must both solve the problem and output the symbol that *represents* the answer, conflating reasoning errors with symbol-binding failures. We study how language models implement MCQA internally using representational analyses (PCA, linear probes) as well as causal interventions. We find that option-boundary (newline) residual states often contain strong linearly decodable signals related to per-option correctness. Winner-identity probing reveals a two-stage progression: the winning *content position* becomes decodable immediately after the final option is processed, while the *output symbol* is represented closer to the answer emission position. Tests under symbol and content permutations support a two-stage mechanism in which models first select a winner in content space and then bind or route that winner to the appropriate symbol to emit.
zh_title: 模型何时决策，何时绑定：多项选择问答的两阶段计算
translation: 多项选择问答（MCQA）易于评估，但它增加了一个元任务：模型必须既要解决问题，又要输出*代表*答案的符号，这混淆了推理错误与符号绑定失败。我们利用表征分析（主成分分析、线性探针）以及因果干预来研究语言模型如何在内部实现MCQA。我们发现，选项边界（换行符）的残差状态通常包含与每个选项正确性相关的、可线性解码的强信号。赢家身份探测揭示了一个两阶段的进展：*获胜内容位置*在处理完最后一个选项后立即变得可解码，而*输出符号*则在更靠近答案发出位置处才被表示。在符号和内容置换下的测试支持一种两阶段机制：模型首先在内容空间中选择一个赢家，然后将该赢家绑定或路由到适当的符号上进行输出。
tldr: 语言模型解决多项选择问答（MCQA）时，并非一步到位，而是采用两阶段机制：首先在内容空间中选择正确答案，然后将该答案绑定到相应的输出符号上。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新之处在于它深入探究了大型语言模型（LLM）内部的认知结构，特别是在处理多项选择任务时。通过区分“决策”（内容选择）和“绑定”（符号输出）两个阶段，它提供了一个更精细的错误分析框架，有助于理解模型是因推理失败还是因输出路由错误而答错。这对可解释性研究（XAI）和提高MCQA模型的鲁力性具有重要意义。
motivation: MCQA的评估很简单，但它要求模型既要解决问题，又要输出代表答案的符号，这混淆了推理错误和符号绑定失败。研究旨在探究语言模型如何在内部实现MCQA。
method: 使用表征分析（PCA、线性探针）和因果干预来研究语言模型内部如何实现MCQA。具体包括赢家身份探测（winner-identity probing）以及在符号和内容置换下的测试。
results: 发现：1. 选项边界（换行符）的残差状态通常包含与每个选项正确性相关的、可线性解码的强信号。2. 存在一个两阶段进程：在处理完最后一个选项后，*获胜内容位置*立即变得可解码；而*输出符号*则在更靠近答案发出位置处才被表示。
conclusion: 模型的MCQA过程支持两阶段机制：模型首先在内容空间中选择赢家，然后将该赢家绑定或路由到要发出的相应符号上。

title: HemBLIP: A Vision-Language Model for Interpretable Leukemia Cell Morphology Analysis
authors: Julie van Logtestijn, Petru Manescu
abstract: Microscopic evaluation of white blood cell morphology is central to leukemia diagnosis, yet current deep learning models often act as black boxes, limiting clinical trust and adoption. We introduce HemBLIP, a vision language model designed to generate interpretable, morphology aware descriptions of peripheral blood cells. Using a newly constructed dataset of 14k healthy and leukemic cells paired with expert-derived attribute captions, we adapt a general-purpose VLM via both full fine-tuning and LoRA based parameter efficient training, and benchmark against the biomedical foundation model MedGEMMA. HemBLIP achieves higher caption quality and morphological accuracy, while LoRA adaptation provides further gains with significantly reduced computational cost. These results highlight the promise of vision language models for transparent and scalable hematological diagnostics.
zh_title: HemBLIP：用于可解释白血病细胞形态分析的视觉-语言模型
translation: 白细胞形态的显微镜评估是白血病诊断的核心，但目前的深度学习模型通常充当黑箱，限制了临床信任和采用。我们引入了 HemBLIP，这是一种视觉语言模型，旨在生成可解释的、形态学感知的外周血细胞描述。我们使用一个新构建的包含 1.4 万个健康和白血病细胞及其专家属性描述的数据集，通过全量微调和基于 LoRA 的参数高效训练来适应通用 VLM，并与生物医学基础模型 MedGEMMA 进行基准测试。HemBLIP 实现了更高的描述质量和形态学准确性，而 LoRA 适应方法在显著降低计算成本的同时，提供了进一步的性能提升。这些结果突出了视觉语言模型在透明和可扩展的血液学诊断中的前景。
tldr: HemBLIP是一个用于白血病诊断的视觉语言模型（VLM），它通过生成可解释的形态描述来解决黑箱问题。它使用1.4万个细胞数据集，并采用LoRA高效训练，在准确性和描述质量上优于基线模型，有望提高血液学诊断的透明度。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将视觉-语言模型（VLM）应用于血液学诊断，特别关注了临床应用中至关重要的“可解释性”问题。通过生成形态学描述，HemBLIP将黑箱预测转化为人类可理解的临床依据，极大地增强了临床医生对模型的信任。使用LoRA等参数高效训练方法，同时实现了性能提升和计算成本降低，使其具有很高的实用性和可扩展性。数据集的构建（14k细胞和专家属性描述）是成功的关键因素。
motivation: 白细胞形态的显微镜评估是白血病诊断的核心，但目前的深度学习模型通常是黑箱，限制了临床信任和采用。
method: 引入了名为 HemBLIP 的视觉语言模型（VLM），旨在生成可解释的、形态学感知的描述。使用了包含 1.4 万个健康和白血病细胞及其专家属性描述的新数据集。通过全量微调和基于 LoRA 的参数高效训练来适应通用 VLM，并与生物医学基础模型 MedGEMMA 进行基准测试。
results: HemBLIP 实现了更高的描述质量和形态学准确性。基于 LoRA 的适应方法在显著降低计算成本的同时，提供了进一步的性能提升。
conclusion: 视觉语言模型在透明和可扩展的血液学诊断中具有应用前景。

title: Human Challenge Oracle: Designing AI-Resistant, Identity-Bound, Time-Limited Tasks for Sybil-Resistant Consensus
authors: Homayoun Maleki, Nekane Sainz, Jon Legarda
abstract:
Sybil attacks remain a fundamental obstacle in open online systems, where adversaries can cheaply create and sustain large numbers of fake identities. Existing defenses, including CAPTCHAs and one-time proof-of-personhood mechanisms, primarily address identity creation and provide limited protection against long-term, large-scale Sybil participation, especially as automated solvers and AI systems continue to improve.
  We introduce the Human Challenge Oracle (HCO), a new security primitive for continuous, rate-limited human verification. HCO issues short, time-bound challenges that are cryptographically bound to individual identities and must be solved in real time. The core insight underlying HCO is that real-time human cognitive effort, such as perception, attention, and interactive reasoning, constitutes a scarce resource that is inherently difficult to parallelize or amortize across identities.
  We formalize the design goals and security properties of HCO and show that, under explicit and mild assumptions, sustaining s active identities incurs a cost that grows linearly with s in every time window. We further describe abstract classes of admissible challenges and concrete browser-based instantiations, and present an initial empirical study illustrating that these challenges are easily solvable by humans within seconds while remaining difficult for contemporary automated systems under strict time constraints.
zh_title: 人类挑战预言机：设计抗AI、身份绑定、有时限的任务以实现抗女巫攻击的共识
translation: 女巫攻击仍然是开放式在线系统中的一个根本性障碍，在这种系统中，对手可以廉价地创建和维持大量的虚假身份。现有的防御措施，包括CAPTCHA和一次性人证机制，主要解决身份创建问题，对长期、大规模的女巫参与提供的保护有限，尤其是在自动化求解器和AI系统不断改进的情况下。我们引入了人类挑战预言机（Human Challenge Oracle, HCO），这是一种用于连续、限速人类验证的新安全原语。HCO发布简短的、有时限的挑战，这些挑战与个体身份进行加密绑定，并且必须实时解决。HCO的核心洞察在于，实时的人类认知努力，如感知、注意力以及交互式推理，构成了一种稀缺资源，本质上难以在多个身份之间并行化或分摊。我们形式化了HCO的设计目标和安全属性，并证明在明确且温和的假设下，维持$s$个活跃身份所需的成本在每个时间窗口内与$s$呈线性增长。我们进一步描述了可接受挑战的抽象类别和具体的基于浏览器的实例化，并提出了初步的实证研究，表明这些挑战在严格的时间限制下，人类可以在几秒钟内轻松解决，同时对当代自动化系统来说仍然很困难。
tldr: 引入人类挑战预言机（HCO），这是一种新的安全原语，通过要求实时解决与身份绑定的有时限认知挑战，使女巫攻击的成本与身份数量呈线性增长，从而实现连续的人类验证和抗女巫攻击的共识。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将“实时人类认知努力”提升为一种可量化、不可分摊的稀缺资源，从而为抗女巫攻击共识提供了一种新的、持续性的安全机制。与传统的CAPTCHA只关注身份创建不同，HCO专注于身份的持续活跃和速率限制，使其更能抵抗日益复杂的自动化求解器和AI系统。如果其实际部署和用户体验能够得到优化，HCO有望成为开放系统（如去中心化网络）中身份验证的重要基石。
motivation: 女巫攻击是开放式在线系统的根本障碍。现有防御措施（如CAPTCHA和一次性人证机制）在对抗长期、大规模的女巫参与方面效果有限，尤其是在自动化求解器和AI系统不断改进的情况下。
method: 引入“人类挑战预言机”（HCO），这是一种用于连续、限速人类验证的新安全原语。HCO发布与单个身份加密绑定的、有时限的简短挑战，必须实时解决。其核心洞察是实时的人类认知努力（如感知、注意力、交互式推理）是一种难以并行化或分摊的稀缺资源。
results: 形式化了HCO的设计目标和安全属性。证明在明确和温和的假设下，维持$s$个活跃身份所需的成本在每个时间窗口内与$s$呈线性增长。描述了可接受挑战的抽象类别和具体的浏览器实现。初步的实证研究表明，这些挑战在严格的时间限制下，人类可在数秒内轻松解决，而当代自动化系统则难以应对。

title: A Gap Between Decision Trees and Neural Networks
authors: Akash Kumar
abstract:
We study when geometric simplicity of decision boundaries, used here as a notion of interpretability, can conflict with accurate approximation of axis-aligned decision trees by shallow neural networks. Decision trees induce rule-based, axis-aligned decision regions (finite unions of boxes), whereas shallow ReLU networks are typically trained as score models whose predictions are obtained by thresholding. We analyze the infinite-width, bounded-norm, single-hidden-layer ReLU class through the Radon total variation ($\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$) seminorm, which controls the geometric complexity of level sets.
  We first show that the hard tree indicator $1_A$ has infinite $\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$. Moreover, two natural split-wise continuous surrogates--piecewise-linear ramp smoothing and sigmoidal (logistic) smoothing--also have infinite $\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$ in dimensions $d>1$, while Gaussian convolution yields finite $\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$ but with an explicit exponential dependence on $d$.
  We then separate two goals that are often conflated: classification after thresholding (recovering the decision set) versus score learning (learning a calibrated score close to $1_A$). For classification, we construct a smooth barrier score $S_A$ with finite $\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$ whose fixed threshold $τ=1$ exactly recovers the box. Under a mild tube-mass condition near $\partial A$, we prove an $L_1(P)$ calibration bound that decays polynomially in a sharpness parameter, along with an explicit $\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$ upper bound in terms of face measures. Experiments on synthetic unions of rectangles illustrate the resulting accuracy--complexity tradeoff and how threshold selection shifts where training lands along it.
zh_title: 决策树与神经网络之间的鸿沟
translation:
我们研究了作为可解释性概念的决策边界的几何简单性，何时会与浅层神经网络对轴对齐决策树的精确逼近发生冲突。决策树会产生基于规则、轴对齐的决策区域（盒子的有限并集），而浅层ReLU网络通常被训练为分数模型，其预测通过阈值化获得。我们通过Radon总变差 ($\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$) 半范数分析了无限宽度、有界范数、单隐藏层ReLU类别，该半范数控制了水平集的几何复杂度。
我们首先表明，硬树指示函数 $1_A$ 具有无限的 $\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$。此外，两种自然的分裂式连续替代——分段线性斜坡平滑和S形（逻辑）平滑——在维度 $d>1$ 时也具有无限的 $\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$，而高斯卷积产生的 $\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$ 是有限的，但明确地呈指数依赖于 $d$。
随后，我们区分了两个经常混淆的目标：阈值化后的分类（恢复决策集）与分数学习（学习接近 $1_A$ 的校准分数）。对于分类，我们构建了一个具有有限 $\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$ 的光滑障碍分数 $S_A$，其固定阈值 $τ=1$ 可以精确恢复盒子。在 $\partial A$ 附近温和的管状质量条件下，我们证明了一个 $L_1(P)$ 校准界限，它以锐度参数的多项式形式衰减，并给出了一个与面测度有关的显式 $\mathrm{R}\mathrm{TV}$ 上界。对合成矩形并集的实验说明了由此产生的准确性-复杂度权衡，以及阈值选择如何影响训练沿着该权衡曲线的位置。
tldr: 研究发现，由于决策树产生的轴对齐决策区域具有无限的几何复杂度（通过RTV衡量），浅层ReLU网络难以准确逼近这些区域。文章区分了分类和分数学习，并提出了一个具有有限RTV的光滑障碍分数模型，用于精确恢复决策区域，并分析了其准确性和复杂度之间的权衡。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于使用Radon总变差（RTV）这一几何复杂性度量工具，量化了决策树（DTs）和浅层神经网络（NNs）在表示能力上的本质差异，从而为“可解释性”与“准确性”之间的权衡提供了一个严格的数学框架。通过证明DTs的硬决策边界具有无限RTV，解释了为什么浅层NN难以完美复制DTs的轴对齐结构。提出的光滑障碍分数模型提供了一种理论上可行的方法来弥补这一鸿沟，对于理解神经网络在学习规则型决策边界时的局限性及其在可解释AI领域中的应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 探索决策边界的几何简单性（作为可解释性的一个概念）与浅层神经网络准确逼近轴对齐决策树的能力之间何时会发生冲突。
method:
1. 使用Radon总变差（RTV）半范数来控制水平集的几何复杂度，分析无限宽度、有界范数、单隐藏层ReLU网络。
2. 分析了硬树指示函数 ($1_A$) 及其两种自然平滑替代（分段线性斜坡平滑和S形平滑）的RTV。
3. 区分了阈值化后的分类（恢复决策集）与分数学习（学习接近 $1_A$ 的校准分数）。
4. 构建了一个具有有限RTV的光滑障碍分数 $S_A$，并通过 $L_1(P)$ 校准界限和显式的RTV上界来证明其有效性。
results:
1. 硬树指示函数 $1_A$ 具有无限的RTV。
2. 两种自然的平滑替代（分段线性斜坡和平滑S形函数）在 $d>1$ 维度上也具有无限的RTV。
3. 高斯卷积产生的RTV是有限的，但明确地呈指数依赖于维度 $d$。
4. 构建的光滑障碍分数 $S_A$ 具有有限的RTV，其固定阈值 $τ=1$ 可以精确恢复盒子（决策区域）。
5. 在温和的管状质量条件下，证明了 $L_1(P)$ 校准界限呈多项式衰减，并给出了RTV上界与面测度有关的明确表达。
6. 实验说明了由此产生的准确性-复杂度权衡，以及阈值选择如何影响训练沿着该权衡曲线的位置。

title: Monaas: Mobile Node as a Service for TSCH-based Industrial IoT Networks
authors: Jinting Liu, Jingwei Li, Tengfei Chang
abstract: The Time-Slotted Channel Hopping (TSCH) mode of IEEE802.15.4 standard provides ultra high end-to-end reliability and low-power consumption for application in field of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT). With the evolving of Industrial 4.0, dynamic and bursty tasks with varied Quality of Service (QoS); effective management and utilization of growing number of mobile equipments become two major challenges for network solutions. The existing TSCH-based networks lack of a system framework design to handle these challenges. In this paper, we propose a novel, service-oriented, and hierarchical IoT network architecture named Mobile Node as a Service (Monaas). Monaas aims to systematically manage and schedule mobile nodes as on-demand, elastic resources through a new architectural design and protocol mechanisms. Its core features include a hierarchical architecture to balance global coordination with local autonomy, task-driven scheduling for proactive resource allocation, and an on-demand mobile resource integration mechanism. The feasibility and potential of the Monaas link layer mechanisms are validated through implementation and performance evaluation on an nRF52840 hardware testbed, demonstrating its potential advantages in specific scenarios. On a physical nRF52840 testbed, Monaas consistently achieved a Task Completion Rate (TCR) above 98% for high-priority tasks under bursty traffic and link degradation, whereas all representative baselines (Static TSCH, 6TiSCH Minimal, OST, FTS-SDN) remained below 40%.Moreover, its on-demand mobile resource integration activated services in 1.2 s, at least 65% faster than SDN (3.5 s) and OST/6TiSCH (> 5.8 s).
zh_title: Monaas：面向基于TSCH的工业物联网网络的移动节点即服务
translation: IEEE802.15.4标准的时隙信道跳频（TSCH）模式为工业物联网（IIoT）领域的应用提供了超高端到端可靠性和低功耗。随着工业4.0的发展，具有不同服务质量（QoS）的动态和突发任务，以及对日益增长的移动设备的有效管理和利用，成为网络解决方案面临的两大主要挑战。现有的基于TSCH的网络缺乏一个系统框架设计来应对这些挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“移动节点即服务”（Monaas）的新型、面向服务、分层的物联网网络架构。Monaas旨在通过新的架构设计和协议机制，将移动节点作为按需、弹性资源进行系统化管理和调度。其核心特点包括：平衡全局协调和本地自治的分层架构、用于主动资源分配的任务驱动调度，以及按需移动资源集成机制。Monaas链路层机制的可行性和潜力通过在nRF52840硬件测试台上的实现和性能评估得到验证，证明了其在特定场景中的潜在优势。在物理nRF52840测试台上，Monaas在突发流量和链路质量下降的情况下，高优先级任务的任务完成率（TCR）始终保持在98%以上，而所有代表性基线（Static TSCH、6TiSCH Minimal、OST、FTS-SDN）均低于40%。此外，其按需移动资源集成在1.2秒内激活服务，比SDN（3.5秒）和OST/6TiSCH（> 5.8秒）快至少65%。
tldr: 针对现有TSCH网络难以有效管理移动设备和突发任务的问题，本文提出了Monaas架构。Monaas将移动节点作为按需资源进行管理和调度，通过分层架构和任务驱动调度，在突发流量和链路质量下降的情况下，高优先级任务的完成率显著优于现有基线（高于98% vs. 低于40%），且资源激活速度更快。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个针对TSCH网络的系统级架构（Monaas），以应对工业4.0中日益增长的移动性和任务突发性挑战。传统的TSCH设计侧重于静态或半静态部署下的可靠性，而Monaas通过引入“移动节点即服务”的概念，将移动资源视为可调度的弹性资源，极大地提升了网络对动态变化的适应能力。实验结果对比清晰且性能提升显著（TCR从<40%提升到>98%），有力地证明了该架构在处理高优先级动态任务方面的巨大潜力。这种将服务抽象和分层管理引入底层通信协议的设计思路，对于未来IIoT网络架构具有重要指导意义。

method: 提出了一种名为Monaas（移动节点即服务）的新型、面向服务、分层的物联网网络架构。该架构旨在将移动节点作为按需、弹性资源进行系统化管理和调度，核心机制包括：平衡全局协调与本地自治的分层架构、用于主动资源分配的任务驱动调度，以及按需移动资源集成机制。

title: Doc-PP: Document Policy Preservation Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models
authors: Haeun Jang, Hwan Chang, Hwanhee Lee
abstract: The deployment of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) for real-world document question answering is often constrained by dynamic, user-defined policies that dictate information disclosure based on context. While ensuring adherence to these explicit constraints is critical, existing safety research primarily focuses on implicit social norms or text-only settings, overlooking the complexities of multimodal documents. In this paper, we introduce Doc-PP (Document Policy Preservation Benchmark), a novel benchmark constructed from real-world reports requiring reasoning across heterogeneous visual and textual elements under strict non-disclosure policies. Our evaluation highlights a systemic Reasoning-Induced Safety Gap: models frequently leak sensitive information when answers must be inferred through complex synthesis or aggregated across modalities, effectively circumventing existing safety constraints. Furthermore, we identify that providing extracted text improves perception but inadvertently facilitates leakage. To address these vulnerabilities, we propose DVA (Decompose-Verify-Aggregation), a structural inference framework that decouples reasoning from policy verification. Experimental results demonstrate that DVA significantly outperforms standard prompting defenses, offering a robust baseline for policy-compliant document understanding
zh_title: Doc-PP：大型视觉-语言模型的文档策略遵守基准
translation: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在现实世界文档问答中的部署，通常受到动态的、用户定义的策略的限制，这些策略根据上下文规定信息披露。虽然确保遵守这些明确的约束至关重要，但现有安全研究主要集中在隐含的社会规范或纯文本设置上，忽略了多模态文档的复杂性。在本文中，我们引入了Doc-PP（文档策略遵守基准），这是一个新颖的基准，它由真实世界的报告构建而成，要求在严格的非披露策略下对异构的视觉和文本元素进行推理。我们的评估突出了一种系统性的“推理引发的安全漏洞”：当答案必须通过复杂的综合或跨模态聚合来推断时，模型经常泄露敏感信息，有效地规避了现有的安全约束。此外，我们发现提供提取的文本可以改善感知，但无意中助长了信息泄露。为了解决这些漏洞，我们提出了DVA（分解-验证-聚合），这是一个将推理与策略验证解耦的结构化推理框架。实验结果表明，DVA显著优于标准的提示防御方法，为策略兼容的文档理解提供了一个强大的基线。
tldr: 针对LVLMs在文档问答中难以遵守非披露策略的问题，本文提出了Doc-PP基准来评估模型。研究发现存在“推理引发的安全漏洞”，并提出了DVA框架（分解-验证-聚合）来解耦推理和策略验证，显著提高了策略遵守能力。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将LVLMs的安全研究从传统的隐性社会规范或纯文本领域，扩展到了更具挑战性的多模态文档和明确的、用户定义的策略遵守（Policy Preservation）领域。Doc-PP基准的构建填补了现有安全评估的空白，特别是关注了需要复杂跨模态推理的场景。提出的DVA框架针对性地解决了模型在推理过程中更容易泄露信息的系统性问题，通过结构化解耦提供了一种有效的防御机制，对于推动LVLMs在敏感文档处理领域的安全部署具有重要意义。
motivation: 现实世界的文档问答系统要求大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）遵守动态的、用户定义的策略来控制信息披露。然而，现有的安全研究主要关注隐含的社会规范或纯文本环境，忽略了多模态文档的复杂性和对明确策略遵守的严格要求。
method: 1. 提出了Doc-PP（文档策略遵守基准），该基准基于真实世界报告构建，要求在严格的非披露策略下对异构的视觉和文本元素进行跨模态推理。2. 提出了DVA（分解-验证-聚合）结构化推理框架，该框架将推理过程与策略验证过程解耦。
results: 1. 评估揭示了系统性的“推理引发的安全漏洞”：当答案必须通过复杂的综合推理或跨模态聚合来推断时，模型经常泄露敏感信息，从而规避了现有的安全约束。2. 发现提供提取的文本虽然改善了感知，但无意中助长了信息泄露。3. 实验结果表明，DVA显著优于标准的提示防御方法。
conclusion: DVA框架显著优于标准的提示防御方法，为策略兼容的文档理解提供了一个强大的基线，有效地解决了LVLMs在遵守文档策略方面的漏洞。

title: Constrained dynamics for searching saddle points on general Riemannian manifolds
authors: Yukuan Hu, Laura Grazioli
abstract: Finding constrained saddle points on Riemannian manifolds is significant for analyzing energy landscapes arising in physics and chemistry. Existing works have been limited to special manifolds that admit global regular level-set representations, excluding applications such as electronic excited-state calculations. In this paper, we develop a constrained saddle dynamics applicable to smooth functions on general Riemannian manifolds. Our dynamics is formulated compactly over the Grassmann bundle of the tangent bundle. By analyzing the Grassmann bundle geometry, we achieve universality via incorporating the second fundamental form, which captures variations of tangent spaces along the trajectory. We rigorously establish the local linear stability of the dynamics and the local linear convergence of the resulting algorithms. Remarkably, our analysis provides the first convergence guarantees for discretized saddle-search algorithms in manifold settings. Moreover, by respecting the intrinsic quotient structure, we remove unnecessary nondegeneracy assumptions on the eigenvalues of the Riemannian Hessian that are present in existing works. We also point out that locating saddle points can be more ill-conditioning than finding local minimizers, and requires using nonredundant parametrizations. Finally, numerical experiments on linear eigenvalue problems and electronic excited-state calculations showcase the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms and corroborate the established local theory.
