zh_title: 约束动力学用于在一般黎曼流形上搜索鞍点
translation: 在黎曼流形上寻找约束鞍点对于分析物理学和化学中出现的能量景观具有重要意义。现有工作仅限于允许全局正则水平集表示的特殊流形，排除了诸如电子激发态计算等应用。在本文中，我们开发了一种适用于一般黎曼流形上光滑函数的约束鞍点动力学。我们的动力学在切丛的Grassmann丛上紧凑地表述。通过分析Grassmann丛几何，我们通过纳入第二基本形式（其捕捉沿轨迹的切空间变化）实现了普适性。我们严格建立了动力学的局部线性稳定性和所得算法的局部线性收敛性。值得注意的是，我们的分析首次为流形设置下的离散鞍点搜索算法提供了收敛性保证。此外，通过尊重内在的商结构，我们消除了现有工作中对黎曼Hessian特征值所存在的不必要的非退化假设。我们还指出，定位鞍点可能比寻找局部极小值更具病态性，并且需要使用非冗余参数化。最后，在线性特征值问题和电子激发态计算中的数值实验展示了所提出算法的有效性并证实了已建立的局部理论。
tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于一般黎曼流形上光滑函数的约束鞍点动力学方法。通过分析Grassmann丛几何并纳入第二基本形式，该方法首次为流形设置下的离散鞍点搜索算法提供了收敛性保证，并成功应用于电子激发态计算等领域。
ai_comments: 本文的创新性在于将鞍点搜索动力学推广到一般的黎曼流形上，克服了现有方法对特殊流形的限制。其重要性体现在为物理和化学中的复杂能量景观分析（如电子激发态）提供了新的工具。尤其值得称赞的是，它不仅提出了新的动力学模型，还提供了在流形设置下离散算法的首次收敛性保证，这是理论上的重大突破。通过消除对黎曼Hessian特征值的不必要假设，该方法在应用上更加稳健和通用。
motivation: 寻找黎曼流形上的约束鞍点对于分析物理学和化学中的能量景观至关重要。现有工作仅限于具有全局正则水平集表示的特殊流形，排除了电子激发态计算等重要应用。
method: 开发了一种适用于一般黎曼流形上光滑函数的约束鞍点动力学。该动力学紧凑地表述在切丛的Grassmann丛上。通过分析Grassmann丛几何并纳入第二基本形式（其捕捉沿轨迹的切空间变化），实现了方法的普适性。
results: 1. 严格建立了动力学的局部线性稳定性和所得算法的局部线性收敛性。2. 首次为流形设置下的离散鞍点搜索算法提供了收敛性保证。3. 通过尊重内在商结构，消除了现有工作中对黎曼Hessian特征值不必要的非退化假设。4. 数值实验（在线性特征值问题和电子激发态计算中）展示了所提出算法的有效性并证实了理论。

title: FocusUI: Efficient UI Grounding via Position-Preserving Visual Token Selection
authors: Mingyu Ouyang, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou, Hwee Tou Ng
abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable performance in User Interface (UI) grounding tasks, driven by their ability to process increasingly high-resolution screenshots. However, screenshots are tokenized into thousands of visual tokens (e.g., about 4700 for 2K resolution), incurring significant computational overhead and diluting attention. In contrast, humans typically focus on regions of interest when interacting with UI. In this work, we pioneer the task of efficient UI grounding. Guided by practical analysis of the task's characteristics and challenges, we propose FocusUI, an efficient UI grounding framework that selects patches most relevant to the instruction while preserving positional continuity for precise grounding. FocusUI addresses two key challenges: (1) Eliminating redundant tokens in visual encoding. We construct patch-level supervision by fusing an instruction-conditioned score with a rule-based UI-graph score that down-weights large homogeneous regions to select distinct and instruction-relevant visual tokens. (2) Preserving positional continuity during visual token selection. We find that general visual token pruning methods suffer from severe accuracy degradation on UI grounding tasks due to broken positional information. We introduce a novel PosPad strategy, which compresses each contiguous sequence of dropped visual tokens into a single special marker placed at the sequence's last index to preserve positional continuity. Comprehensive experiments on four grounding benchmarks demonstrate that FocusUI surpasses GUI-specific baselines. On the ScreenSpot-Pro benchmark, FocusUI-7B achieves a performance improvement of 3.7% over GUI-Actor-7B. Even with only 30% visual token retention, FocusUI-7B drops by only 3.2% while achieving up to 1.44x faster inference and 17% lower peak GPU memory.
zh_title: FocusUI：通过位置保持的视觉标记选择实现高效UI定位
translation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在用户界面（UI）定位任务中表现出了显著的性能，这得益于它们处理越来越高分辨率截图的能力。然而，截图被标记化为数千个视觉标记（例如，2K分辨率约有4700个），带来了巨大的计算开销并稀释了注意力。相比之下，人类在与UI交互时通常只关注感兴趣的区域。在这项工作中，我们开创了高效UI定位的任务。在对任务特点和挑战进行实用分析的指导下，我们提出了FocusUI，这是一个高效的UI定位框架，它选择与指令最相关的补丁，同时保留位置连续性以实现精确的定位。FocusUI解决了两个关键挑战：（1）消除视觉编码中的冗余标记。我们通过融合指令条件分数和基于规则的UI图分数来构建补丁级监督，以降低大型同质区域的权重，从而选择独特且与指令相关的视觉标记。（2）在视觉标记选择过程中保持位置连续性。我们发现，一般的视觉标记剪枝方法由于破坏了位置信息，在UI定位任务上会出现严重的精度下降。我们引入了一种新颖的PosPad策略，它将每个连续丢弃的视觉标记序列压缩成一个放置在该序列最后一个索引处的特殊标记，以保留位置连续性。在四个定位基准测试上的综合实验表明，FocusUI超越了GUI特定的基线。在ScreenSpot-Pro基准测试中，FocusUI-7B比GUI-Actor-7B的性能提高了3.7%。即使只保留30%的视觉标记，FocusUI-7B的性能也只下降3.2%，同时实现了高达1.44倍的推理速度和17%的峰值GPU内存降低。
tldr: 为了解决高分辨率UI截图带来的计算开销和注意力稀释问题，本文提出了FocusUI框架。它通过融合指令和UI图分数来选择最相关的视觉标记，并使用PosPad策略保留位置连续性，从而在显著提高推理速度和降低内存消耗的同时，保持了UI定位的高精度。
ai_comments: FocusUI的创新点在于将效率提升（通过标记剪枝）与UI定位任务的特定需求（位置连续性）相结合。传统的视觉标记剪枝方法在UI任务中容易失败，因为UI元素的精确边界和相对位置至关重要。PosPad策略通过用单个标记代表连续的丢弃区域，巧妙地解决了位置信息破坏的问题，这是对现有VLM效率提升技术的重要改进。该工作不仅开创了“高效UI定位”这一新的任务方向，而且通过实际的性能和资源节约数据（1.44倍加速，17%内存降低）证明了其在实际应用中的巨大价值。
motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在处理高分辨率UI截图时，会产生数千个视觉标记，导致显著的计算开销并稀释注意力。本文旨在开创高效UI定位的任务，通过模仿人类只关注感兴趣区域的方式，提高效率。
method: 提出FocusUI框架，通过选择与指令最相关的补丁来实现高效UI定位。方法包括：1. **消除冗余标记：** 通过融合指令条件分数和基于规则的UI图分数来构建补丁级监督，以选择独特且与指令相关的标记。2. **保持位置连续性：** 引入PosPad策略，将每个连续丢弃的视觉标记序列压缩成一个放置在该序列最后一个索引处的特殊标记，以保留位置信息。
results: 在四个定位基准测试中，FocusUI超越了GUI特定的基线。在ScreenSpot-Pro基准测试中，FocusUI-7B比GUI-Actor-7B的性能提高了3.7%。即使只保留30%的视觉标记，性能也只下降3.2%，但推理速度提高了1.44倍，峰值GPU内存降低了17%。
conclusion: FocusUI通过有效选择视觉标记并保持位置连续性，成功地实现了高效UI定位，在保持高准确率的同时，显著提升了计算效率和资源利用率。

title: Complexity of Perfect and Ideal Resilience Verification in Fast Re-Route Networks
authors: Matthias Bentert, Esra Ceylan-Kettler, Valentin Hübner, Stefan Schmid, Jiří Srba
abstract:
To achieve fast recovery from link failures, most modern communication networks feature fully decentralized fast re-routing mechanisms. These re-routing mechanisms rely on pre-installed static re-routing rules at the nodes (the routers), which depend only on local failure information, namely on the failed links incident to the node. Ideally, a network is perfectly resilient: the re-routing rules ensure that packets are always successfully routed to their destinations as long as the source and the destination are still physically connected in the underlying network after the failures. Unfortunately, there are examples where achieving perfect resilience is not possible. Surprisingly, only very little is known about the algorithmic aspect of when and how perfect resilience can be achieved.
  We investigate the computational complexity of analyzing such local fast re-routing mechanisms. Our main result is a negative one: we show that even checking whether a given set of static re-routing rules ensures perfect resilience is coNP-complete. We also show coNP-completeness of the so-called ideal resilience, a weaker notion of resilience often considered in the literature. Additionally, we investigate other fundamental variations of the problem. In particular, we show that our coNP-completeness proof also applies to scenarios where the re-routing rules have specific patterns (known as skipping in the literature).
  On the positive side, for scenarios where nodes do not have information about the link from which a packet arrived (the so-called in-port), we present linear-time algorithms for both the verification and synthesis problem for perfect resilience.
zh_title: 快速重路由网络中完美和理想弹性验证的复杂性
translation: 为了实现从链路故障中快速恢复，大多数现代通信网络都采用了完全去中心化的快速重路由机制。这些重路由机制依赖于在节点（路由器）上预先安装的静态重路由规则，这些规则仅依赖于局部故障信息，即与该节点相邻的故障链路。理想情况下，网络是完美弹性的：只要源和目的地在底层网络中故障后仍然物理连接，重路由规则就能确保数据包始终成功路由到目的地。不幸的是，存在无法实现完美弹性的例子。令人惊讶的是，关于何时以及如何实现完美弹性的算法方面知之甚少。我们研究了分析这种局部快速重路由机制的计算复杂性。我们的主要结果是否定的：我们证明了即使是检查给定的一组静态重路由规则是否确保完美弹性也是共NP完全的。我们还证明了所谓的理想弹性（文献中经常考虑的一种较弱的弹性概念）也是共NP完全的。此外，我们研究了该问题的其他基本变体。特别是，我们证明了我们的共NP完全性证明也适用于重路由规则具有特定模式（文献中称为跳过，skipping）的场景。从积极的方面来看，对于节点不知道数据包来自哪条链路（所谓的in-port）的场景，我们提出了用于完美弹性验证和合成问题的线性时间算法。
tldr: 在快速重路由网络中，验证既定的静态规则是否能确保“完美弹性”或“理想弹性”是共NP完全的，这表明验证难度很高。但在节点缺乏数据包到达端口（in-port）信息的特定情况下，存在线性时间算法。
ai_comments: 本文的重要性在于首次对快速重路由网络中核心的弹性验证问题给出了严格的计算复杂性界限。共NP完全性的证明揭示了在完全去中心化、基于局部信息进行决策的网络中，保证全局连通性（完美弹性）的困难性。这对于设计未来FRR协议和工具具有重要的指导意义，表明在一般情况下，高效的运行时验证是不可能的。同时，发现特定约束条件（缺乏in-port信息）下的线性时间算法，为特定类型的网络设计提供了优化途径。
motivation: 现代网络使用快速重路由机制应对链路故障，目标是实现完美弹性（只要物理连接存在，数据包就能到达）。然而，实现完美弹性的算法条件和计算复杂性知之甚少。本文旨在研究分析这种局部快速重路由机制的计算复杂性。
method: 通过证明计算复杂性界限（共NP完全性）来分析局部快速重路由机制，并针对特定约束条件（缺乏in-port信息）设计了线性时间算法。
results: 主要的负面结果是：检查给定的静态重路由规则是否确保完美弹性是共NP完全的。检查理想弹性（一种较弱的概念）也是共NP完全的。正面的结果是：在节点缺乏数据包到达端口信息的场景中，完美弹性的验证和合成问题存在线性时间算法。
conclusion: 验证快速重路由网络中的完美弹性或理想弹性在计算上是困难的（共NP完全），即使对于特定规则模式也是如此。但在缺乏in-port信息的特定受限场景中，验证和合成可以高效地在线性时间内完成。

title: Large-Scale Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Reasoning-Infused LLMs
authors: Paweł Liskowski, Krzysztof Jankowski
abstract: We introduce Arctic-ABSA, a collection of powerful models for real-life aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA). Our models are tailored to commercial needs, trained on a large corpus of public data alongside carefully generated synthetic data, resulting in a dataset 20 times larger than SemEval14. We extend typical ABSA models by expanding the number of sentiment classes from the standard three (positive, negative, neutral) to five, adding mixed and unknown classes, while also jointly predicting overall text sentiment and supporting multiple languages. We experiment with reasoning injection by fine-tuning on Chain-of-Thought (CoT) examples and introduce a novel reasoning pretraining technique for encoder-only models that significantly improves downstream fine-tuning and generalization. Our 395M-parameter encoder and 8B-parameter decoder achieve up to 10 percentage points higher accuracy than GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet, while setting new state-of-the-art results on the SemEval14 benchmark. A single multilingual model maintains 87-91% accuracy across six languages without degrading English performance. We release ABSA-mix, a large-scale benchmark aggregating 17 public ABSA datasets across 92 domains.
zh_title: 具有推理注入的大规模方面级情感分析
translation: 我们引入了Arctic-ABSA，一系列强大的用于真实世界方面级情感分析（ABSA）的模型。我们的模型针对商业需求量身定制，在大量公开数据和精心生成的合成数据上进行训练，形成的数据集比SemEval14大20倍。我们将典型的ABSA模型扩展，将情感类别的数量从标准的三个（正面、负面、中性）增加到五个，增加了混合和未知类别，同时联合预测整体文本情感并支持多种语言。我们通过在思维链（CoT）示例上进行微调来实验推理注入，并引入一种新颖的编码器模型推理预训练技术，该技术显著改善了下游微调和泛化能力。我们的3.95亿参数编码器和80亿参数解码器在准确率上比GPT-4o和Claude 3.5 Sonnet高出10个百分点，同时在SemEval14基准测试上创造了新的最先进结果。一个单一的多语言模型在六种语言上保持87-91%的准确率，而不会降低英语性能。我们发布了ABSA-mix，一个聚合了92个领域中17个公开ABSA数据集的大规模基准测试集。
tldr: 研究人员开发了Arctic-ABSA，一个大规模、多类别的方面级情感分析模型，通过集成推理训练（CoT和新预训练方法），在SemEval14上击败了GPT-4o，并在六种语言上表现出色，同时发布了一个大型基准数据集。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了Arctic-ABSA模型集合，它不仅规模庞大，而且通过引入混合和未知情感类别扩展了传统ABSA任务，并创新性地结合了思维链（CoT）推理和一种新的推理预训练技术，显著提升了性能，甚至超越了GPT-4o等先进模型。其重要性在于为商业应用提供了更强大、更细粒度的情感分析能力。局限性方面，虽然声称超越了GPT-4o，但未明确说明在何种真实世界场景下进行全面比较。
motivation: 开发适用于商业需求的、更强大的、实时的大规模方面级情感分析（ABSA）模型。
method: 使用大规模公开数据和合成数据（比SemEval14大20倍）训练模型；将情感类别扩展到五类（正、负、中性、混合、未知）；联合预测整体文本情感并支持多语言；通过在思维链（CoT）示例上微调来注入推理能力；为仅编码器模型引入新颖的推理预训练技术。
results: 3.95亿参数的编码器和80亿参数的解码器模型在SemEval14基准测试上取得了最先进的结果，准确率比GPT-4o和Claude 3.5 Sonnet高出10个百分点。一个多语言模型在六种语言上保持87-91%的准确率，且不损害英语性能。发布了包含17个数据集、跨越92个领域的ABSA-mix大规模基准测试集。
conclusion: 通过引入Arctic-ABSA模型集合，该研究在扩展情感类别、支持多语言和注入推理能力方面取得了显著进展，并在SemEval14基准测试上取得了最先进的结果，同时在与顶尖LLM的比较中展现出更高的准确性。

title: Trade-R1: Bridging Verifiable Rewards to Stochastic Environments via Process-Level Reasoning Verification
authors: Rui Sun, Yifan Sun, Sheng Xu, Li Zhao, Jing Li, Daxin Jiang, Chen Hua, Zuo Bai
abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled Large Language Models (LLMs) to achieve remarkable reasoning in domains like mathematics and coding, where verifiable rewards provide clear signals. However, extending this paradigm to financial decision is challenged by the market's stochastic nature: rewards are verifiable but inherently noisy, causing standard RL to degenerate into reward hacking. To address this, we propose Trade-R1, a model training framework that bridges verifiable rewards to stochastic environments via process-level reasoning verification. Our key innovation is a verification method that transforms the problem of evaluating reasoning over lengthy financial documents into a structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) task. We construct a triangular consistency metric, assessing pairwise alignment between retrieved evidence, reasoning chains, and decisions to serve as a validity filter for noisy market returns. We explore two reward integration strategies: Fixed-effect Semantic Reward (FSR) for stable alignment signals, and Dynamic-effect Semantic Reward (DSR) for coupled magnitude optimization. Experiments on different country asset selection demonstrate that our paradigm reduces reward hacking, with DSR achieving superior cross-market generalization while maintaining the highest reasoning consistency.
zh_title: 交易-R1：通过过程级推理验证将可验证奖励桥接到随机环境
translation: 强化学习（RL）已使大型语言模型（LLM）在数学和编码等领域取得了卓越的推理能力，这些领域的可验证奖励提供了清晰的信号。然而，将这种范式扩展到金融决策面临市场随机性的挑战：奖励是可验证的，但本质上是嘈杂的，导致标准RL退化为奖励欺骗。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Trade-R1，一个通过过程级推理验证将可验证奖励桥接到随机环境的模型训练框架。我们的关键创新是一种验证方法，它将评估跨冗长金融文档的推理问题转化为一个结构化的检索增强生成（RAG）任务。我们构建了一个三角形一致性指标，评估检索到的证据、推理链和决策之间的成对对齐，以此作为嘈杂的市场回报的有效性过滤器。我们探索了两种奖励整合策略：用于稳定对齐信号的固定效应语义奖励（FSR）和用于耦合幅度优化的动态效应语义奖励（DSR）。在不同国家资产选择上的实验表明，我们的范式减少了奖励欺骗，其中DSR在保持最高推理一致性的同时实现了卓越的跨市场泛化能力。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为Trade-R1的框架，用于解决金融决策中的强化学习（RL）问题。由于市场固有的随机性和噪声，标准的RL方法容易导致奖励欺骗。Trade-R1通过过程级推理验证，将可验证的奖励与随机环境相结合。其核心创新在于将评估金融文档推理的任务转化为结构化的检索增强生成（RAG）任务，并引入了三角形一致性指标来过滤噪声市场回报。实验表明，Trade-R1能减少奖励欺骗，其中DSR策略在跨市场泛化和推理一致性方面表现优异。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的Trade-R1框架，有效地解决了在金融等随机环境中应用强化学习时面临的奖励欺骗问题。通过将推理过程结构化为RAG任务并引入三角形一致性指标，该方法为处理嘈杂的市场数据提供了一种有效的解决方案。DSR策略在实验中表现出的优越性能和泛化能力尤为值得关注。然而，该框架在实际金融应用中的可扩展性和鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 标准的强化学习（RL）方法在数学和编码等领域取得了成功，但由于金融市场的随机性和噪声，将其应用于金融决策会面临挑战，导致奖励欺骗。
method: 提出Trade-R1框架，通过过程级推理验证将可验证奖励与随机环境连接起来。创新之处在于将评估金融文档推理的任务转化为结构化的检索增强生成（RAG）任务，并构建了一个三角形一致性指标来评估检索证据、推理链和决策之间的一致性，以此作为过滤噪声市场回报的有效性过滤器。探索了两种奖励整合策略：固定效应语义奖励（FSR）和动态效应语义奖励（DSR）。
results: 在不同国家资产选择的实验中，Trade-R1框架减少了奖励欺骗。其中，DSR策略在跨市场泛化方面表现优越，并保持了最高的推理一致性。
conclusion: Trade-R1框架通过引入过程级推理验证，成功地将可验证的奖励与金融市场的随机环境相结合，有效解决了标准RL方法中的奖励欺骗问题，并在跨市场资产选择任务中展现出优越的性能和泛化能力。

title: FOREVER: Forgetting Curve-Inspired Memory Replay for Language Model Continual Learning
authors: Yujie Feng, Hao Wang, Jian Li, Xu Chu, Zhaolu Kang, Yiran Liu, Yasha Wang, Philip S. Yu, Xiao-Ming Wu
abstract: Continual learning (CL) for large language models (LLMs) aims to enable sequential knowledge acquisition without catastrophic forgetting. Memory replay methods are widely used for their practicality and effectiveness, but most rely on fixed, step-based heuristics that often misalign with the model's actual learning progress, since identical training steps can result in varying degrees of parameter change. Motivated by recent findings that LLM forgetting mirrors the Ebbinghaus human forgetting curve, we propose FOREVER (FORgEtting curVe-inspired mEmory Replay), a novel CL framework that aligns replay schedules with a model-centric notion of time. FOREVER defines model time using the magnitude of optimizer updates, allowing forgetting curve-inspired replay intervals to align with the model's internal evolution rather than raw training steps. Building on this approach, FOREVER incorporates a forgetting curve-based replay scheduler to determine when to replay and an intensity-aware regularization mechanism to adaptively control how to replay. Extensive experiments on three CL benchmarks and models ranging from 0.6B to 13B parameters demonstrate that FOREVER consistently mitigates catastrophic forgetting.
zh_title: FOREVER：受遗忘曲线启发的语言模型持续学习的记忆重放方法
translation: 持续学习（CL）旨在使大型语言模型（LLMs）能够在不发生灾难性遗忘的情况下顺序获取知识。记忆重放方法因其实用性和有效性而被广泛使用，但大多数依赖于固定的、基于步骤的启发式方法，这些方法通常与模型的实际学习进度不符，因为相同的训练步骤可能导致不同程度的参数变化。受近期研究发现大型语言模型遗忘现象与艾宾浩斯人类遗忘曲线相似的启发，我们提出了 FOREVER（受遗忘曲线启发的记忆重放），一个新颖的 CL 框架，它将重放时间表与模型的中心时间概念对齐。FOREVER 使用优化器更新的幅度来定义模型时间，从而使受遗忘曲线启发的重放间隔与模型的内部演变对齐，而不是原始的训练步骤。在此基础上，FOREVER 整合了一个基于遗忘曲线的重放调度器来确定何时重放，以及一个强度感知的正则化机制来适应性地控制如何重放。在跨越 0.6B 到 13B 参数范围的三个 CL 基准测试和模型上进行的广泛实验证明，FOREVER 持续有效地减轻了灾难性遗忘。
tldr: FOREVER 提出了一种新颖的持续学习方法，它使用优化器更新幅度来定义“模型时间”，并基于人类遗忘曲线来安排记忆重放的频率和强度，从而比基于步骤的方法更精确地防止大型语言模型灾难性遗忘。
ai_comments: 该方法创新性地将人类遗忘曲线的概念应用于语言模型的持续学习，并使用优化器更新的幅度来定义“模型时间”，这比传统的基于步骤的启发式方法更具模型中心性，能够更精确地调度记忆重放。其实验结果在不同规模的模型上都显示出对灾难性遗忘的有效缓解。
motivation: 现有的记忆重放方法依赖于固定的、基于步骤的启发式方法，这与模型实际的学习进度不一致，因为相同的训练步骤可能导致不同程度的参数变化。研究发现大型语言模型的遗忘现象与人类的艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线相似。
method: FOREVER 框架定义了使用优化器更新幅度作为“模型时间”的概念，并构建了一个受遗忘曲线启发的重放调度器来确定重放时机，同时整合了一个强度感知的正则化机制来适应性地控制重放强度。
results: 在三个持续学习基准测试和参数范围从 0.6B 到 13B 的模型上进行的广泛实验表明，FOREVER 持续有效地减轻了灾难性遗忘。
conclusion: FOREVER 框架通过使用基于遗忘曲线的重放调度和强度感知的正则化机制，有效地缓解了灾难性遗忘。

title: Computing the Intrinsic Delaunay Triangulation of a Closed Polyhedral Surface
authors: Loïc Dubois
abstract:
Every surface that is intrinsically polyhedral can be represented by a portalgon: a collection of polygons in the Euclidean plane with some pairs of equally long edges abstractly identified. While this representation is arguably simpler than meshes (flat polygons in R3 forming a surface), it has unbounded happiness: a shortest path in the surface may visit the same polygon arbitrarily many times. This pathological behavior is an obstacle towards efficient algorithms. On the other hand, Löffler, Ophelders, Staals, and Silveira (SoCG 2023) recently proved that the (intrinsic) Delaunay triangulations have bounded happiness.
  In this paper, given a closed polyhedral surface S, represented by a triangular portalgon T, we provide an algorithm to compute the Delaunay triangulation of S whose vertices are the singularities of S (the points whose surrounding angle is distinct from 2pi). The time complexity of our algorithm is polynomial in the number of triangles and in the logarithm of the aspect ratio r of T. Within our model of computation, we show that the dependency in log(r) is unavoidable. Our algorithm can be used to pre-process a triangular portalgon before computing shortest paths on its surface, and to determine whether the surfaces of two triangular portalgons are isometric.

title: CoINS: Counterfactual Interactive Navigation via Skill-Aware VLM
authors: Kangjie Zhou, Zhejia Wen, Zhiyong Zhuo, Zike Yan, Pengying Wu, Ieng Hou U, Shuaiyang Li, Han Gao, Kang Ding, Wenhan Cao, Wei Pan, Chang Liu
abstract: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in robotic planning. However, they typically function as semantic reasoners, lacking an intrinsic understanding of the specific robot's physical capabilities. This limitation is particularly critical in interactive navigation, where robots must actively modify cluttered environments to create traversable paths. Existing VLM-based navigators are predominantly confined to passive obstacle avoidance, failing to reason about when and how to interact with objects to clear blocked paths. To bridge this gap, we propose Counterfactual Interactive Navigation via Skill-aware VLM (CoINS), a hierarchical framework that integrates skill-aware reasoning and robust low-level execution. Specifically, we fine-tune a VLM, named InterNav-VLM, which incorporates skill affordance and concrete constraint parameters into the input context and grounds them into a metric-scale environmental representation. By internalizing the logic of counterfactual reasoning through fine-tuning on the proposed InterNav dataset, the model learns to implicitly evaluate the causal effects of object removal on navigation connectivity, thereby determining interaction necessity and target selection. To execute the generated high-level plans, we develop a comprehensive skill library through reinforcement learning, specifically introducing traversability-oriented strategies to manipulate diverse objects for path clearance. A systematic benchmark in Isaac Sim is proposed to evaluate both the reasoning and execution aspects of interactive navigation. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that CoINS significantly outperforms representative baselines, achieving a 17\% higher overall success rate and over 80\% improvement in complex long-horizon scenarios compared to the best-performing baseline

title: ResTok: Learning Hierarchical Residuals in 1D Visual Tokenizers for Autoregressive Image Generation
authors: Xu Zhang, Cheng Da, Huan Yang, Kun Gai, Ming Lu, Zhan Ma
abstract: Existing 1D visual tokenizers for autoregressive (AR) generation largely follow the design principles of language modeling, as they are built directly upon transformers whose priors originate in language, yielding single-hierarchy latent tokens and treating visual data as flat sequential token streams. However, this language-like formulation overlooks key properties of vision, particularly the hierarchical and residual network designs that have long been essential for convergence and efficiency in visual models. To bring "vision" back to vision, we propose the Residual Tokenizer (ResTok), a 1D visual tokenizer that builds hierarchical residuals for both image tokens and latent tokens. The hierarchical representations obtained through progressively merging enable cross-level feature fusion at each layer, substantially enhancing representational capacity. Meanwhile, the semantic residuals between hierarchies prevent information overlap, yielding more concentrated latent distributions that are easier for AR modeling. Cross-level bindings consequently emerge without any explicit constraints. To accelerate the generation process, we further introduce a hierarchical AR generator that substantially reduces sampling steps by predicting an entire level of latent tokens at once rather than generating them strictly token-by-token. Extensive experiments demonstrate that restoring hierarchical residual priors in visual tokenization significantly improves AR image generation, achieving a gFID of 2.34 on ImageNet-256 with only 9 sampling steps. Code is available at https://github.com/Kwai-Kolors/ResTok.
zh_title: 残差词元：用于自回归图像生成的1D视觉词元化器中的分层残差学习
translation: 现有的用于自回归（AR）生成的1D视觉词元化器在很大程度上遵循语言建模的设计原则，因为它们直接构建在源自语言的Transformer之上，产生单一层次的潜在词元，并将视觉数据视为平坦的顺序词元流。然而，这种类语言的表述忽略了视觉的关键特性，特别是对于视觉模型中的收敛性和效率至关重要的分层和残差网络设计。为了让“视觉”回归视觉，我们提出了残差词元化器（ResTok），一种在图像词元和潜在词元中构建分层残差的1D视觉词元化器。通过逐步合并获得分层表示，可以在每一层实现跨层特征融合，从而大大增强表示能力。同时，层级之间的语义残差可以防止信息重叠，产生更容易被AR建模的更集中的潜在分布。无需任何显式约束即可实现跨层绑定。为了加速生成过程，我们进一步引入了一个分层AR生成器，它通过一次预测一个级别的潜在词元，而不是严格地逐个词元生成，从而大大减少了采样步骤。大量的实验表明，在视觉词元化中恢复分层残差先验可以显著改善AR图像生成，在ImageNet-256上仅用9个采样步骤就达到了2.34的gFID。代码可在https://github.com/Kwai-Kolors/ResTok获取。
tldr: ResTok提出了一种新的1D视觉词元化器，它在图像和潜在表示中引入了分层残差，以改进自回归图像生成。这种方法通过跨层特征融合和语义残差来增强表示能力，并允许在更少的采样步骤内生成高质量图像。
ai_comments: 该研究成功地将视觉领域特有的分层和残差设计引入到1D视觉词元化器中，解决了现有方法过于依赖语言模型范式的局限性。ResTok在提高生成质量和效率方面取得了显著成果，尤其是在减少采样步骤方面，这对于实际应用具有重要意义。其提出的跨层特征融合和语义残差机制是该方法的关键创新点。
motivation: 现有1D视觉词元化器主要借鉴语言模型的Transformer架构，忽略了视觉模型中至关重要的分层和残差网络设计，这阻碍了图像生成的效率和性能。
method: 提出残差词元化器（ResTok），它在图像和潜在表示中构建分层残差。通过逐步合并获得分层表示，实现跨层特征融合。引入分层自回归生成器，一次预测一个级别的潜在词元，以加速生成过程。
results: ResTok在ImageNet-256数据集上实现了2.34的gFID分数，仅需9个采样步骤，显著提高了自回归图像生成的性能。
conclusion: 在视觉词元化中恢复分层残差先验可以显著提高自回归图像生成性能，ResTok在生成效率和图像质量方面均取得了优异成果。

title: Experimental Evaluation of a UAV-Mounted LEO Satellite Backhaul for Emergency Connectivity
authors: Mattia Figaro, Francesco Rossato, Alexander Bonora, Marco Giordani, Giovanni Schembra, Michele Zorzi
abstract: Reliable connectivity is critical for Public Protection and Disaster Relief operations, especially in rural or compromised environments where terrestrial infrastructure is unavailable. In such scenarios, NTNs, and specifically UAVs, are promising candidates to provide on-demand and rapid connectivity on the ground, serving as aerial base stations. In this paper, we implement a setup in which a rotary-wing UAV, equipped with a Starlink Mini terminal, provides Internet connectivity to an emergency ground user in the absence of cellular coverage via LEO satellites. The UAV functions as a Wi-Fi access point, while backhauling the ground traffic through the Starlink constellation. We evaluate the system via both network simulations in ns-3 and real-world flight experiments in a rural environment, in terms of throughput, latency, coverage, and energy consumption under static and dynamic flight conditions. Our results demonstrate that the system can maintain a stable uplink throughput of approximately 30 Mbps up to approximately 200 meters, and with minimal impact on the UAV battery lifetime. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of deploying commercial LEO satellite terminals on UAVs as a practical solution for emergency connectivity.
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures. This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 2026 International Conference on Computing, Networking and Communications (ICNC)
zh_title: 无人机挂载LEO卫星回传链路的紧急连通性实验评估
translation: 在公共保护和灾难救援行动中，可靠的连接至关重要，尤其是在缺乏地面基础设施的农村或受损环境中。在这种情况下，非地面网络（NTN），特别是无人机，是作为空中基站，为地面提供按需和快速连接的有希望的候选者。在本文中，我们实施了一个设置，其中一架配备了Starlink Mini终端的旋翼无人机，在缺乏蜂窝覆盖的情况下，通过LEO卫星星座向紧急地面用户提供互联网连接。无人机充当Wi-Fi接入点，同时通过Starlink星座回传地面流量。我们通过ns-3中的网络模拟和在农村环境中的真实世界飞行实验，从吞吐量、延迟、覆盖范围和静态及动态飞行条件下的能耗等方面对系统进行了评估。我们的结果表明，该系统可以维持大约30 Mbps的稳定上行吞吐量，覆盖距离可达约200米，并且对无人机电池寿命的影响最小。这些发现证明了将商用LEO卫星终端部署在无人机上作为紧急连接的实用解决方案是可行的。
tldr: 研究人员将Starlink Mini装在无人机上，在没有地面网络的情况下，成功地通过无人机作为Wi-Fi热点，利用LEO卫星提供紧急互联网接入，实测在200米内可达30 Mbps上行速率，对电池影响小，证明了这种方案的实用性。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于实际部署了商用LEO卫星终端（Starlink Mini）到无人机上，并进行了真实世界的飞行实验来验证其在紧急通信场景下的可行性。重要性在于为缺乏地面基础设施的灾难救援场景提供了一种快速、按需的替代连接方案。局限性可能在于仅使用了星链Mini终端，其性能和覆盖范围可能与更专业的设备有所不同。
motivation: 在公共保护和灾难救援行动中，尤其是在缺乏地面基础设施的农村或受损环境中，可靠的连接至关重要。NTN（非地面网络），特别是无人机，是提供按需、快速地面连接的有希望的候选者。
method: 通过网络模拟（ns-3）和真实世界飞行实验，评估了配备Starlink Mini终端的旋翼无人机作为Wi-Fi接入点，通过LEO卫星星座回传地面用户流量的系统性能，测试指标包括吞吐量、延迟、覆盖范围和能耗。
results: 系统可以在高达约200米距离内保持约30 Mbps的稳定上行吞吐量，并且对无人机电池寿命的影响很小。
conclusion: 这些发现证明了将商用LEO卫星终端部署在无人机上作为紧急连接的实用解决方案是可行的。

title: On the importance of smoothness, interface resolution and numerical sensitivities in shape and topological sensitivity analysis
authors: M.H. Gfrerer, P. Gangl
abstract: In this paper we investigate the influence of the discretization of PDE constraints on shape and topological derivatives. To this end, we study a tracking-type functional and a two-material Poisson problem in one spatial dimension. We consider the discretization by a standard method and an enriched method. In the standard method we use splines of degree $p$ such that we can control the smoothness of the basis functions easily, but do not take any interface location into consideration. This includes for p=1 the usual hat basis functions. In the enriched method we additionally capture the interface locations in the ansatz space by enrichment functions. For both discretization methods shape and topological sensitivity analysis is performed. It turns out that the regularity of the shape derivative depends on the regularity of the basis functions. Furthermore, for point-wise convergence of the shape derivative the interface has to be considered in the ansatz space. For the topological derivative we show that only the enriched method converges.
zh_title: 论光滑度、界面分辨率和数值敏感性在一维形状和拓扑敏感性分析中的重要性
translation: 在本文中，我们研究了偏微分方程约束的离散化对形状和拓扑导数的影响。为此，我们研究了一维中的一个跟踪型泛函和一个双材料泊松问题。我们考虑了标准方法和富集方法的离散化。在标准方法中，我们使用p阶样条，这样可以轻松控制基函数的平滑度，但不考虑任何界面位置。这包括p=1时常用的“帽子”基函数。在富集方法中，我们还通过富集函数捕获试验空间中的界面位置。对两种离散化方法都进行了形状和拓扑敏感性分析。结果表明，形状导数的正则性取决于基函数的正则性。此外，为了使形状导数点收敛，必须在试验空间中考虑界面。对于拓扑导数，我们证明只有富集方法才能收敛。
tldr: 在形状和拓扑敏感性分析中，数值离散化（特别是界面处理）对导数的准确性和收敛性有显著影响；富集方法（考虑界面）在收敛性上优于标准方法。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于系统地比较了标准方法和富集方法在求解形状和拓扑敏感性分析中对离散化误差的敏感性，并明确指出了界面处理对导数收敛性的关键影响。其重要性在于为使用数值方法进行形状优化提供了关于网格和基函数选择的指导。主要局限性可能在于研究仅限于一维泊松问题。
motivation: 研究离散化偏微分方程约束对形状和拓扑导数的影响。
method: 研究了一个跟踪型泛函和一维双材料泊松问题。比较了使用标准方法（使用光滑度可控的p次样条）和富集方法（在试验空间中通过富集函数捕获界面位置）的离散化。对两种方法都进行了形状和拓扑敏感性分析。
results: 形状导数的正则性取决于基函数的正则性；点收敛要求在试验空间中考虑界面；只有富集方法能使拓扑导数收敛。
conclusion: 形状导数的正则性取决于基函数的正则性，并且为了使形状导数实现点收敛，必须在试验空间中考虑界面。对于拓扑导数，只有富集方法才能收敛。

title: FUSION: Full-Body Unified Motion Prior for Body and Hands via Diffusion
authors: Enes Duran, Nikos Athanasiou, Muhammed Kocabas, Michael J. Black, Omid Taheri
abstract: Hands are central to interacting with our surroundings and conveying gestures, making their inclusion essential for full-body motion synthesis. Despite this, existing human motion synthesis methods fall short: some ignore hand motions entirely, while others generate full-body motions only for narrowly scoped tasks under highly constrained settings. A key obstacle is the lack of large-scale datasets that jointly capture diverse full-body motion with detailed hand articulation. While some datasets capture both, they are limited in scale and diversity. Conversely, large-scale datasets typically focus either on body motion without hands or on hand motions without the body. To overcome this, we curate and unify existing hand motion datasets with large-scale body motion data to generate full-body sequences that capture both hand and body. We then propose the first diffusion-based unconditional full-body motion prior, FUSION, which jointly models body and hand motion. Despite using a pose-based motion representation, FUSION surpasses state-of-the-art skeletal control models on the Keypoint Tracking task in the HumanML3D dataset and achieves superior motion naturalness. Beyond standard benchmarks, we demonstrate that FUSION can go beyond typical uses of motion priors through two applications: (1) generating detailed full-body motion including fingers during interaction given the motion of an object, and (2) generating Self-Interaction motions using an LLM to transform natural language cues into actionable motion constraints. For these applications, we develop an optimization pipeline that refines the latent space of our diffusion model to generate task-specific motions. Experiments on these tasks highlight precise control over hand motion while maintaining plausible full-body coordination. The code will be public.
zh_title: FUSION：全身统一运动先验，通过扩散实现身体与手的运动
translation: 手部是我们与周围环境互动和传达手势的核心，因此，在全身运动合成中包含手部至关重要。尽管如此，现有的人体运动合成方法仍显不足：一些方法完全忽略手部运动，而另一些方法仅在高度受限场景下的狭窄任务中生成全身运动。一个关键障碍是缺乏能够联合捕获多样化的全身运动和详细手部关节的数据集。虽然一些数据集同时捕获了这两者，但它们的规模和多样性有限。相反，大规模数据集通常只关注不带手部的身体运动，或不带身体的手部运动。为了克服这一挑战，我们整理并整合了现有的手部运动数据集与大规模身体运动数据，以生成能够同时捕获手部和身体的全身运动序列。然后，我们提出了第一个基于扩散的无条件全身运动先验，FUSION，它联合建模了身体和手部运动。尽管使用了基于姿态的运动表示，FUSION在HumanML3D数据集的关键点跟踪任务上超越了最先进的骨骼控制模型，并实现了卓越的运动自然度。除了标准的基准测试，我们还展示了FUSION如何通过两个应用超越运动先验的典型用途：（1）在给定物体运动的情况下，生成包含手指细节的全身交互运动；（2）利用LLM将自然语言线索转化为可行的运动约束，生成自我交互运动。对于这些应用，我们开发了一个优化流程，用于细化我们扩散模型的潜在空间，以生成特定任务的运动。这些任务的实验突出了对手部运动的精确控制，同时保持了合理的全身协调性。代码将公开。
tldr: 该论文提出了FUSION，一个首个基于扩散的无条件全身运动先验模型，能够同时生成详细的手部和身体运动。它通过整合现有的手部和身体运动数据集来克服数据限制，并在关键点跟踪任务上超越了现有技术。FUSION还通过物体交互和自我交互应用展示了其生成特定任务运动的能力。
ai_comments: 该研究在人体运动合成领域取得了重要进展，特别是在手部运动的精细化和全身协调方面。利用扩散模型处理高维、复杂的运动数据是一个有前景的方向。代码的公开将有助于该领域的进一步研究和应用。
motivation: 现有的人体运动合成方法在处理包含手部细节的全身运动时存在不足，要么忽略手部，要么仅限于狭窄的、受限的场景。缺乏大规模、多样化的联合手部和身体运动数据集是一个关键障碍。
method: 该研究整合了现有的手部运动数据集和大规模身体运动数据，创建了一个统一的数据集。在此基础上，提出了FUSION，一个基于扩散的无条件全身运动先验模型，能够同时对身体和手部运动进行建模。研究还开发了一个优化流程，用于细化扩散模型的潜在空间，以生成特定任务的运动。
results: FUSION在HumanML3D数据集的关键点跟踪任务上超越了最先进的骨骼控制模型，并实现了更自然的运动。在物体交互和自我交互等应用中，FUSION能够生成包含手指细节的全身运动，并精确控制手部运动，同时保持合理的全身协调性。
conclusion: FUSION是第一个能够同时生成详细手部和身体运动的全身运动先验模型，克服了现有方法的局限性，并在多个任务和应用中展示了其优越性和灵活性。

title: Anti-Length Shift: Dynamic Outlier Truncation for Training Efficient Reasoning Models
authors: Wei Wu, Liyi Chen, Congxi Xiao, Tianfu Wang, Qimeng Wang, Chengqiang Lu, Yan Gao, Yi Wu, Yao Hu, Hui Xiong
abstract: Large reasoning models enhanced by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards have achieved significant performance gains by extending their chain-of-thought. However, this paradigm incurs substantial deployment costs as models often exhibit excessive verbosity on simple queries. Existing efficient reasoning methods relying on explicit length penalties often introduce optimization conflicts and leave the generative mechanisms driving overthinking largely unexamined. In this paper, we identify a phenomenon termed length shift where models increasingly generate unnecessary reasoning on trivial inputs during training. To address this, we introduce Dynamic Outlier Truncation (DOT), a training-time intervention that selectively suppresses redundant tokens. This method targets only the extreme tail of response lengths within fully correct rollout groups while preserving long-horizon reasoning capabilities for complex problems. To complement this intervention and ensure stable convergence, we further incorporate auxiliary KL regularization and predictive dynamic sampling. Experimental results across multiple model scales demonstrate that our approach significantly pushes the efficiency-performance Pareto frontier outward. Notably, on the AIME-24, our method reduces inference token usage by 78% while simultaneously increasing accuracy compared to the initial policy and surpassing state-of-the-art efficient reasoning methods.
zh_title: 反长度偏移：用于训练高效推理模型的动态异常值截断
translation: 通过可验证奖励强化的深度推理模型在扩展其思维链方面取得了显著的性能提升。然而，这种范式带来了巨大的部署成本，因为模型在简单查询上往往表现出过度的冗长。现有的依赖于显式长度惩罚的高效推理方法会引入优化冲突，并且对驱动过度思考的生成机制考察不足。在本文中，我们识别出一种被称为长度偏移的现象，即模型在训练过程中对琐碎的输入生成不必要的推理。为解决此问题，我们引入了动态异常值截断（DOT），这是一种训练时干预手段，用于选择性地抑制冗余的Token。该方法仅针对完全正确推理组中响应长度的极端尾部，同时为复杂问题保留了长程推理能力。为了补充这种干预并确保稳定的收敛，我们进一步结合了辅助KL正则化和预测性动态采样。跨多个模型规模的实验结果表明，我们的方法显著地将效率-性能帕累托前沿向外推移。特别是在AIME-24上，我们的方法与初始策略相比，推理Token使用量减少了78%，同时准确率有所提高，并超越了最先进的高效推理方法。
tldr: 该研究发现大型推理模型在训练中会因简单输入而产生不必要的冗长推理（长度偏移），引入了动态异常值截断（DOT）技术，在训练时仅修剪完全正确推理中的极端冗长输出，成功在推理效率和准确性之间取得了显著的改进，尤其在AIME-24上Token使用量减少78%且性能提升。
ai_comments: 该方法创新性地提出了“长度偏移”现象，并设计了动态异常值截断（DOT）来解决训练过程中模型在简单问题上的过度冗长问题。其优势在于仅针对完全正确的推理中极长响应进行抑制，保留了复杂问题的长程推理能力，并在效率和性能之间取得了显著的帕累托前沿改进。局限性可能在于“极端尾部”的选择标准是否鲁棒。
motivation: 通过可验证奖励的强化学习增强的大型推理模型在扩展思维链（chain-of-thought）时性能显著提升，但这带来了高昂的部署成本，因为模型在简单查询上往往过于冗长。现有的显式长度惩罚方法引入了优化冲突，且未考察驱动过度思考的生成机制。
method: 我们引入了动态异常值截断（DOT）作为一种训练时干预手段，选择性地抑制冗余Token。该方法仅针对完全正确推理组中响应长度的极端尾部进行处理，同时保留复杂问题的长程推理能力。此外，我们还结合了辅助KL正则化和预测性动态采样以确保稳定的收敛。
results: 实验结果表明，我们的方法在多个模型规模上显著地将效率-性能帕累托前沿推向外。在AIME-24上，我们的方法相较于初始策略，推理Token使用量减少了78%，同时准确率有所提高，并超越了现有最高效的推理方法。
conclusion: 我们的方法显著地将效率-性能帕累托前沿向外推移。在AIME-24上，我们的方法在推理时减少了78%的Token使用量，同时相对于初始策略提高了准确率，并超越了最先进的高效推理方法。

title: Muse: Towards Reproducible Long-Form Song Generation with Fine-Grained Style Control
authors: Changhao Jiang, Jiahao Chen, Zhenghao Xiang, Zhixiong Yang, Hanchen Wang, Jiabao Zhuang, Xinmeng Che, Jiajun Sun, Hui Li, Yifei Cao, Shihan Dou, Ming Zhang, Junjie Ye, Tao Ji, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
abstract: Recent commercial systems such as Suno demonstrate strong capabilities in long-form song generation, while academic research remains largely non-reproducible due to the lack of publicly available training data, hindering fair comparison and progress. To this end, we release a fully open-source system for long-form song generation with fine-grained style conditioning, including a licensed synthetic dataset, training and evaluation pipelines, and Muse, an easy-to-deploy song generation model. The dataset consists of 116k fully licensed synthetic songs with automatically generated lyrics and style descriptions paired with audio synthesized by SunoV5. We train Muse via single-stage supervised finetuning of a Qwen-based language model extended with discrete audio tokens using MuCodec, without task-specific losses, auxiliary objectives, or additional architectural components. Our evaluations find that although Muse is trained with a modest data scale and model size, it achieves competitive performance on phoneme error rate, text--music style similarity, and audio aesthetic quality, while enabling controllable segment-level generation across different musical structures. All data, model weights, and training and evaluation pipelines will be publicly released, paving the way for continued progress in controllable long-form song generation research. The project repository is available at https://github.com/yuhui1038/Muse.
zh_title: Muse：迈向具有细粒度风格控制的可复现长篇歌曲生成
translation: 最近的商业系统如Suno展示了在长篇歌曲生成方面的强大能力，而学术研究由于缺乏公开可用的训练数据，在很大程度上仍然是不可复现的，阻碍了公平比较和进步。为此，我们发布了一个完全开源的长篇歌曲生成系统，具有细粒度的风格条件控制，包括一个授权的合成数据集、训练和评估流程，以及一个易于部署的歌曲生成模型Muse。该数据集包含116k首完全授权的合成歌曲，其中自动生成的歌词和风格描述与通过SunoV5合成的音频配对。我们通过对一个基于Qwen的语言模型进行单阶段监督微调来训练Muse，该模型通过MuCodec扩展了离散音频Token，没有使用任务特定的损失函数、辅助目标或额外的架构组件。我们的评估发现，尽管Muse使用适度的训练数据规模和模型尺寸进行训练，它在音素错误率、文本-音乐风格相似度以及音频美学质量方面均取得了有竞争力的性能，同时能够实现跨不同音乐结构的分段级可控生成。所有数据、模型权重以及训练和评估流程都将公开，为可控长篇歌曲生成研究的持续进步铺平道路。项目仓库位于https://github.com/yuhui1038/Muse。
tldr: 为解决学术界长篇歌曲生成研究的复现性难题，研究人员发布了Muse：一个完全开源的、基于单阶段微调Qwen模型的长篇歌曲生成系统，它使用合成数据集进行训练，并在风格控制和性能上达到了有竞争力的水平，所有组件均将公开。
ai_comments: 该研究的重要创新点在于发布了一个完全开源的、可复现的长篇歌曲生成系统，解决了学术界在这一领域缺乏公开数据的难题。它通过单阶段微调一个扩展了离散音频Token的语言模型来实现，避免了复杂的结构或额外的损失函数，展示了在有限数据规模下仍能达到有竞争力的性能，特别是在细粒度风格控制方面。其局限性可能在于依赖商业系统SunoV5生成的合成数据。
motivation: 现有的商业系统在长篇歌曲生成方面表现出色，但学术研究由于缺乏公开可用的训练数据，导致结果难以复现，阻碍了公平比较和研究进展。因此，研究动机是创建一个完全开源、可复现的长篇歌曲生成系统，并具备细粒度的风格控制能力。
method: 采用单阶段监督微调（supervised finetuning）的方式，对一个基于Qwen的语言模型进行扩展，该模型集成了通过MuCodec获得的离散音频Token，且没有采用任务特定的损失函数、辅助目标或额外的架构组件。使用一个包含116k首完全授权的合成歌曲（带有自动生成的歌词和风格描述，以及SunoV5合成的音频）的许可证数据集进行训练。
results: Muse模型在音素错误率（phoneme error rate）、文本-音乐风格相似度（text--music style similarity）和音频美学质量（audio aesthetic quality）方面取得了具有竞争力的性能。它还实现了对不同音乐结构的分段级生成控制。
conclusion: 通过公开发布数据、模型权重和训练评估流程，Muse系统为可控长篇歌曲生成的研究铺平了道路，实现了在合理数据规模和模型大小下，在关键指标上达到有竞争力的性能，并支持跨不同音乐结构的分段级控制。

title: On-Device Deep Reinforcement Learning for Decentralized Task Offloading Performance trade-offs in the training process
authors: Gorka Nieto, Idoia de la Iglesia, Cristina Perfecto, Unai Lopez-Novoa
abstract: Allowing less capable devices to offload computational tasks to more powerful devices or servers enables the development of new applications that may not run correctly on the device itself. Deciding where and why to run each of those applications is a complex task. Therefore, different approaches have been adopted to make offloading decisions. In this work, we propose a decentralized Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) agent to address the selection of computing locations. Unlike most existing work, we analyze it in a real testbed composed of various edge devices running the agent to determine where to execute each task. These devices are connected to a Multi-Access Edge Computing (MEC) server and a Cloud server through 5G communications. We evaluate not only the agent's performance in meeting task requirements but also the implications of running this type of agent locally, assessing the trade-offs of training locally versus remotely in terms of latency and energy consumption.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Cognitive Communications and Networking
zh_title: 关于在设备上进行深度强化学习以进行去中心化任务卸载的性能权衡训练过程的研究
translation: 允许能力较弱的设备将计算任务卸载到更强大的设备或服务器，可以开发出在设备本身上无法正确运行的新应用程序。决定在哪里以及为何运行这些应用程序中的每一个都是一项复杂的任务。因此，已经采用了不同的方法来做出卸载决策。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种去中心化的深度强化学习（DRL）代理来解决计算位置的选择问题。与大多数现有工作不同，我们在由运行代理的各种边缘设备组成的真实测试环境中对其进行了分析，以确定在哪里执行每个任务。这些设备通过5G通信连接到多接入边缘计算（MEC）服务器和云服务器。我们不仅评估了代理在满足任务需求方面的性能，还评估了在本地运行此类代理的含义，评估了在延迟和能源消耗方面在本地训练与远程训练的权衡。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种去中心化的深度强化学习（DRL）代理，用于在边缘设备上进行任务卸载决策，并分析了在设备上本地训练的性能权衡。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于，它不仅提出了一个用于去中心化任务卸载的DRL方法，而且在真实的测试环境中进行了部署和评估，并深入分析了在设备上本地训练的权衡。这为在资源受限的设备上实现智能任务卸载提供了实际的指导。然而，该研究可能没有详细说明DRL代理的具体网络结构和训练参数，以及在更大规模或更复杂的网络拓扑下的扩展性。
motivation: 为了使计算能力较弱的设备能够卸载计算任务，从而支持更复杂的应用程序，需要一个有效的任务卸载决策机制。现有的方法在实际应用中面临挑战，因此需要新的方法来处理这一复杂任务。
method: 提出了一种去中心化的深度强化学习（DRL）代理，用于在由多台边缘设备组成的真实测试环境中进行任务卸载决策。该测试环境通过5G通信连接到MEC服务器和云服务器。对代理在满足任务需求方面的性能进行了评估，并分析了在设备上本地训练与远程训练在延迟和能耗方面的权衡。
results: 该研究评估了DRL代理在满足任务需求方面的性能，并量化了在设备上本地训练与远程训练在延迟和能耗方面的权衡。
conclusion: 在设备上进行深度强化学习可以有效地用于去中心化任务卸载决策，但需要在训练过程中的性能（如延迟和能耗）与本地执行能力之间进行权衡。

title: Posterior error bounds for prior-driven balancing in linear Gaussian inverse problems
authors: Josie König, Han Cheng Lie
abstract: In large-scale Bayesian inverse problems, it is often necessary to apply approximate forward models to reduce the cost of forward model evaluations, while controlling approximation quality. In the context of Bayesian inverse problems with linear forward models, Gaussian priors, and Gaussian noise, we use perturbation theory for inverses to bound the error in the approximate posterior mean and posterior covariance resulting from a linear approximate forward model. We then focus on the smoothing problem of inferring the initial condition of linear time-invariant dynamical systems, using finitely many partial state observations. For such problems, and for a specific model order reduction method based on balanced truncation, we show that the impulse response of a certain prior-driven system is closely related to the prior-preconditioned Hessian of the inverse problem. This reveals a novel connection between systems theory and inverse problems. We exploit this connection to prove the first a priori error bounds for system-theoretic model order reduction methods applied to smoothing problems. The bounds control the approximation error of the posterior mean and covariance in terms of the truncated Hankel singular values of the underlying system.
zh_title: 线性高斯逆问题中先验驱动平衡的后验误差界限
translation: 在大型贝叶斯逆问题中，通常需要应用近似前向模型以降低前向模型评估的成本，同时控制近似质量。在具有线性前向模型、高斯先验和高斯噪声的贝叶斯逆问题的背景下，我们使用逆问题的扰动理论来界定由线性近似前向模型导致的近似后验均值和后验协方差的误差。然后，我们重点关注利用有限次部分状态观测值来推断线性时不变动力系统初始条件的平滑问题。对于此类问题，以及对于基于平衡截断的特定模型降阶方法，我们证明了某个先验驱动系统的脉冲响应与逆问题的先验预处理Hessian密切相关。这揭示了系统理论与逆问题之间的新颖联系。我们利用这种联系，证明了系统理论模型降阶方法应用于平滑问题的第一个先验误差界限。这些界限根据底层系统的截断汉克尔奇异值来控制后验均值和协方差的近似误差。
tldr: 对于带线性高斯模型的逆问题，使用扰动理论推导了近似模型带来的后验误差界限，特别是针对基于平衡截断的模型降阶方法，证明了其误差可由系统本身的奇异值控制，连接了系统理论与逆问题。
ai_comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于将系统理论中的平衡截断方法与逆问题中的先验信息相结合，并首次为基于系统理论的模型降阶方法在平滑问题中提供了先验误差界限。其局限性在于仅限于线性高斯逆问题。
motivation: 在大规模贝叶斯逆问题中，为了降低前向模型评估的成本，通常需要应用近似前向模型，同时需要控制近似质量。
method: 使用扰动理论来界定由线性近似前向模型导致的近似后验均值和协方差的误差，并利用系统理论中的平衡截断方法，证明了特定先验驱动系统的脉冲响应与逆问题的先验预处理Hessian之间的联系。
results: 证明了用于平滑问题的系统理论模型降阶方法（基于平衡截断）的第一个先验误差界限，这些界限根据底层系统的截断汉克尔奇异值来控制后验均值和协方差的近似误差。

title: Unique Decoding of Hyperderivative Reed-Solomon Codes
authors: Haojie Gu, Jun Zhang
abstract: Error-correcting codes are combinatorial objects designed to cope with the problem of reliable transmission of information on a noisy channel. A fundamental problem in coding theory and practice is to efficiently decode the received word with errors to obtain the transmitted codeword. In this paper, we consider the decoding problem of Hyperderivative Reed-Solomon (HRS) codes with respect to the NRT metric. Specifically, we propose a Welch-Berlekamp algorithm for the unique decoding of NRT HRS codes.

title: Stage-specific cancer survival prediction enriched by explainable machine learning
authors: Parisa Poorhasani, Bogdan Iancu
abstract: Despite the fact that cancer survivability rates vary greatly between stages, traditional survival prediction models have frequently been trained and assessed using examples from all combined phases of the disease. This method may result in an overestimation of performance and ignore the stage-specific variations. Using the SEER dataset, we created and verified explainable machine learning (ML) models to predict stage-specific cancer survivability in colorectal, stomach, and liver cancers. ML-based cancer survival analysis has been a long-standing topic in the literature; however, studies involving the explainability and transparency of ML survivability models are limited. Our use of explainability techniques, including SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME), enabled us to illustrate significant feature-cancer stage interactions that would have remained hidden in traditional black-box models. We identified how certain demographic and clinical variables influenced survival differently across cancer stages and types. These insights provide not only transparency but also clinical relevance, supporting personalized treatment planning. By focusing on stage-specific models, this study provides new insights into the most important factors at each stage of cancer, offering transparency and potential clinical relevance to support personalized treatment planning.
zh_title: 分阶段癌症生存率预测与可解释机器学习的增强
translation: 尽管癌症的生存率在不同阶段之间存在巨大差异，但传统的生存预测模型通常使用来自疾病所有合并阶段的样本进行训练和评估。这种方法可能导致性能被高估，并忽略了阶段特异性的变化。我们使用SEER数据集，创建并验证了可解释的机器学习（ML）模型，用于预测结直肠癌、胃癌和肝癌的分阶段癌症生存率。基于ML的癌症生存分析是文献中一个长期存在的主题，然而，涉及ML可生性模型的可解释性和透明度的研究是有限的。我们使用包括SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) 和 Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) 在内的可解释性技术，使我们能够说明在传统黑箱模型中可能被隐藏的重要特征-癌症阶段交互作用。我们确定了某些人口统计学和临床变量如何在不同癌症阶段和类型中以不同的方式影响生存率。这些见解不仅提供了透明度，还具有临床相关性，支持个性化治疗计划。通过关注分阶段模型，本研究为每个癌症阶段最重要的因素提供了新的见解，为支持个性化治疗计划提供了透明度和潜在的临床相关性。
tldr: 传统癌症生存模型忽略了阶段差异，本研究使用可解释ML（SHAP/LIME）对结直肠癌、胃癌和肝癌进行分阶段生存预测，揭示了不同阶段的关键影响因素，增强了模型透明度和临床指导价值。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于结合了分阶段的生存率预测和可解释的机器学习（ML）技术（如SHAP和LIME），以揭示不同癌症阶段中影响生存率的关键特征交互作用，这超越了传统黑箱模型的局限性。其重要性在于为个性化治疗方案提供了透明且具有临床意义的见解。局限性未在摘要中明确提及。
motivation: 传统生存预测模型常使用所有疾病阶段的样本进行训练和评估，这可能导致性能被高估，并忽略了疾病阶段间的特异性差异。同时，现有研究中涉及ML可解释性和透明度的研究有限。
method: 使用SEER数据集，创建并验证了用于预测结直肠癌、胃癌和肝癌分阶段癌症生存率的可解释机器学习（ML）模型，并采用了SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) 和 Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) 等可解释性技术。
results: 我们成功地利用可解释性技术说明了重要的特征-癌症阶段交互作用，并识别出某些人口统计学和临床变量在不同癌症阶段和类型中影响生存率的方式有所不同。
conclusion: 通过关注分阶段模型，本研究为每个癌症阶段最重要的因素提供了新的见解，为支持个性化治疗计划提供了透明度和潜在的临床相关性。

title: RADAR: Retrieval-Augmented Detector with Adversarial Refinement for Robust Fake News Detection
authors: Song-Duo Ma, Yi-Hung Liu, Hsin-Yu Lin, Pin-Yu Chen, Hong-Yan Huang, Shau-Yung Hsu, Yun-Nung Chen
abstract: To efficiently combat the spread of LLM-generated misinformation, we present RADAR, a retrieval-augmented detector with adversarial refinement for robust fake news detection. Our approach employs a generator that rewrites real articles with factual perturbations, paired with a lightweight detector that verifies claims using dense passage retrieval. To enable effective co-evolution, we introduce verbal adversarial feedback (VAF). Rather than relying on scalar rewards, VAF issues structured natural-language critiques; these guide the generator toward more sophisticated evasion attempts, compelling the detector to adapt and improve. On a fake news detection benchmark, RADAR achieves 86.98% ROC-AUC, significantly outperforming general-purpose LLMs with retrieval. Ablation studies confirm that detector-side retrieval yields the largest gains, while VAF and few-shot demonstrations provide critical signals for robust training.
zh_title: RADAR：用于鲁棒虚假新闻检测的带有对抗性精炼的检索增强检测器
translation: 为了有效对抗LLM生成的错误信息传播，我们提出了RADAR，一种用于鲁棒虚假新闻检测的检索增强检测器，带有对抗性精炼。我们的方法采用一个生成器，用事实扰动重写真实文章，并配有一个轻量级检测器，该检测器使用密集段落检索来验证声明。为了实现有效的协同演化，我们引入了口头对抗性反馈（VAF）。VAF不依赖于标量奖励，而是发出结构化的自然语言批评；这些批评指导生成器进行更复杂的逃避尝试，迫使检测器适应和改进。在虚假新闻检测基准测试中，RADAR取得了86.98%的ROC-AUC，显著优于带有检索功能的通用LLM。消融研究证实，检测器侧的检索带来了最大的增益，而VAF和少样本演示为鲁棒训练提供了关键信号。
tldr: RADAR是一种新的虚假新闻检测系统，它使用一个生成器来创建难以检测的虚假文本，并通过一种称为VAF的新型自然语言反馈机制来训练一个基于检索的检测器，使其对LLM生成的内容更加健壮和准确。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于引入了“口头对抗性反馈”（VAF）机制，它使用结构化的自然语言批评而非标量奖励来指导生成器，从而推动检测器进行更鲁棒的训练。其重要性在于为应对大规模、快速演变的LLM生成虚假信息提供了更强大的检测框架。限制在于摘要中未详细说明VAF的具体结构和实施细节。
motivation: 为了有效对抗大型语言模型（LLM）生成的错误信息（虚假新闻）的传播。
method: RADAR采用一个生成器，用事实扰动重写真实文章，并配有一个轻量级检测器，该检测器使用密集段落检索来验证声明。核心是引入了口头对抗性反馈（VAF），它提供结构化的自然语言批评来指导生成器进行更复杂的逃避尝试，从而训练检测器。
results: 在虚假新闻检测基准测试中，RADAR取得了86.98%的ROC-AUC，显著优于使用检索功能的通用LLM。消融研究证实，检测器侧的检索带来了最大的性能提升，而VAF和少样本演示为鲁棒训练提供了关键信号。
conclusion: 摘要中未明确给出结论，但结果表明RADAR在基准测试中表现出色，并强调了检索和VAF对鲁棒训练的关键作用。

title: SoK: Privacy Risks and Mitigations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
authors: Andreea-Elena Bodea, Stephen Meisenbacher, Alexandra Klymenko, Florian Matthes
abstract: The continued promise of Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly in their natural language understanding and generation capabilities, has driven a rapidly increasing interest in identifying and developing LLM use cases. In an effort to complement the ingrained "knowledge" of LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques have become widely popular. At its core, RAG involves the coupling of LLMs with domain-specific knowledge bases, whereby the generation of a response to a user question is augmented with contextual and up-to-date information. The proliferation of RAG has sparked concerns about data privacy, particularly with the inherent risks that arise when leveraging databases with potentially sensitive information. Numerous recent works have explored various aspects of privacy risks in RAG systems, from adversarial attacks to proposed mitigations. With the goal of surveying and unifying these works, we ask one simple question: What are the privacy risks in RAG, and how can they be measured and mitigated? To answer this question, we conduct a systematic literature review of RAG works addressing privacy, and we systematize our findings into a comprehensive set of privacy risks, mitigation techniques, and evaluation strategies. We supplement these findings with two primary artifacts: a Taxonomy of RAG Privacy Risks and a RAG Privacy Process Diagram. Our work contributes to the study of privacy in RAG not only by conducting the first systematization of risks and mitigations, but also by uncovering important considerations when mitigating privacy risks in RAG systems and assessing the current maturity of proposed mitigations.
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. This work has been accepted for publication at the IEEE Conference on Secure and Trustworthy Machine Learning (SaTML 2026). The final version will be available on IEEE Xplore
zh_title: SoK：检索增强生成系统中的隐私风险与缓解措施
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）持续的潜力，特别是其自然语言理解和生成能力，推动了识别和开发LLM用例的日益增长的兴趣。为了补充LLMs固有的“知识”，检索增强生成（RAG）技术已变得非常流行。其核心在于将LLMs与特定领域的知识库相结合，从而用上下文和最新的信息来增强对用户问题的响应生成。RAG的扩散引发了对数据隐私的担忧，特别是当利用包含潜在敏感信息的数据库时所产生的固有风险。最近的许多工作已经探索了RAG系统中各种方面的隐私风险，从对抗性攻击到提出的缓解措施。为了调查和统一这些工作，我们提出了一个简单的问题：RAG中的隐私风险是什么，如何衡量和缓解它们？为了回答这个问题，我们对解决隐私问题的RAG工作进行了系统的文献回顾，并将我们的发现系统化为一套全面的隐私风险、缓解技术和评估策略。我们用两个主要的人工制品补充了这些发现：一个RAG隐私风险分类法和一个RAG隐私流程图。我们的工作不仅通过对风险和缓解措施进行首次系统化，而且通过揭示在RAG系统中缓解隐私风险时的重要考虑因素和评估现有缓解措施的成熟度，为RAG隐私研究做出了贡献。
tldr: 这篇综述论文调查了流行的RAG系统中存在的隐私风险，系统地分类了这些风险、已提出的缓解方法和评估策略，并创建了分类法和流程图来帮助理解和解决RAG的隐私问题。
ai_comments: 这项工作的重要性在于首次对检索增强生成（RAG）系统中隐私风险、缓解措施和评估策略进行了系统性的梳理和统一，并提出了隐私风险分类法和流程图，有助于未来该领域的研究和实践。其创新点在于系统化的综述方法和产出的两个核心构件。局限性在于，它是对现有工作的综述，可能未涵盖所有新兴的或尚未发表的隐私风险。
motivation: 鉴于大型语言模型（LLMs）的普及以及检索增强生成（RAG）技术结合领域知识库的广泛应用，引发了对数据隐私的担忧，特别是当利用包含敏感信息的数据库时。因此，需要对现有关于RAG隐私风险的研究进行系统性的调查和统一。
method: 系统文献回顾（Systematic Literature Review），以回答“RAG中的隐私风险是什么，如何衡量和缓解它们”的问题，并辅以构建“RAG隐私风险分类法”和“RAG隐私流程图”两个主要产物。
results: 系统性地整理了RAG系统中的隐私风险、缓解技术和评估策略，并创建了“RAG隐私风险分类法”和“RAG隐私流程图”，揭示了在缓解RAG隐私风险时的重要考虑因素以及现有缓解措施的成熟度。
conclusion: 该研究通过系统回顾了现有关于RAG隐私问题的文献，系统地总结了隐私风险、缓解技术和评估策略，并提出了RAG隐私风险分类法和流程图，为评估和缓解RAG系统中的隐私风险提供了重要的参考框架。

title: Benchmark^2: Systematic Evaluation of LLM Benchmarks
authors: Qi Qian, Chengsong Huang, Jingwen Xu, Changze Lv, Muling Wu, Wenhao Liu, Xiaohua Wang, Zhenghua Wang, Zisu Huang, Muzhao Tian, Jianhan Xu, Kun Hu, He-Da Wang, Yao Hu, Xuanjing Huang, Xiaoqing Zheng
abstract: The rapid proliferation of benchmarks for evaluating large language models (LLMs) has created an urgent need for systematic methods to assess benchmark quality itself. We propose Benchmark^2, a comprehensive framework comprising three complementary metrics: (1) Cross-Benchmark Ranking Consistency, measuring whether a benchmark produces model rankings aligned with peer benchmarks; (2) Discriminability Score, quantifying a benchmark's ability to differentiate between models; and (3) Capability Alignment Deviation, identifying problematic instances where stronger models fail but weaker models succeed within the same model family. We conduct extensive experiments across 15 benchmarks spanning mathematics, reasoning, and knowledge domains, evaluating 11 LLMs across four model families. Our analysis reveals significant quality variations among existing benchmarks and demonstrates that selective benchmark construction based on our metrics can achieve comparable evaluation performance with substantially reduced test sets.

title: Using Small Language Models to Reverse-Engineer Machine Learning Pipelines Structures
authors: Nicolas Lacroix, Mireille Blay-Fornarino, Sébastien Mosser, Frederic Precioso
abstract:
Background: Extracting the stages that structure Machine Learning (ML) pipelines from source code is key for gaining a deeper understanding of data science practices. However, the diversity caused by the constant evolution of the ML ecosystem (e.g., algorithms, libraries, datasets) makes this task challenging. Existing approaches either depend on non-scalable, manual labeling, or on ML classifiers that do not properly support the diversity of the domain. These limitations highlight the need for more flexible and reliable solutions.
  Objective: We evaluate whether Small Language Models (SLMs) can leverage their code understanding and classification abilities to address these limitations, and subsequently how they can advance our understanding of data science practices.
  Method: We conduct a confirmatory study based on two reference works selected for their relevance regarding current state-of-the-art's limitations. First, we compare several SLMs using Cochran's Q test. The best-performing model is then evaluated against the reference studies using two distinct McNemar's tests. We further analyze how variations in taxonomy definitions affect performance through an additional Cochran's Q test. Finally, a goodness-of-fit analysis is conducted using Pearson's chi-squared tests to compare our insights on data science practices with those from prior studies.

title: A Scheduling Framework for Efficient MoE Inference on Edge GPU-NDP Systems
authors: Qi Wu, Chao Fang, Jiayuan Chen, Ye Lin, Yueqi Zhang, Yichuan Bai, Yuan Du, Li Du
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models facilitate edge deployment by decoupling model capacity from active computation, yet their large memory footprint drives the need for GPU systems with near-data processing (NDP) capabilities that offload experts to dedicated processing units. However, deploying MoE models on such edge-based GPU-NDP systems faces three critical challenges: 1) severe load imbalance across NDP units due to non-uniform expert selection and expert parallelism, 2) insufficient GPU utilization during expert computation within NDP units, and 3) extensive data pre-profiling necessitated by unpredictable expert activation patterns for pre-fetching. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an efficient inference framework featuring three key optimizations. First, the underexplored tensor parallelism in MoE inference is exploited to partition and compute large expert parameters across multiple NDP units simultaneously towards edge low-batch scenarios. Second, a load-balancing-aware scheduling algorithm distributes expert computations across NDP units and GPU to maximize resource utilization. Third, a dataset-free pre-fetching strategy proactively loads frequently accessed experts to minimize activation delays. Experimental results show that our framework enables GPU-NDP systems to achieve 2.41x on average and up to 2.56x speedup in end-to-end latency compared to state-of-the-art approaches, significantly enhancing MoE inference efficiency in resource-constrained environments.

title: PosterVerse: A Full-Workflow Framework for Commercial-Grade Poster Generation with HTML-Based Scalable Typography
authors: Junle Liu, Peirong Zhang, Yuyi Zhang, Pengyu Yan, Hui Zhou, Xinyue Zhou, Fengjun Guo, Lianwen Jin
abstract: Commercial-grade poster design demands the seamless integration of aesthetic appeal with precise, informative content delivery. Current automated poster generation systems face significant limitations, including incomplete design workflows, poor text rendering accuracy, and insufficient flexibility for commercial applications. To address these challenges, we propose PosterVerse, a full-workflow, commercial-grade poster generation method that seamlessly automates the entire design process while delivering high-density and scalable text rendering. PosterVerse replicates professional design through three key stages: (1) blueprint creation using fine-tuned LLMs to extract key design elements from user requirements, (2) graphical background generation via customized diffusion models to create visually appealing imagery, and (3) unified layout-text rendering with an MLLM-powered HTML engine to guarantee high text accuracy and flexible customization. In addition, we introduce PosterDNA, a commercial-grade, HTML-based dataset tailored for training and validating poster design models. To the best of our knowledge, PosterDNA is the first Chinese poster generation dataset to introduce HTML typography files, enabling scalable text rendering and fundamentally solving the challenges of rendering small and high-density text. Experimental results demonstrate that PosterVerse consistently produces commercial-grade posters with appealing visuals, accurate text alignment, and customizable layouts, making it a promising solution for automating commercial poster design. The code and model are available at https://github.com/wuhaer/PosterVerse.

title: An Ontology-Based Approach to Security Risk Identification of Container Deployments in OT Contexts
authors: Yannick Landeck, Dian Balta, Martin Wimmer, Christian Knierim
abstract: In operational technology (OT) contexts, containerised applications often require elevated privileges to access low-level network interfaces or perform administrative tasks such as application monitoring. These privileges reduce the default isolation provided by containers and introduce significant security risks. Security risk identification for OT container deployments is challenged by hybrid IT/OT architectures, fragmented stakeholder knowledge, and continuous system changes. Existing approaches lack reproducibility, interpretability across contexts, and technical integration with deployment artefacts. We propose a model-based approach, implemented as the Container Security Risk Ontology (CSRO), which integrates five key domains: adversarial behaviour, contextual assumptions, attack scenarios, risk assessment rules, and container security artefacts. Our evaluation of CSRO in a case study demonstrates that the end-to-end formalisation of risk calculation, from artefact to risk level, enables automated and reproducible risk identification. While CSRO currently focuses on technical, container-level treatment measures, its modular and flexible design provides a solid foundation for extending the approach to host-level and organisational risk factors.
comment: Accepted for publication on the Software Engineering in Practice (SEIP) track of the Internation Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE'26)

title: Padé Neurons for Efficient Neural Models
authors: Onur Keleş, A. Murat Tekalp
abstract: Neural networks commonly employ the McCulloch-Pitts neuron model, which is a linear model followed by a point-wise non-linear activation. Various researchers have already advanced inherently non-linear neuron models, such as quadratic neurons, generalized operational neurons, generative neurons, and super neurons, which offer stronger non-linearity compared to point-wise activation functions. In this paper, we introduce a novel and better non-linear neuron model called Padé neurons (Paons), inspired by Padé approximants. Paons offer several advantages, such as diversity of non-linearity, since each Paon learns a different non-linear function of its inputs, and layer efficiency, since Paons provide stronger non-linearity in much fewer layers compared to piecewise linear approximation. Furthermore, Paons include all previously proposed neuron models as special cases, thus any neuron model in any network can be replaced by Paons. We note that there has been a proposal to employ the Padé approximation as a generalized point-wise activation function, which is fundamentally different from our model. To validate the efficacy of Paons, in our experiments, we replace classic neurons in some well-known neural image super-resolution, compression, and classification models based on the ResNet architecture with Paons. Our comprehensive experimental results and analyses demonstrate that neural models built by Paons provide better or equal performance than their classic counterparts with a smaller number of layers. The PyTorch implementation code for Paon is open-sourced at https://github.com/onur-keles/Paon.

title: VotIE: Information Extraction from Meeting Minutes
authors: José Pedro Evans, Luís Filipe Cunha, Purificação Silvano, Alípio Jorge, Nuno Guimarães, Sérgio Nunes, Ricardo Campos
abstract: Municipal meeting minutes record key decisions in local democratic processes. Unlike parliamentary proceedings, which typically adhere to standardized formats, they encode voting outcomes in highly heterogeneous, free-form narrative text that varies widely across municipalities, posing significant challenges for automated extraction. In this paper, we introduce VotIE (Voting Information Extraction), a new information extraction task aimed at identifying structured voting events in narrative deliberative records, and establish the first benchmark for this task using Portuguese municipal minutes, building on the recently introduced CitiLink corpus. Our experiments yield two key findings. First, under standard in-domain evaluation, fine-tuned encoders, specifically XLM-R-CRF, achieve the strongest performance, reaching 93.2\% macro F1, outperforming generative approaches. Second, in a cross-municipality setting that evaluates transfer to unseen administrative contexts, these models suffer substantial performance degradation, whereas few-shot LLMs demonstrate greater robustness, with significantly smaller declines in performance. Despite this generalization advantage, the high computational cost of generative models currently constrains their practicality. As a result, lightweight fine-tuned encoders remain a more practical option for large-scale, real-world deployment. To support reproducible research in administrative NLP, we publicly release our benchmark, trained models, and evaluation framework.

title: Modeling Behavioral Patterns in News Recommendations Using Fuzzy Neural Networks
authors: Kevin Innerebner, Stephan Bartl, Markus Reiter-Haas, Elisabeth Lex
abstract: News recommender systems are increasingly driven by black-box models, offering little transparency for editorial decision-making. In this work, we introduce a transparent recommender system that uses fuzzy neural networks to learn human-readable rules from behavioral data for predicting article clicks. By extracting the rules at configurable thresholds, we can control rule complexity and thus, the level of interpretability. We evaluate our approach on two publicly available news datasets (i.e., MIND and EB-NeRD) and show that we can accurately predict click behavior compared to several established baselines, while learning human-readable rules. Furthermore, we show that the learned rules reveal news consumption patterns, enabling editors to align content curation goals with target audience behavior.
