title: Zak-OTFS ISAC with Bistatic Sensing via Semi-Blind Atomic Norm Denoising Scheme
authors: Kecheng Zhang, Weijie Yuan, Maria Sabrina Greco
abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) through Zak-transform-based orthogonal time frequency space (Zak-OTFS) modulation is a promising solution for high-mobility scenarios. Realizing accurate bistatic sensing and robust communication necessitates precise channel estimation; however, this remains a formidable challenge in doubly dispersive environments, where fractional delay-Doppler shifts induce severe channel spreading. This paper proposes a semi-blind atomic norm denoising scheme for Zak-OTFS ISAC with bistatic sensing. We first derive the discrete-time input-output (I/O) relationship of Zak-OTFS under fractional delay-Doppler shifts and rectangular windowing. Based on this I/O relation, we formulate the joint channel parameter estimation and data detection task as an atomic norm denoising problem, utilizing the negative square penalty method to handle the non-convex discrete constellation constraints. To solve this problem efficiently, we develop an accelerated iterative algorithm that integrates majorization-minimization, accelerated projected gradient, and inexact accelerated proximal gradient methods. We provide a rigorous convergence proof for the proposed algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves super-resolution sensing accuracy and communication performance approaching the perfect channel state information lower bound.
comment: Submitted to IEEE for possible publication

title: Cramer-Rao Bound for Angle of Arrival Estimates in True-Time-Delay Systems
authors: Carl Collmann, Ahmad Nimr, Gerhard Fettweis
abstract: In the context of joint communication and sensing JC&S, the challenge of obtaining accurate parameter estimates is of interest. Parameter estimates, such as the AoA can be utilized for solving the initial access problem, interference mitigation, localization of users or monitoring of the environment and synchronization of MIMO systems. Recently, TTD systems have gained attention for fast beam training during initial access and mitigation of beam squinting. This work derives the CRB for angle estimates in typical TTD systems. Properties of the CRB and the Fisher information are investigated and numerically evaluated. Finally, methods for angle estimation such as ML and established estimators are utilized to solve the angle estimation problem using a uniform linear array.

title: OpenISAC: An Open-Source Real-Time Experimentation Platform for OFDM-ISAC with Over-the-Air Synchronization
authors: Zhiwen Zhou, Chaoyue Zhang, Xiaoli Xu, Yong Zeng
abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is envisioned to be one of the key usage scenarios for the sixth generation (6G) mobile communication networks. While significant progresses have been achieved for the theoretical studies, the further advancement of ISAC is hampered by the lack of accessible, open-source, and real-time experimental platforms. To address this gap, we introduce OpenISAC, a versatile and high-performance open-source platform for real-time ISAC experimentation. OpenISAC utilizes orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) waveform and implements crucial sensing functionalities, including both monostatic and bistatic delay-Doppler sensing. A key feature of our platform is a novel over-the-air (OTA) synchronization mechanism that enables robust bistatic operations without requiring a wired connection between nodes. The platform is built entirely on open-source software, leveraging the universal software radio peripheral (USRP) hardware driver (UHD) library, thus eliminating the need for any commercial licenses. It supports a wide range of software-defined radios, from the cost-effective USRP B200 series to the high-performance X400 series. The physical layer modulator and demodulator are implemented with C++ for high-speed processing, while the sensing data is streamed to a Python environment, providing a user-friendly interface for rapid prototyping and validation of sensing signal processing algorithms. With flexible parameter selection and real-time communication and sensing operation, OpenISAC serves as a powerful and accessible tool for the academic and research communities to explore and innovate within the field of OFDM-ISAC.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications for possible publication

title: Two-stage Multi-beam Training for Multiuser Millimeter-Wave Communications
authors: Weijia Wang, Changsheng You, Xiaodan Shao, Rui Zhang
abstract: In this letter, we study an efficient multi-beam training method for multiuser millimeter-wave communication systems. Unlike the conventional single-beam training method that relies on exhaustive search, multi-beam training design faces a key challenge in balancing the trade-off between beam training overhead and success beam-identification rate, exacerbated by severe inter-beam interference. To tackle this challenge, we propose a new two-stage multi-beam training method with two distinct multi-beam patterns to enable fast and accurate user angle identification. Specifically, in the first stage, the antenna array is divided into sparse subarrays to generate multiple beams (with high array gains), for identifying candidate user angles. In the second stage, the array is redivided into dense subarrays to generate flexibly steered wide beams, for which a cross-validation method is employed to effectively resolve the remaining angular ambiguity in the first stage. Last, numerical results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves the success beam-identification rate compared to existing multi-beam training methods, while retaining or even reducing the required beam training overhead.

title: CSI-MAE: A Masked Autoencoder-based Channel Foundation Model
authors: Jun Jiang, Xiaolong Ruan, Shugong Xu
abstract: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has emerged as a key technique in machine learning, tackling challenges such as limited labeled data, high annotation costs, and variable wireless channel conditions. It is essential for developing Channel Foundation Models (CFMs), which extract latent features from channel state information (CSI) and adapt to different wireless settings. Yet, existing CFMs have notable drawbacks: heavy reliance on scenario-specific data hinders generalization, they focus on single/dual tasks, and lack zero-shot learning ability. In this paper, we propose CSI-MAE, a generalized CFM leveraging masked autoencoder for cross-scenario generalization. Trained on 3GPP channel model datasets, it integrates sensing and communication via CSI perception and generation, proven effective across diverse tasks. A lightweight decoder finetuning strategy cuts training costs while maintaining competitive performance. Under this approach, CSI-MAE matches or surpasses supervised models. With full-parameter finetuning, it achieves the state-of-the-art performance. Its exceptional zero-shot transferability also rivals supervised techniques in cross-scenario applications, driving wireless communication innovation.

title: Ensemble Models for Predicting Treatment Response in Pediatric Low-Grade Glioma Managed with Chemotherapy
authors: Max Bengtsson, Elif Keles, Angela J. Waanders, Ulas Bagci
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a novel pipeline for predicting chemotherapy response in pediatric brain tumors that are not amenable to complete surgical resection, using pre-treatment magnetic resonance imaging combined with clinical information. Our method integrates a state-of-the-art pediatric brain tumor segmentation framework with radiomic feature extraction and clinical data through an ensemble of a Swin UNETR encoder and XGBoost classifier. The segmentation model delineates four tumor subregions enhancing tumor, non-enhancing tumor, cystic component and edema which are used to extract imaging biomarkers and generate predictive features. The Swin UNETR network classifies the response to treatment directly from these segmented MRI scans, while XGBoost predicts response using radiomics and clinical variables including legal sex, ethnicity, race, age at event (in days), molecular subtype, tumor locations, initial surgery status, metastatic status, metastasis location, chemotherapy type, protocol name and chemotherapy agents. The ensemble output provides a non-invasive estimate of chemotherapy response in this historically challenging population characterized by lower progression-free survival. Among compared approaches, our Swin-Ensemble achieved the best performance (precision for non effective cases=0.68, recall for non effective cases=0.85, precision for chemotherapy effective cases=0.64 and overall accuracy=0.69), outperforming Mamba-FeatureFuse, Swin UNETR encoder, and Swin-FeatureFuse models. Our findings suggest that this ensemble framework represents a promising step toward personalized therapy response prediction for pediatric low-grade glioma patients in need of chemotherapy treatment who are not suitable for complete surgical resection, a population with significantly lower progression free survival and for whom chemotherapy remains the primary treatment option.

title: Hybrid Downlink Beamforming with Outage Constraints under Imperfect CSI using Model-Driven Deep Learning
authors: Lukas Schynol, Marius Pesavento
abstract: We consider energy-efficient multi-user hybrid downlink beamforming (BF) and power allocation under imperfect channel state information (CSI) and probabilistic outage constraints. In this domain, classical optimization methods resort to computationally costly conic optimization problems. Meanwhile, generic deep network (DN) architectures lack interpretability and require large training data sets to generalize well. In this paper, we therefore propose a lightweight model-aided deep learning architecture based on a greedy selection algorithm for analog beam codewords. The architecture relies on an instance-adaptive augmentation of the signal model to estimate the impact of the CSI error. To learn the DN parameters, we derive a novel and efficient implicit representation of the nested constrained BF problem and prove sufficient conditions for the existence of the corresponding gradient. In the loss function, we utilize an annealing-based approximation of the outage compared to conventional quantile-based loss terms. This approximation adaptively anneals towards the exact probabilistic constraint depending on the current level of quality of service (QoS) violation. Simulations validate that the proposed DN can achieve the nominal outage level under CSI error due to channel estimation and channel compression, while allocating less power than benchmarks. Thereby, a single trained model generalizes to different numbers of users, QoS requirements and levels of CSI quality. We further show that the adaptive annealing-based loss function can accelerate the training and yield a better power-outage trade-off.

title: Joint Beamforming and Position Optimization for Fluid RIS-aided ISAC Systems
authors: Junjie Ye, Peichang Zhang, Xiao-Peng Li, Lei Huang, Yuanwei Liu
abstract: A fluid reconfigurable intelligent surface (fRIS)-aided integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) system is proposed to enhance multi-target sensing and multi-user communication. Unlike the conventional RIS, the fRIS employs movable elements with adjustable positions, offering additional spatial degrees of freedom. In this system, a joint optimization problem is formulated to minimize sensing beampattern mismatch and symbol estimation error. An algorithm based on alternating minimization is devised to handle the resultant non-convex problem, where the subproblems are solved via augmented Lagrangian method, quadratic programming, semidefinite relaxation, and majorization-minimization. A key challenge is that the element positions affect both incident and reflective channels, leading to the high-order composite objective functions. As a remedy, the high-order terms are transformed into linear and linear-difference forms by exploiting the structural characteristics of fRIS and the channels. Numerical results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed scheme over conventional RIS-aided ISAC and other benchmarks.
comment: 13 pages, has submitted to an IEEE journal for possible publication
zh_title: 液体可重构智能表面辅助的ISAC系统中波束成形与位置联合优化
translation: 提出了一种液体可重构智能表面（fRIS）辅助的集成传感与通信（ISAC）系统，以增强多目标传感和多用户通信能力。与传统的RIS不同，fRIS采用具有可调节位置的可移动元件，提供了额外的空间自由度。在该系统中，制定了一个联合优化问题，旨在最小化传感波束图失配和符号估计误差。设计了一种基于交替最小化（AM）的算法来处理由此产生的非凸问题，其中子问题通过增广拉格朗日法、二次规划、半定松弛和主导最小化方法求解。一个关键挑战是元件位置会影响入射和反射信道，从而导致高阶复合目标函数。作为补救措施，通过利用fRIS和信道的结构特性，将高阶项转换为线性和线性差分形式。数值结果证明了所提出的方案优于传统的RIS辅助ISAC系统和其他基准方案。
tldr: 提出了一种利用可移动元件的液体RIS (fRIS) 辅助的ISAC系统，通过联合优化波束成形和元件位置来增强传感和通信性能。使用交替最小化算法解决了由此产生的非凸优化问题，并展示了优于传统RIS的性能。
ai_comments: 该工作创新性地将“液体”可重构智能表面（fRIS）引入ISAC系统，利用其元件位置可调的特性，为系统性能提升提供了新的空间自由度。主要的挑战和创新点在于如何有效地处理由位置变量引入的高阶非凸目标函数。通过结合多种优化技术（增广拉格朗日法、半定松弛、主导最小化）和结构特性转换，作者提供了一个解决复杂联合优化问题的有效框架，对于未来ISAC和智能反射面技术的研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 提出fRIS辅助的集成传感与通信（ISAC）系统，旨在利用fRIS可移动元件提供的额外空间自由度，增强多目标传感和多用户通信能力。
method: 制定了一个联合优化问题，旨在最小化传感波束图失配和符号估计误差。设计了一种基于交替最小化（AM）的算法来解决由此产生的非凸问题。子问题通过增广拉格朗日法（ALM）、二次规划（QP）、半定松弛（SDR）和主导最小化（MM）方法求解。通过利用fRIS和信道的结构特性，将高阶项转换为线性和线性差分形式以解决位置变量导致的高阶复合目标函数问题。
results: 数值结果表明，所提出的方案优于传统的RIS辅助ISAC系统和其他基准方案。

title: pintervals: an R package for model-agnostic prediction intervals
authors: David Randahl, Anders Hjort, Jonathan P. Williams
abstract: The \pkg{pintervals} package aims to provide a unified framework for constructing prediction intervals and calibrating predictions in a model-agnostic setting using set-aside calibration data. It comprises routines to construct conformal as well as parametric and bootstrapped prediction intervals from any model that outputs point predictions. Several R packages and functions already exist for constructing prediction intervals, but they often focus on specific modeling frameworks or types of predictions, or require manual customization for different models or applications. By providing a consistent interface for a variety of prediction interval construction approaches (all model-agnostic), \pkg{pintervals} allows researchers to apply and compare them across different modeling frameworks and applications.
zh_title: pintervals：一个用于模型无关预测区间的 R 软件包
translation: \pkg{pintervals} 软件包旨在提供一个统一的框架，用于在模型无关的环境中，使用预留的校准数据来构建预测区间和校准预测。它包含了一系列例程，可以从任何输出点预测的模型中构造共形、参数和自举预测区间。目前已存在一些用于构建预测区间的 R 软件包和函数，但它们通常侧重于特定的建模框架或预测类型，或者需要针对不同的模型或应用进行手动定制。通过为各种预测区间构造方法（所有方法都是模型无关的）提供一致的接口，\pkg{pintervals} 允许研究人员在不同的建模框架和应用中应用和比较它们。
tldr: `pintervals` 是一个 R 软件包，它提供了一个统一的、模型无关的框架，用于构建和比较各种预测区间（如共形、参数和自举法）。
ai_comments: 该软件包的创新点在于其“模型无关性”（model-agnostic）和“统一性”（unified framework）。在机器学习模型日益复杂且多样化的背景下，提供一个不依赖于具体模型结构就能生成可靠预测区间的工具，具有重要的实践价值。它降低了研究人员在应用和比较不同不确定性量化方法时的门槛，尤其适用于需要快速评估不同模型预测可靠性的场景。
motivation: 现有的预测区间构造工具通常侧重于特定的建模框架或预测类型，或需要针对不同模型进行手动定制。`pintervals` 旨在解决现有工具的局限性，提供一个统一、模型无关的框架来构建和校准预测区间。
method: `pintervals` 软件包通过使用预留的校准数据，提供了一个统一的框架来构造预测区间。它包含了一系列例程，用于构建共形（conformal）、参数（parametric）和自举（bootstrapped）等预测区间方法，适用于任何能输出点预测的模型。
results: 软件包提供了一个一致的接口，使用户能够在不同的建模框架和应用中应用和比较各种模型无关的预测区间构造方法。

title: Objective comparison of auditory profiles using manifold learning and intrinsic measures
authors: Chen Xu, Birger Kollmeier, Lena Schell-Majoor
abstract: Assigning individuals with hearing impairment to auditory profiles can support a better understanding of the causes and consequences of hearing loss and facilitate profile-based hearing-aid fitting. However, the factors influencing auditory profile generation remain insufficiently understood, and existing profiling frameworks have rarely been compared systematically. This study therefore investigated the impact of two key factors - the clustering method and the number of profiles - on auditory profile generation. In addition, eight established auditory profiling frameworks were systematically reviewed and compared using intrinsic statistical measures and manifold learning techniques. Frameworks were evaluated with respect to internal consistency (i.e., grouping similar individuals) and cluster separation (i.e., clear differentiation between groups). To ensure comparability, all analyses were conducted on a common open-access dataset, the extended Oldenburg Hearing Health Record (OHHR), comprising 1,127 participants (mean age = 67.2 years, SD = 12.0). Results showed that both the clustering method and the chosen number of profiles substantially influenced the resulting auditory profiles. Among purely audiogram-based approaches, the Bisgaard auditory profiles demonstrated the strongest clustering performance, whereas audiometric phenotypes performed worst. Among frameworks incorporating supra-threshold information in addition to the audiogram, the Hearing4All auditory profiles were advantageous, combining a near-optimal number of profile classes (N = 13) with high clustering quality, as indicated by a low Davies-Bouldin index. In conclusion, manifold learning and intrinsic measures enable systematic comparison of auditory profiling frameworks and identify the Hearing4All auditory profile as a promising approach for future research.

title: Parameter Convergence Radar Detector Based on VAMP Deep Unfolding
authors: Haoyun Zhang, Jianghong Han, Xueqian Wang, Gang Li, Xiao-Ping Zhang
abstract: Compared with the sparse recovery process in traditional compressed sensing (CS) radar detector CAMP, vector AMP deep unfolding (VAMP-DU) can achieve sparse recovery over a broader range of observation matrices, with faster convergence speed and higher recovery accuracy. However, the distribution of the error term in VAMP-DU remains unknown, which renders the distribution of the test statistic in CS radar detection undetermined and thus hinders threshold setting under a given false alarm rate when VAMP-DU is applied to CS radar detection. In this work, we theoretically prove that the error term in VAMP-DU follows a Gaussian distribution by leveraging a general state evolution (SE). Based on the Gaussianity, we propose a new parameter convergence radar detector (PCRD) as the CS detector to calculate the distribution parameter of the test statistic and realize target detection under a given false alarm rate. Specifically, PCRD exploits the Gaussian property of error term in VAMP-DU to exhibit superior false alarm control capability, while leveraging the improved recovery accuracy of VAMP-DU to further enhance target detection performance. Numerical simulations validate the Gaussianity of the error term in VAMP-DU and show the superiority of the VAMP-DU-based PCRD over existing approaches in both false alarm control accuracy and target detection performance.
zh_title: 基于VAMP深度展开的参数收敛雷达检测器
translation: 与传统压缩感知（CS）雷达检测器CAMP中的稀疏恢复过程相比，向量近似消息传递深度展开（VAMP-DU）可以在更广泛的观测矩阵范围内实现稀疏恢复，具有更快的收敛速度和更高的恢复精度。然而，VAMP-DU中误差项的分布仍然未知，这使得CS雷达检测中的测试统计量分布无法确定，从而阻碍了VAMP-DU应用于CS雷达检测时在给定虚警率下的阈值设置。在这项工作中，我们利用通用状态演化（SE）理论上证明了VAMP-DU中的误差项服从高斯分布。基于这种高斯性，我们提出了一种新的参数收敛雷达检测器（PCRD）作为CS检测器，用于计算测试统计量的分布参数，并在给定虚警率下实现目标检测。具体而言，PCRD利用VAMP-DU误差项的高斯特性来展现出卓越的虚警控制能力，同时利用VAMP-DU改进的恢复精度来进一步增强目标检测性能。数值仿真验证了VAMP-DU中误差项的高斯性，并表明基于VAMP-DU的PCRD在虚警控制精度和目标检测性能方面均优于现有方法。
tldr: 针对VAMP深度展开（VAMP-DU）应用于压缩感知（CS）雷达检测时误差项分布未知导致阈值难以设定的问题，本文证明了VAMP-DU的误差项服从高斯分布，并基于此提出了参数收敛雷达检测器（PCRD），实现了更准确的虚警控制和更优的目标检测性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将深度展开技术（VAMP-DU）与传统的雷达检测理论相结合，并通过严格的理论分析（利用通用状态演化）解决了VAMP-DU在实际检测应用中的关键障碍——误差项分布未知问题。证明误差项的高斯性是实现精确虚警率控制（这是雷达系统设计的核心要求）的基础。这种基于理论分析的检测器设计（PCRD）能够有效利用VAMP-DU在稀疏恢复上的优势，是对现有CS雷达检测方法的重大改进。
motivation: 传统的压缩感知（CS）雷达检测器CAMP的稀疏恢复能力有限。虽然VAMP深度展开（VAMP-DU）在稀疏恢复方面性能更优（速度更快、精度更高、适用范围更广），但其误差项的分布未知，导致在应用于CS雷达检测时，无法确定测试统计量的分布，从而无法在给定的虚警率下设置检测阈值。
method: 1. 利用通用状态演化（SE）理论上证明了VAMP-DU中的误差项服从高斯分布。 2. 基于此高斯性，提出了一种新的CS检测器——参数收敛雷达检测器（PCRD）。 3. PCRD利用VAMP-DU误差项的高斯特性来提高虚警控制能力，并利用VAMP-DU改进的恢复精度来增强目标检测性能。
results: 数值仿真验证了VAMP-DU中误差项的高斯性，并表明基于VAMP-DU的PCRD在虚警控制精度和目标检测性能方面均优于现有方法。

title: Optimal execution on Uniswap v2/v3 under transient price impact
authors: Bastien Baude, Damien Challet, Ioane Muni Toke
abstract: We study the optimal liquidation of a large position on Uniswap v2 and Uniswap v3 in discrete time. The instantaneous price impact is derived from the AMM pricing rule. Transient impact is modeled to capture either exponential or approximately power-law decay, together with a permanent component. In the Uniswap v2 setting, we obtain optimal strategies in closed-form under general price dynamics. For Uniswap v3, we consider a two-layer liquidity framework, which naturally extends to multiple layers. We address the problem using dynamic programming under geometric Brownian motion dynamics and approximate the solution numerically using a discretization scheme. We obtain optimal strategies akin to classical ones in the LOB literature, with features specific to Uniswap. In particular, we show how the liquidity profile influences them.
zh_title: 瞬态价格影响下 Uniswap v2/v3 上的最优执行
translation: 我们研究了在离散时间内，在 Uniswap v2 和 Uniswap v3 上大额头寸的最优清算问题。瞬时价格影响源自 AMM 定价规则。瞬态影响被建模为捕获指数或近似幂律衰减，并包含一个永久性组成部分。在 Uniswap v2 的设置中，我们在一般价格动态下获得了闭式形式的最优策略。对于 Uniswap v3，我们考虑了一个双层流动性框架，该框架可以自然地扩展到多层。我们利用几何布朗运动动态下的动态规划方法来解决该问题，并使用离散化方案进行数值近似求解。我们获得了类似于经典限价订单簿（LOB）文献中的最优策略，但具有 Uniswap 特有的特征。特别是，我们展示了流动性配置文件如何影响这些策略。
tldr: 研究了在瞬态和永久价格影响模型下，如何在 Uniswap v2 和 v3 上最优地清算大额头寸。对于 v2 获得了闭式解；对于 v3 使用动态规划和数值方法，结果显示最优策略受流动性配置文件影响，并类似于经典的 LOB 策略。
ai_comments: 这项工作将经典的金融市场最优执行理论（通常应用于中心化交易所的限价订单簿 LOB）扩展到了去中心化金融（DeFi）领域的自动做市商（AMM）平台 Uniswap v2 和 v3。其创新性在于将瞬态价格影响模型（指数/近似幂律衰减）与 AMM 的非线性定价规则相结合。特别是在 v3 上的分析，通过引入多层流动性框架和使用动态规划，解决了其集中流动性带来的复杂性，为实际的 DeFi 大宗交易策略提供了重要的理论基础和见解。
motivation: 研究在去中心化金融（DeFi）平台 Uniswap v2 和 v3 上，如何实现大额头寸的最优清算（即最优执行），同时考虑瞬态和永久价格冲击。
method: 将瞬时价格影响基于 AMM 定价规则。瞬态影响建模为指数或近似幂律衰减，并包含一个永久分量。对于 Uniswap v2，在一般价格动态下获得了闭式解。对于 Uniswap v3，采用两层（可扩展至多层）流动性框架，在几何布朗运动（GBM）动态下，使用动态规划和离散化方案进行数值近似求解。
results: 对于 Uniswap v2，获得了闭式形式的最优策略。对于 Uniswap v3，获得了类似于经典限价订单簿（LOB）文献中的最优策略，但具有 Uniswap 特有的特征。研究结果特别展示了流动性配置文件如何影响这些最优策略。

title: Optimal dividend payout with path-dependent drawdown constraint
authors: Chonghu Guan, Jiacheng Fan, Zuo Quan Xu
abstract: This paper studies an optimal dividend problem with a drawdown constraint in a Brownian motion model, requiring the dividend payout rate to remain above a fixed proportion of its historical maximum. This leads to a path-dependent stochastic control problem, as the admissible control depends on its own past values. The associated Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation is a novel two-dimensional variational inequality with a gradient constraint, a type of problem previously only analyzed in the literature using viscosity solution techniques. In contrast, this paper employs delicate PDE methods to establish the existence of a strong solution. This stronger regularity allows us to explicitly characterize an optimal feedback control strategy, expressed in terms of two free boundaries and the running maximum surplus process. Furthermore, we derive key properties of the value function and the free boundaries, including boundedness and continuity. Numerical examples are provided to verify the theoretical results and to offer new financial insights.
zh_title: 具有路径依赖回撤约束的最优股息支付
translation: 本文研究了布朗运动模型下具有回撤约束的最优股息问题，该约束要求股息支付率必须保持在其历史最大值的固定比例之上。这导致了一个路径依赖的随机控制问题，因为允许的控制取决于其自身的过去值。相关的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB)方程是一个新颖的具有梯度约束的二维变分不等式，此前文献中仅使用粘性解技术对此类问题进行过分析。与此相反，本文采用精妙的偏微分方程（PDE）方法来建立强解的存在性。这种更强的正则性使我们能够明确刻画最优反馈控制策略，该策略由两个自由边界和运行最大盈余过程表示。此外，我们推导了价值函数和自由边界的关键性质，包括有界性和连续性。提供了数值示例来验证理论结果并提供新的金融见解。
tldr: 研究了在布朗运动模型下，股息支付率必须保持在其历史最大值一定比例以上的路径依赖最优股息问题。通过精妙的偏微分方程方法，建立了强解的存在性，并明确刻画了最优反馈控制策略（涉及两个自由边界）。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于处理了一个具有路径依赖约束（股息支付率基于其历史最大值）的复杂随机控制问题，这在金融保险领域具有重要的实际意义，有助于维持股息支付的稳定性。方法上的突破在于，它避开了传统的粘性解技术，首次采用精妙的偏微分方程（PDE）方法来建立HJB方程的强解，从而获得了更强的正则性，使得最优反馈控制策略得以明确表征。这种从粘性解到强解的转变是理论上的重大进步。
motivation: 研究在布朗运动模型下，满足股息支付率必须高于其历史最大值固定比例（路径依赖回撤约束）的最优股息支付问题。
method: 将问题转化为具有梯度约束的二维变分不等式（Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB)方程）。采用精妙的偏微分方程（PDE）方法来建立强解的存在性。利用强正则性来明确刻画最优反馈控制策略（以两个自由边界和运行最大盈余过程表示）。
results: 建立了HJB方程强解的存在性。明确刻画了最优反馈控制策略，该策略由两个自由边界和运行最大盈余过程表示。推导了价值函数和自由边界的关键性质，包括有界性和连续性。提供了数值示例来验证理论结果并提供新的金融见解。
conclusion: 通过精妙的偏微分方程方法，成功地解决了具有路径依赖回撤约束的最优股息问题，并明确地表征了最优控制策略和价值函数的性质。

title: Diversification Preferences and Risk Attitudes
authors: Xiangxin He, Fangda Liu, Ruodu Wang
abstract: Portfolio diversification is a cornerstone of modern finance, while risk aversion is central to decision theory; both concepts are long-standing and foundational. We investigate their connections by studying how different forms of diversification correspond to notions of risk aversion. We focus on the classical distinctions between weak and strong risk aversion, and consider diversification preferences for pairs of risks that are identically distributed, comonotonic, antimonotonic, independent, or exchangeable, as well as their intersections. Under a weak continuity condition and without assuming completeness of preferences, diversification for antimonotonic and identically distributed pairs implies weak risk aversion, and diversification for exchangeable pairs is equivalent to strong risk aversion. The implication from diversification for independent pairs to weak risk aversion requires a stronger continuity. We further provide results and examples that clarify the relationships between various diversification preferences and risk attitudes, in particular justifying the one-directional nature of many implications.
zh_title: 多样化偏好与风险态度
translation: 投资组合多样化是现代金融的基石，而风险厌恶是决策理论的核心；这两个概念都历史悠久且具有基础性。我们通过研究不同形式的多样化如何对应风险厌恶的概念来探讨它们之间的联系。我们专注于弱风险厌恶和强风险厌恶之间的经典区别，并考虑针对同分布、共单调、反单调、独立或可交换的风险对及其交集的多样化偏好。在一个弱连续性条件下且不假设偏好完备性的前提下，对反单调和同分布风险对的多样化意味着弱风险厌恶，而对可交换风险对的多样化等价于强风险厌恶。从对独立风险对的多样化推导出弱风险厌恶需要更强的连续性条件。我们进一步提供了结果和例子来阐明各种多样化偏好和风险态度之间的关系，特别是证明了许多推论的单向性。
tldr: 本文研究投资组合多样化偏好与风险厌恶之间的联系。在弱连续性条件下，证明了反单调和同分布风险的多样化意味着弱风险厌恶，而可交换风险的多样化等价于强风险厌恶。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它在形式上严谨地建立了投资组合多样化行为与决策理论中风险厌恶概念（特别是弱风险厌恶和强风险厌恶）之间的精确对应关系。通过不假设偏好的完备性，并使用弱连续性条件，其结果具有较高的普遍性。特别是发现对“可交换风险”的多样化恰好等价于“强风险厌恶”，为理解和衡量强风险厌恶提供了一个基于行为的、可操作的框架。这种对基础概念间深层联系的澄清，对于金融学和经济学理论都具有重要意义。
motivation: 投资组合多样化是现代金融的基石，风险厌恶是决策理论的核心。本文旨在研究这两种基础概念之间的联系，特别是探究不同形式的多样化如何对应不同的风险厌恶概念（如弱风险厌恶和强风险厌恶）。
method: 研究方法是侧重于弱风险厌恶和强风险厌恶之间的经典区别，并考虑针对特定风险对（同分布、共单调、反单调、独立或可交换）的多样化偏好及其交集。分析是在弱连续性条件下进行的，且不假设偏好的完备性。
results: 1. 在弱连续性条件下且不假设偏好完备性的前提下，对反单调和同分布风险对的多样化偏好意味着弱风险厌恶。2. 对可交换风险对的多样化偏好等价于强风险厌恶。3. 对独立风险对的多样化偏好推导出弱风险厌恶需要更强的连续性条件。4. 提供了进一步的结果和例子来阐明各种多样化偏好和风险态度之间的关系，并解释了许多推论的单向性。
conclusion: 本文建立了特定形式的多样化偏好与弱风险厌恶和强风险厌恶概念之间的明确联系，例如对可交换风险的多样化等价于强风险厌恶，从而加深了对金融学和决策理论中两个基本概念之间关系的理解。

title: Sharp Transitions and Systemic Risk in Sparse Financial Networks
authors: Riley James Bendel
abstract: We study contagion and systemic risk in sparse financial networks with balance-sheet interactions on a directed random graph. Each institution has homogeneous liabilities and equity, and exposures along outgoing edges are split equally across counterparties. A linear fraction of institutions have zero out-degree in sparse digraphs; we adopt an external-liability convention that makes the exposure mapping well-defined without altering propagation. We isolate a single-hit transmission mechanism and encode it by a sender-truncated subgraph G_sh. We define adversarial and random systemic events with shock size k_n = c log n and systemic fraction epsilon n. In the subcritical regime rho_out < 1, we prove that maximal forward reachability in G_sh is O(log n) with high probability, yielding O((log n)^2) cascades from shocks of size k_n. For random shocks, we give an explicit fan-in accumulation bound, showing that multi-hit defaults are negligible with high probability when the explored default set is polylogarithmic. In the supercritical regime, we give an exact distributional representation of G_sh as an i.i.d.-outdegree random digraph with uniform destinations, placing it within the scope of the strong-giant/bow-tie theorem of Penrose (2014). We derive the resulting implication for random-shock systemic events. Finally, we explain why sharp-threshold machinery does not directly apply: systemic-event properties need not be monotone in the edge set because adding outgoing edges reduces per-edge exposure.
zh_title: 稀疏金融网络中的急剧转变和系统性风险
translation: 我们研究了基于有向随机图的稀疏金融网络中，具有资产负债表相互作用的传染和系统性风险。每个机构具有同质的负债和股本，并且沿出边的风险敞口在交易对手之间平均分配。在线性比例的机构出度为零的稀疏有向图中，我们采用了一种外部负债约定，使得风险敞口映射明确定义，同时不改变传播过程。我们分离出一种单次冲击传播机制，并将其编码为发送者截断子图 $G_{sh}$。我们定义了冲击规模为 $k_n = c \log n$ 和系统性比例为 $\epsilon n$ 的对抗性和随机系统性事件。在亚临界状态 $\rho_{out} < 1$ 下，我们证明了 $G_{sh}$ 中的最大正向可达性以高概率为 $O(\log n)$，从而导致冲击规模 $k_n$ 产生的级联规模为 $O((\log n)^2)$。对于随机冲击，我们给出了一个明确的扇入累积界限，表明当探索的违约集为多对数级时，多重冲击违约以高概率可以忽略不计。在超临界状态下，我们给出了 $G_{sh}$ 的精确分布表示，它是一个具有均匀目的地的独立同分布出度的随机有向图，从而将其置于 Penrose (2014) 的强巨型/领结定理的范围内。我们推导了由此产生的对随机冲击系统性事件的含义。最后，我们解释了为什么急剧阈值机制不直接适用：系统性事件的属性在边集上不必是单调的，因为增加出边会减少单边风险敞口。
tldr: 对稀疏金融网络中的系统性风险分析表明，在亚临界状态下级联规模较小（多对数级），并且由于增加网络边对风险敞口的非单调影响，标准的急剧阈值理论变得复杂。
ai_comments: 本文的创新在于将网络理论（有向随机图、强巨型定理）应用于金融传染模型，特别是在稀疏有向随机图上考虑资产负债表相互作用。其重要性在于揭示了金融网络中独特的非单调性（增加出边会减少单边风险敞口），解释了为什么传统的急剧阈值机制不能直接应用于系统性风险分析，从而为理解金融系统中的临界行为提供了更精确的工具。
motivation: 研究具有资产负债表相互作用的稀疏金融网络（基于有向随机图）中的传染和系统性风险。
method: 使用具有资产负债表相互作用的有向随机图模型。引入外部负债约定。隔离单次冲击传播机制（$G_{sh}$）。分析亚临界（$\rho_{out} < 1$）和超临界状态，并应用正向可达性、扇入累积界限，以及强巨型/领结定理。
results: 在亚临界状态下，最大正向可达性为 $O(\log n)$，导致级联规模为 $O((\log n)^2)$。对于随机冲击，多重冲击违约可以忽略不计。在超临界状态下，给出了 $G_{sh}$ 的精确分布表示，并推导了随机冲击的系统性事件的含义。
conclusion: 解释了急剧阈值机制不直接适用的原因：系统性事件的属性在边集上不一定是单调的，因为增加出边会减少单边风险敞口。

title: Towards Trustworthy LLM-Based Recommendation via Rationale Integration
authors: Chung Park, Taesan Kim, Hyeongjun Yun, Dongjoon Hong, Junui Hong, Kijung Park, MinCheol Cho, Mira Myong, Jihoon Oh, Min sung Choi
abstract: Traditional recommender systems (RS) have been primarily optimized for accuracy and short-term engagement, often overlooking transparency and trustworthiness. Recently, platforms such as Amazon and Instagram have begun providing recommendation rationales to users, acknowledging their critical role in fostering trust and enhancing engagement; however, most existing systems still treat them as post-hoc artifacts. We propose an LLM-based recommender (LLM-Rec) that not only predicts items but also generates logically grounded rationales. Our approach leverages a self-annotated rationale dataset and instruction tuning in a rationale-first format, where the model generates an explanation before outputting the recommended item. By adopting this strategy and representing rationales in a chain-of-thought (CoT) style, LLM-Rec strengthens both interpretability and recommendation performance. Experiments on the Fashion and Scientific domains of the Amazon Review dataset demonstrate significant improvements over well-established baselines. To encourage reproducibility and future research, we publicly release a rationale-augmented recommendation dataset containing user histories, rationales, and recommended items.
zh_title: 迈向通过理由整合的可信赖的大型语言模型推荐
translation: 传统推荐系统（RS）主要针对准确性和短期参与度进行优化，往往忽略了透明度和可信赖性。最近，亚马逊和Instagram等平台开始向用户提供推荐理由，承认其在培养信任和增强参与度方面的重要作用；然而，大多数现有系统仍将它们视为事后的产物。我们提出了一种基于LLM的推荐器（LLM-Rec），它不仅预测物品，还生成逻辑上合理的理由。我们的方法利用了一个自我标注的理由数据集和指令微调，采用“理由优先”的格式，即模型在输出推荐物品之前先生成解释。通过采用这种策略并将理由表示为思维链（CoT）风格，LLM-Rec同时增强了可解释性和推荐性能。在Amazon Review数据集的时尚和科学领域的实验证明了相对于成熟基线的显著改进。为鼓励可复现性和未来研究，我们公开了一个包含用户历史、理由和推荐物品的理由增强推荐数据集。
tldr: 研究人员开发了一种新的基于LLM的推荐系统（LLM-Rec），它通过先生成像思维链一样的推荐理由，然后才给出推荐物品，来解决传统推荐系统缺乏透明度和信任度的问题，实验结果显示性能有所提升。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种“先生成理由再推荐物品”的“理由优先”格式，并利用CoT（思维链）风格来增强LLM在推荐系统中的可解释性和性能，解决了传统推荐系统缺乏透明度和可信赖性的问题。其局限性可能在于对生成式模型的过度依赖以及推理成本。
motivation: 传统推荐系统主要优化准确性和短期参与度，往往忽略了透明度和可信赖性。平台开始提供推荐理由以增强信任和参与度，但现有系统多将理由视为事后产生的制品。
method: 提出了一种基于LLM的推荐器（LLM-Rec），它利用自我标注的理由数据集和指令微调，采用“理由优先”的格式进行训练，即模型先生成解释，再输出推荐的物品，并将理由表示为思维链（CoT）风格。
results: 在Amazon Review数据集的时尚和科学领域上，实验结果表明LLM-Rec相对于成熟的基线模型有显著的性能提升。同时，为鼓励可复现性和未来研究，公开了一个包含用户历史、理由和推荐物品的理由增强推荐数据集。
conclusion: 通过在Amazon Review数据集的时尚和科学领域进行的实验，证明了LLM-Rec相较于成熟基线模型有显著的性能提升。

title: GCRank: A Generative Contextual Comprehension Paradigm for Takeout Ranking Model
authors: Ziheng Ni, Congcong Liu, Cai Shang, Yiming Sun, Junjie Li, Zhiwei Fang, Guangpeng Chen, Jian Li, Zehua Zhang, Changping Peng, Zhangang Lin, Ching Law, Jingping Shao
abstract: The ranking stage serves as the central optimization and allocation hub in advertising systems, governing economic value distribution through eCPM and orchestrating the user-centric blending of organic and advertising content. Prevailing ranking models often rely on fragmented modules and hand-crafted features, limiting their ability to interpret complex user intent. This challenge is further amplified in location-based services such as food delivery, where user decisions are shaped by dynamic spatial, temporal, and individual contexts. To address these limitations, we propose a novel generative framework that reframes ranking as a context comprehension task, modeling heterogeneous signals in a unified architecture. Our architecture consists of two core components: the Generative Contextual Encoder (GCE) and the Generative Contextual Fusion (GCF). The GCE comprises three specialized modules: a Personalized Context Enhancer (PCE) for user-specific modeling, a Collective Context Enhancer (CCE) for group-level patterns, and a Dynamic Context Enhancer (DCE) for real-time situational adaptation. The GCF module then seamlessly integrates these contextual representations through low-rank adaptation. Extensive experiments confirm that our method achieves significant gains in critical business metrics, including click-through rate and platform revenue. We have successfully deployed our method on a large-scale food delivery advertising platform, demonstrating its substantial practical impact. This work pioneers a new perspective on generative recommendation and highlights its practical potential in industrial advertising systems.
zh_title: GCRank：一种用于外卖排序模型的生成式上下文理解范式
translation: 排序阶段是广告系统中的核心优化和分配中心，通过eCPM管理经济价值分配，并协调有机内容和广告内容的以用户为中心的混合。主流的排序模型通常依赖于零散的模块和手工特征，限制了它们解释复杂用户意图的能力。在外卖等基于位置的服务中，用户决策受到动态的空间、时间和个体情境的影响，这一挑战更加突出。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一种新颖的生成式框架，将排序重新定义为上下文理解任务，并在统一的架构中对异构信号进行建模。我们的架构由两个核心组件组成：生成式上下文编码器（GCE）和生成式上下文融合（GCF）。GCE包含三个专业模块：用于用户特定建模的个性化上下文增强器（PCE）、用于群体级模式的集体上下文增强器（CCE）以及用于实时情境适应的动态上下文增强器（DCE）。然后，GCF模块通过低秩适应无缝地整合这些上下文表示。广泛的实验证实，我们的方法在关键业务指标（包括点击率和平台收入）上取得了显著的提升。我们已成功将该方法部署在一个大规模的外卖广告平台上，证明了其巨大的实际应用影响。这项工作开创了生成式推荐的新视角，并突显了其在工业广告系统中的实用潜力。
tldr: GCRank是一种新的生成式框架，将外卖排序任务重构为上下文理解任务。它使用GCE（包含个性化、集体和动态增强模块）和GCF进行统一建模，有效整合了复杂的时空和个体信号，并在大规模外卖平台部署中显著提高了点击率和平台收入。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将传统的推荐/排序任务转化为一个“生成式上下文理解”任务，这是一个在工业推荐系统中值得关注的新范式。通过设计一个统一的架构（GCE和GCF），该模型能够系统地整合异构、动态的上下文信号（个性化、集体、实时情境），克服了传统模型中特征和模块碎片化的问题。成功在大规模外卖平台上的部署，证明了该方法不仅具有理论创新性，还具有强大的实际业务价值。
motivation: 现有的排序模型依赖于零散的模块和手工特征，难以解释复杂的意图，尤其是在外卖等受动态时空和个体情境影响的定位服务中，模型的上下文理解能力受限。
method: 提出GCRank，一个将排序重构为上下文理解任务的生成式框架。该架构包含两个核心组件：1. 生成式上下文编码器（GCE）：包含个性化上下文增强器（PCE）、集体上下文增强器（CCE）和动态上下文增强器（DCE）三个专业模块。2. 生成式上下文融合（GCF）：通过低秩适应（low-rank adaptation）无缝整合上述上下文表示。
results: 在关键业务指标（包括点击率和平台收入）上取得了显著提升。已成功部署在一个大规模的外卖广告平台上，展示了重大的实际应用价值。
conclusion: 该工作开创了生成式推荐的新视角，并突出了其在工业广告系统中的实用潜力。

title: Acceptance of cybernetic avatars for capability enhancement: a large-scale survey
authors: Laura Aymerich-Franch, Tarek Taha, Hiroko Kamide, Takahiro Miyashita, Hiroshi Ishiguro, Paolo Dario
abstract: Avatar embodiment experiences have the potential to enhance human capabilities by extending human senses, body, and mind. This study investigates social acceptance of robotic and virtual avatars as enablers of capability enhancement in six domains: identity exploration, well-being and behavioral transformation, expanded travel capabilities, expanded bodily and sensory abilities, cognitive augmentation, and immortality. We conducted a large-scale survey (n = 1001) in Dubai to explore acceptance of sixteen capability enhancement scenarios within these domains. The highest levels of agreement were observed for multilingual communication (77.5%) and learning capabilities (68.7%), followed by assisting individuals with reduced mobility (64.5%) and behavioral transformation (59.5%). Scenarios involving immortality through consciousness transfer received the least support (34.9%). These findings contribute to a deeper understanding of public attitudes toward avatar-based human enhancement and offer practical guidance for the responsible design, development, and integration of cybernetic avatars in the society, ensuring their societal acceptance and fostering a harmonious human-avatar coexistence.
zh_title: 能力增强型赛博格化身的接受度：一项大规模调查
translation: 化身具身体验有潜力通过扩展人类的感官、身体和心智来增强人类的能力。本研究调查了机器人和虚拟化身作为能力增强推动者在六个领域的社会接受度：身份探索、健康与行为转变、扩展旅行能力、扩展身体和感官能力、认知增强和永生。我们在迪拜进行了一项大规模调查（n = 1001），以探索在这六个领域内十六种能力增强情景的接受度。在多语言交流（77.5%）和学习能力（68.7%）方面观察到最高的同意率，其次是协助行动不便者（64.5%）和行为转变（59.5%）。涉及通过意识转移实现永生的情景获得的支持最少（34.9%）。这些发现有助于加深对公众对基于化身的人类增强态度的理解，并为赛博格化身在社会中的负责任设计、开发和整合提供实际指导，以确保其社会接受度并促进人类与化身的和谐共存。
tldr: 对1001人进行的大规模调查显示，公众对化身增强旅行、学习和交流等实用能力持高度接受态度，但对通过意识转移实现永生持保留态度，这为未来赛博格技术的设计和推广提供了重要参考。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于其大规模的跨领域调查，系统地评估了公众对赛博格化身（包括机器人和虚拟化身）在六个关键能力增强领域的接受程度。其重要性在于为负责任的技术设计和整合提供了实证指导。局限性可能在于研究仅在迪拜进行，其结果的普遍性可能受地域文化影响。
motivation: 探究机器人和虚拟化身作为能力增强（扩展人类感官、身体和心智）的推动者，在社会中的接受程度。
method: 进行了一项大规模的调查（n = 1001），在迪拜探索了六个领域内十六种能力增强情景的接受度。
results: 在多语言交流（77.5%）和学习能力（68.7%）方面观察到最高的同意率，其次是协助行动不便者（64.5%）和行为转变（59.5%）。涉及通过意识转移实现永生的情景获得的支持最少（34.9%）。
conclusion: 这些发现加深了对公众对基于化身的人类增强的态度理解，并为赛博格化身在社会中的负责任设计、开发和整合提供了实际指导，以确保其社会接受度和促进人类与化身和谐共存。

title: The Impact of LLM-Generated Reviews on Recommender Systems: Textual Shifts, Performance Effects, and Strategic Platform Control
authors: Itzhak Ziv, Moshe Unger, Hilah Geva
abstract: The rise of generative AI technologies is reshaping content-based recommender systems (RSes), which increasingly encounter AI-generated content alongside human-authored content. This study examines how the introduction of AI-generated reviews influences RS performance and business outcomes. We analyze two distinct pathways through which AI content can enter RSes: user-centric, in which individuals use AI tools to refine their reviews, and platform-centric, in which platforms generate synthetic reviews directly from structured metadata. Using a large-scale dataset of hotel reviews from TripAdvisor, we generate synthetic reviews using LLMs and evaluate their impact across the training and deployment phases of RSes. We find that AI-generated reviews differ systematically from human-authored reviews across multiple textual dimensions. Although both user- and platform-centric AI reviews enhance RS performance relative to models without textual data, models trained on human reviews consistently achieve superior performance, underscoring the quality of authentic human data. Human-trained models generalize robustly to AI content, whereas AI-trained models underperform on both content types. Furthermore, tone-based framing strategies (encouraging, constructive, or critical) substantially enhance platform-generated review effectiveness. Our findings highlight the strategic importance of platform control in governing the generation and integration of AI-generated reviews, ensuring that synthetic content complements recommendation robustness and sustainable business value.
zh_title: LLM生成评论对推荐系统的影响：文本转移、性能效应与战略平台控制
translation: 生成式人工智能技术的兴起正在重塑内容推荐系统（RSes），这些系统越来越多地遇到与人类创作内容并存的人工智能生成内容。本研究考察了人工智能生成评论通过两种不同途径进入RSes：以用户为中心（个人使用AI工具完善评论）和以平台为中心（平台直接根据结构化元数据生成合成评论），并分析了它们对RS性能和业务成果的影响。我们使用TripAdvisor的大型酒店评论数据集，利用LLM生成合成评论，并评估了它们在RS的训练和部署阶段的影响。我们发现，AI生成评论在多个文本维度上与人类创作的评论存在系统性差异。尽管用户和平台中心的人工智能评论都比没有文本数据的模型提高了RS性能，但用人类评论训练的模型始终表现出更优越的性能，突显了真实人类数据的质量。人类训练的模型对AI内容具有稳健的泛化能力，而AI训练的模型在两种内容类型上都表现不佳。此外，基于语气的框架策略（鼓励、建设性或批判性）能显著提高平台生成评论的有效性。我们的研究结果凸显了平台在控制AI生成评论的生成和整合方面的战略重要性，以确保合成内容能够补充推荐的鲁棒性和可持续的商业价值。
tldr: LLM生成的评论会系统性地改变推荐系统，但人类生成的评论数据在保证推荐性能和鲁棒性方面仍然优越；平台需要战略性地管理AI评论的引入。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地探讨了LLM生成评论对推荐系统的双重影响路径（用户中心和平台中心），并量化了其在推荐性能上的差异。其重要性在于揭示了在AI内容泛滥背景下，人类评论数据的持久价值和平台战略控制的必要性。局限性在于研究基于酒店评论数据集，其普适性可能需要其他领域的数据验证。
motivation: 研究动机是生成式AI技术的兴起正在重塑内容推荐系统，这些系统正越来越多地遇到AI生成内容与人类创作内容共存的情况，因此需要研究AI生成评论如何影响RS性能和业务成果。
method: 使用大型TripAdvisor酒店评论数据集，利用LLMs生成合成评论，并评估这些AI评论在推荐系统（RSes）的训练和部署阶段对RS性能的影响，同时比较了用户中心和平台中心两种引入路径。
results: AI生成评论在多个文本维度上与人类评论存在系统性差异；无论是用户中心还是平台中心AI评论，都能提升RS性能（相对于不使用文本数据的模型），但由人类评论训练的模型性能始终最优；人类训练的模型对AI内容泛化能力强，而AI训练的模型在两种内容上都表现不佳；基于语气的框架策略（鼓励、建设性或批判性）能显著增强平台生成评论的有效性。
conclusion: 研究结果强调了平台在管理和整合AI生成评论方面的战略重要性，以确保合成内容能够补充推荐的鲁棒性和可持续的商业价值。

title: Distillation-based Scenario-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts for the Matching Stage of Multi-scenario Recommendation
authors: Ruibing Wang, Shuhan Guo, Haotong Du, Quanming Yao
abstract: Multi-scenario recommendation is pivotal for optimizing user experience across diverse contexts. While Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (MMOE) thrives in ranking, its transfer to the matching stage is hindered by the blind optimization inherent to independent two-tower architectures and the parameter dominance of head scenarios. To address these structural and distributional bottlenecks, we propose Distillation-based Scenario-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (DSMOE). Specially, we devise a Scenario-Adaptive Projection (SAP) module to generate lightweight, context-specific parameters, effectively preventing expert collapse in long-tail scenarios. Concurrently, we introduce a cross-architecture knowledge distillation framework, where an interaction-aware teacher guides the two-tower student to capture complex matching patterns. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate DSMOE's superiority, particularly in significantly improving retrieval quality for under-represented, data-sparse scenarios.
zh_title: 基于蒸馏的场景自适应专家混合模型在多场景推荐匹配阶段的应用
translation: 多场景推荐对于优化跨不同上下文的用户体验至关重要。虽然多门控专家混合模型（MMOE）在排序阶段表现出色，但其在转移到匹配阶段时受到独立双塔架构中存在的盲目优化和头部场景参数主导性的阻碍。为解决这些结构和分布瓶颈，我们提出了基于蒸馏的场景自适应专家混合模型（DSMOE）。具体来说，我们设计了一个场景自适应投影（SAP）模块来生成轻量级的、上下文特定的参数，有效防止了长尾场景中的专家崩溃。同时，我们引入了一个跨架构知识蒸馏框架，其中一个交互感知的教师模型指导双塔学生模型捕获复杂的匹配模式。在真实世界数据集上的广泛实验证明了DSMOE的优越性，特别是在显著提高了对代表性不足、数据稀疏场景的召回质量方面。
tldr: 为解决多场景推荐召回阶段MMOE模型中专家崩溃和头部场景参数垄断的问题，DSMOE模型通过场景自适应投影（SAP）生成场景特定参数，并使用知识蒸馏来指导双塔学生模型学习，显著提高了长尾场景的检索性能。
ai_comments: 该论文针对多场景推荐中MMOE在召回（matching）阶段面临的专家崩溃和头部场景参数主导问题，提出了创新的DSMOE模型。其核心贡献在于引入了场景自适应投影（SAP）模块来生成轻量级、场景特定的参数，并设计了跨架构知识蒸馏框架，有效解决了长尾场景的优化难题。模型的有效性在真实数据集上得到了验证。
motivation: 现有的MMOE模型在多场景推荐的匹配阶段应用受限，主要由于独立的双塔架构存在盲目优化问题，以及头部场景对参数的主导性。
method: 提出了一种基于蒸馏的场景自适应专家混合模型（DSMOE）。该模型包含一个场景自适应投影（SAP）模块，用于生成轻量级、上下文特定的参数以防止专家崩溃；同时引入了一个跨架构知识蒸馏框架，使交互感知的教师模型指导双塔学生模型捕获复杂的匹配模式。
results: 在真实世界数据集上的广泛实验证明了DSMOE的优越性，特别是在显著提高了对代表性不足、数据稀疏场景的召回质量方面。

title: Cross-Platform Digital Discourse Analysis of the Israel-Hamas Conflict: Sentiment, Topics, and Event Dynamics
authors: Despoina Antonakaki, Sotiris Ioannidis
abstract: The Israeli-Palestinian conflict remains one of the most polarizing geopolitical issues, with the October 2023 escalation intensifying online debate. Social media platforms, particularly Telegram, have become central to real-time news sharing, advocacy, and propaganda. In this study, we analyze Telegram, Twitter/X, and Reddit to examine how conflict narratives are produced, amplified, and contested across different digital spheres. Building on our previous work on Telegram discourse during the 2023 escalation, we extend the analysis longitudinally and cross-platform using an updated dataset spanning October 2023 to mid-2025. The corpus includes more than 187,000 Telegram messages, 2.1 million Reddit comments, and curated Twitter/X posts. We combine Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), BERTopic, and transformer-based sentiment and emotion models to identify dominant themes, emotional dynamics, and propaganda strategies. Telegram channels provide unfiltered, high-intensity documentation of events; Twitter/X amplifies frames to global audiences; and Reddit hosts more reflective and deliberative discussions. Our findings reveal persistent negative sentiment, strong coupling between humanitarian framing and solidarity expressions, and platform-specific pathways for the diffusion of pro-Palestinian and pro-Israeli narratives. This paper offers three contributions: (1) a multi-platform, FAIR-compliant dataset on the Israel-Hamas war, (2) an integrated pipeline combining topic modeling, sentiment and emotion analysis, and spam filtering for large-scale conflict discourse, and (3) empirical insights into how platform affordances and affective publics shape the evolution of digital conflict communication.
zh_title: 以色列-哈马斯冲突的跨平台数字话语分析：情感、主题和事件动态
translation: 以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突仍然是最具两极分化的地缘政治问题之一，2023年10月的升级加剧了在线辩论。社交媒体平台，特别是Telegram，已成为实时新闻分享、倡导和宣传的中心。在本研究中，我们分析了Telegram、Twitter/X和Reddit，以研究冲突叙事如何在不同的数字领域中产生、放大和受到争论。在先前关于2023年升级期间Telegram话语研究的基础上，我们利用跨越2023年10月至2025年中期的更新数据集，纵向扩展分析并进行跨平台比较。该语料库包括超过187,000条Telegram消息、210万条Reddit评论和精选的Twitter/X帖子。我们将潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）、BERTopic以及基于Transformer的情感和情绪模型相结合，以识别主导主题、情感动态和宣传策略。Telegram频道提供未经审查的、高强度的事件记录；Twitter/X将框架放大给全球受众；而Reddit则承载着更具反思性和审议性的讨论。我们的研究结果揭示了持续的负面情绪，人道主义框架与团结表达之间的紧密耦合，以及叙事传播的平台特异性路径（亲巴勒斯坦和亲以色列叙事）。本文做出了三项贡献：（1）一个多平台、符合FAIR原则的以色列-哈马斯战争数据集，（2）一个结合了话题建模、情感和情绪分析以及垃圾信息过滤的用于大规模冲突话语的集成管道，（3）关于平台可供性（affordances）和情感公众如何影响数字冲突交流演变的实证见解。
tldr: 研究人员分析了Telegram、Twitter/X和Reddit在2023-2025年间关于以色列-哈马斯冲突的大量数据，发现情绪普遍负面，且不同平台（Telegram的原始记录、Twitter/X的放大、Reddit的审议）在传播亲/反冲突叙事方面扮演着不同角色。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新之处在于其跨平台（Telegram、Twitter/X、Reddit）的纵向分析，并整合了多种先进的文本挖掘技术（LDA、BERTopic、Transformer模型）来解构复杂冲突的数字叙事。其重要性在于揭示了不同平台在信息传播和叙事构建中的独特角色。局限性可能在于对“宣传策略”的识别深度，以及样本的代表性问题。
motivation: 2023年10月冲突升级加剧了在线辩论，特别是Telegram已成为实时新闻分享、倡导和宣传的中心，因此需要分析不同数字领域中冲突叙事的产生、放大和争论方式。
method: 结合了潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）、BERTopic、基于Transformer的情感和情绪模型，并利用了包含18.7万条Telegram消息、210万条Reddit评论和精选Twitter/X帖子的数据集进行纵向和跨平台分析。
results: 研究发现持续存在负面情绪，人道主义叙事与团结表达之间存在紧密耦合，并揭示了亲巴勒斯坦和亲以色列叙事传播的平台特异性路径。Telegram提供未经过滤的高强度事件记录，Twitter/X将框架放大给全球受众，而Reddit则进行更具反思性和审议性的讨论。
conclusion: 研究揭示了持续的负面情绪，人道主义叙事与团结表达之间的紧密联系，以及叙事在不同平台上传播的特定路径，并阐明了平台特性和情感公众如何塑造数字冲突交流的演变。

title: TextBridgeGNN: Pre-training Graph Neural Network for Cross-Domain Recommendation via Text-Guided Transfer
authors: Yiwen Chen, Yiqing Wu, Huishi Luo, Fuzhen Zhuang, Deqing Wang
abstract:
Graph-based recommendation has achieved great success in recent years. The classical graph recommendation model utilizes ID embedding to store essential collaborative information. However, this ID-based paradigm faces challenges in transferring to a new domain, making it hard to build a pre-trained graph recommendation model. This phenomenon primarily stems from two inherent challenges: (1) the non-transferability of ID embeddings due to isolated domain-specific ID spaces, and (2) structural incompatibility between heterogeneous interaction graphs across domains.
  To address these issues, we propose TextBridgeGNN, a pre-training and fine-tuning framework that can effectively transfer knowledge from a pre-trained GNN to downstream tasks. We believe the key lies in how to build the relationship between domains. Specifically, TextBridgeGNN uses text as a semantic bridge to connect domains through multi-level graph propagation. During the pre-training stage, textual information is utilized to break the data islands formed by multiple domains, and hierarchical GNNs are designed to learn both domain-specific and domain-global knowledge with text features, ensuring the retention of collaborative signals and the enhancement of semantics. During the fine-tuning stage, a similarity transfer mechanism is proposed. This mechanism initializes ID embeddings in the target domain by transferring from semantically related nodes, successfully transferring the ID embeddings and graph pattern.
  Experiments demonstrate that TextBridgeGNN outperforms existing methods in cross-domain, multi-domain, and training-free settings, highlighting its ability to integrate Pre-trained Language Model (PLM)-driven semantics with graph-based collaborative filtering without costly language model fine-tuning or real-time inference overhead.
zh_title: TextBridgeGNN：通过文本引导的迁移预训练图神经网络以实现跨域推荐
translation:
近年来，基于图的推荐取得了巨大成功。经典的图推荐模型利用ID嵌入来存储重要的协同信息。然而，这种基于ID的范式在迁移到新领域时面临挑战，使得构建预训练的图推荐模型变得困难。这种现象主要源于两个固有的挑战：（1）由于孤立的、特定于域的ID空间，ID嵌入的不可转移性；（2）跨域的异构交互图之间的结构不兼容性。
为了解决这些问题，我们提出了TextBridgeGNN，一个预训练和微调框架，可以有效地将知识从预训练的GNN迁移到下游任务。我们相信关键在于如何建立域之间的关系。具体来说，TextBridgeGNN使用文本作为语义桥梁，通过多层图传播连接各个域。在预训练阶段，利用文本信息打破了多个域形成的数据孤岛，并设计了分层GNN来学习具有文本特征的域特定和域全局知识，确保了协同信号的保留和语义的增强。在微调阶段，提出了一种相似性迁移机制。该机制通过从语义相关的节点迁移ID嵌入来初始化目标域的ID嵌入，成功地迁移了ID嵌入和图模式。
实验表明，TextBridgeGNN在跨域、多域和无训练设置下均优于现有方法，凸显了其在没有昂贵的语言模型微调或实时推理开销的情况下，将预训练语言模型（PLM）驱动的语义与基于图的协同过滤相结合的能力。
tldr: TextBridgeGNN通过利用文本作为语义桥梁，解决了ID嵌入的不可转移性和异构交互图之间的结构不兼容性问题，实现了图神经网络在跨域推荐中的知识迁移，并在实验中表现优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 该研究有效地利用文本信息解决了图神经网络在跨域推荐中的知识迁移问题，通过引入文本作为语义桥梁和提出相似性迁移机制，克服了ID嵌入不可转移和图结构不兼容的挑战。其在多种设置下的优越性能以及无需昂贵语言模型微调的特点，使其具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，对于文本特征提取的有效性以及大规模异构图的扩展性仍有待进一步探讨。
motivation: 传统的基于ID嵌入的图推荐模型在跨域迁移时面临ID嵌入不可转移和图结构不兼容两大挑战，难以构建预训练的图推荐模型。
method: TextBridgeGNN提出了一种预训练-微调框架，利用文本作为语义桥梁，通过多层图传播连接不同域。预训练阶段利用文本信息打破数据孤岛，并通过分层GNN学习域内和域全局知识。微调阶段提出相似性迁移机制，通过迁移语义相关节点的ID嵌入来初始化目标域的ID嵌入。
results: TextBridgeGNN在跨域、多域和无训练设置下均优于现有方法，证明了其能够整合预训练语言模型驱动的语义与基于图的协同过滤，且无需昂贵的语言模型微调或实时推理开销。
conclusion: TextBridgeGNN通过利用文本作为语义桥梁，成功地实现了图神经网络在跨域推荐中的知识迁移，克服了传统方法的局限性，并在实验中取得了优于现有方法的性能。

title: FUSE : Failure-aware Usage of Subagent Evidence for MultiModal Search and Recommendation
authors: Tushar Vatsa, Vibha Belavadi, Priya Shanmugasundaram, Suhas Suresha, Dewang Sultania
abstract: Multimodal creative assistants decompose user goals and route tasks to subagents for layout, styling, retrieval, and generation. Retrieval quality is pivotal, yet failures can arise at several stages: understanding user intent, choosing content types, finding candidates (recall), or ranking results. Meanwhile, sending and processing images is costly, making naive multimodal approaches impractical. We present FUSE: Failure-aware Usage of Subagent Evidence for MultiModal Search and Recommendation. FUSE replaces most raw-image prompting with a compact Grounded Design Representation (GDR): a selection aware JSON of canvas elements (image, text, shape, icon, video, logo), structure, styles, salient colors, and user selection provided by the Planner team. FUSE implements seven context budgeting strategies: comprehensive baseline prompting, context compression, chain-of-thought reasoning, mini-shot optimization, retrieval-augmented context, two-stage processing, and zero-shot minimalism. Finally, a pipeline attribution layer monitors system performance by converting subagent signals into simple checks: intent alignment, content-type/routing sanity, recall health (e.g., zero-hit and top-match strength), and ranking displacement analysis. We evaluate the seven context budgeting variants across 788 evaluation queries from diverse users and design templates (refer Figure 3). Our systematic evaluation reveals that Context Compression achieves optimal performance across all pipeline stages, with 93.3% intent accuracy, 86.8% routing success(with fallbacks), 99.4% recall, and 88.5% NDCG@5. This approach demonstrates that strategic context summarization outperforms both comprehensive and minimal contextualization strategies.

zh_title: FUSE：面向故障的子代理证据在多模态搜索和推荐中的使用
translation: 多模态创意助手将用户目标分解，并将任务路由到子代理以进行布局、样式设计、检索和生成。检索质量至关重要，但故障可能出现在几个阶段：理解用户意图、选择内容类型、查找候选（召回）或排序结果。同时，发送和处理图像成本很高，使得天真的多模态方法不切实际。我们提出了FUSE：面向故障的子代理证据在多模态搜索和推荐中的使用。FUSE用紧凑的Grounded Design Representation (GDR) 取代了大部分原始图像提示：一个由Planner团队提供的、感知画布元素（图像、文本、形状、图标、视频、标志）、结构、样式、显著颜色和用户选择的JSON。FUSE实现了七种上下文预算策略：全面的基线提示、上下文压缩、思维链推理、小样本优化、检索增强的上下文、两阶段处理和零样本最小化。最后，一个管道归因层通过将子代理信号转换为简单的检查来监控系统性能：意图对齐、内容类型/路由合理性、召回健康度（例如，零命中和最佳匹配强度）和排序置换分析。我们根据来自不同用户和设计模板的788个评估查询评估了七种上下文预算变体（参见图3）。我们的系统评估显示，上下文压缩在所有管道阶段实现了最佳性能，意图准确率为93.3%，路由成功率为86.8%（带回退），召回率为99.4%，NDCG@5为88.5%。该方法证明了战略性上下文总结优于全面和最小化的上下文策略。
tldr: 为了解决多模态助手检索成本高和易出错的问题，FUSE用GDR代替原始图像，并测试了七种上下文管理策略。Context Compression策略被证明是最优的，它在关键性能指标上取得了高分。
ai_comments: 该方法创新性地提出了使用紧凑的GDR（Grounded Design Representation）来替代大部分原始图像提示，以解决多模态搜索和推荐中成本高和失败率的问题。其重要性在于通过上下文预算策略和故障感知归因层，实现了效率和性能的平衡。局限性在于评估仅基于788个查询和特定的设计模板。
motivation: 多模态助手在检索质量方面存在挑战，包括意图理解、内容选择、候选召回和排序失败。此外，发送和处理图像的成本高昂，使得天真的多模态方法不切实际。
method: FUSE（Failure-aware Usage of Subagent Evidence for MultiModal Search and Recommendation）使用紧凑的GDR（Grounded Design Representation）替代原始图像提示。实现了七种上下文预算策略：全面基线提示、上下文压缩、思维链推理、小样本优化、检索增强上下文、两阶段处理和零样本最小化。最后，通过管道归因层监控系统性能。
results: Context Compression在所有管道阶段实现了最佳性能，包括93.3%的意图准确率，86.8%的路由成功率（带回退），99.4%的召回率和88.5%的NDCG@5。

title: Fair Distribution of Digital Payments: Balancing Transaction Flows for Regulatory Compliance
authors: Ashlesha Hota, Shashwat Kumar, Daman Deep Singh, Abolfazl Asudeh, Palash Dey, Abhijnan Chakraborty
abstract: The concentration of digital payment transactions in just two UPI apps like PhonePe and Google Pay has raised concerns of duopoly in India s digital financial ecosystem. To address this, the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) has mandated that no single UPI app should exceed 30 percent of total transaction volume. Enforcing this cap, however, poses a significant computational challenge: how to redistribute user transactions across apps without causing widespread user inconvenience while maintaining capacity limits? In this paper, we formalize this problem as the Minimum Edge Activation Flow (MEAF) problem on a bipartite network of users and apps, where activating an edge corresponds to a new app installation. The objective is to ensure a feasible flow respecting app capacities while minimizing additional activations. We further prove that Minimum Edge Activation Flow is NP-Complete. To address the computational challenge, we propose scalable heuristics, named Decoupled Two-Stage Allocation Strategy (DTAS), that exploit flow structure and capacity reuse. Experiments on large semi-synthetic transaction network data show that DTAS finds solutions close to the optimal ILP within seconds, offering a fast and practical way to enforce transaction caps fairly and efficiently.
zh_title: 数字支付的公平分配：平衡交易流以符合监管规定
translation: 印度数字支付交易过度集中在PhonePe和Google Pay等少数几款应用中，引发了对印度数字金融生态系统双头垄断的担忧。为解决此问题，印度国家支付公司（NPCI）强制规定任何单一的UPI应用交易总量不应超过30%。然而，执行此上限带来了一个重大的计算挑战：如何在不引起广泛用户不便的同时，在保持容量限制的情况下，重新分配用户交易到不同的应用？在本文中，我们将此问题形式化为用户和应用二分网络上的最小边激活流（MEAF）问题，其中激活一条边对应于新的应用安装。目标是确保一个可行的流，同时尊重应用容量，并最小化额外的激活次数。我们进一步证明最小边激活流是NP-完全问题。为应对计算挑战，我们提出了利用流结构和容量重用的可扩展启发式算法，命名为解耦两阶段分配策略（DTAS）。对大规模半合成交易网络数据的实验表明，DTAS在几秒钟内找到了接近最优整数线性规划（ILP）的解决方案，为公平高效地执行交易上限提供了一种快速实用的方法。
tldr: 为解决印度数字支付应用的市场垄断问题，本研究将强制实施交易上限的挑战建模为NP-完全的最小边激活流问题，并开发了一种名为DTAS的快速启发式算法，该算法能高效地重新分配交易以满足监管要求。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将监管合规问题（支付交易的公平分配）建模为一个新的图论问题——最小边激活流（MEAF）问题，并证明其是NP-完全问题。提出的DTAS启发式算法在实际应用中展示了高效性。限制在于，该研究主要关注印度UPI生态系统，其结果的普适性需要进一步验证。
motivation: 印度UPI生态系统中，数字支付交易过度集中在少数应用（如PhonePe和Google Pay）中，引发了对双头垄断的担忧，NPCI要求任何单一应用交易量不得超过30%的限制，这带来了重大的计算挑战。
method: 将问题形式化为二分网络上的最小边激活流（MEAF）问题，并提出了解耦两阶段分配策略（DTAS）作为可扩展的启发式算法。
results: 证明了最小边激活流（MEAF）是NP-完全问题。实验表明，DTAS算法能够在几秒钟内找到接近最优ILP的解决方案。
conclusion: DTAS提供了一种快速实用的方法来公平有效地执行交易上限，实验证明它可以在几秒钟内找到接近最优整数线性规划（ILP）的解决方案。

title: LLM-as-evaluator in Strategy Research: A Normative, Variance-Aware Protocol
authors: Arnaldo Camuffo, Alfonso Gambardella, Saeid Kazemi, Jakub Malachowski, Abhinav Pandey
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming essential tools for strategy scholars who need to evaluate text corpora at scale. This paper provides a systematic analysis of the reliability of LLM-as-evaluator in strategy research. After classifying the typical ways in which LLMs can be deployed for evaluation purposes in strategy research, we draw on the specialised AI literature to analyse their properties as measurement instruments. Our empirical analysis reveals substantial instability in LLMs' evaluation output, stemming from multiple factors: the specific phrasing of prompts, the context provided, sampling procedures, extraction methods, and disagreements across different models. We quantify these effects and demonstrate how this unreliability can compromise the validity of research inferences drawn from LLM-generated evaluations. To address these challenges, we develop a comprehensive protocol that is variance-aware, normative, and auditable. We provide practical guidance for flexible implementation of this protocol, including approaches to preregistration and transparent reporting. By establishing these methodological standards, we aim to elevate LLM-based evaluation of business text corpora from its current ad hoc status to a rigorous, actionable, and auditable measurement approach suitable for scholarly research.
zh_title: LLM作为评估者在战略研究中的应用：一个规范的、关注方差的协议
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正成为战略学者大规模评估文本语料库所必需的工具。本文对LLM作为评估者在战略研究中的可靠性进行了系统分析。在对LLM可用于战略研究的典型评估部署方式进行分类后，我们借鉴专业人工智能文献来分析它们作为测量工具的特性。我们的实证分析揭示了LLM评估输出存在显著的不稳定性，这源于多个因素：提示的具体措辞、提供的情境、采样程序、提取方法以及不同模型之间的分歧。我们量化了这些影响，并证明了这种不可靠性如何损害从LLM生成的评估中得出的研究推断的有效性。为应对这些挑战，我们开发了一个全面的、关注方差的、规范化的且可审计的协议。我们为该协议的灵活实施提供了实用指导，包括预注册和透明报告的方法。通过建立这些方法学标准，我们旨在将基于LLM的商业文本语料库评估从其目前的临时状态提升为适合学术研究的严谨、可操作和可审计的测量方法。
tldr: LLM在战略研究中用于大规模文本评估时非常不稳定，受提示和模型影响很大，这会损害研究有效性。为解决此问题，本文提出了一个严格、可审计且关注不确定性的新评估协议。
ai_comments: 这项工作创新性地将LLM评估引入了战略研究领域，并系统地分析了其作为测量工具的可靠性问题。其重要性在于为使用LLM进行文本评估提供了规范化的、关注方差的协议，解决了当前实践中存在的随意性和不可靠性。局限性在于其分析主要集中在文本评估的可靠性方面，可能未完全涵盖LLM在战略研究中应用的全部潜在挑战。
motivation: 战略学者需要大规模评估文本语料，LLM正成为必要的工具，但需要系统分析LLM作为评估者的可靠性，以应对当前实践中存在的评估输出不稳定问题，确保研究推断的有效性。
method: 对LLM在战略研究中部署的典型方式进行分类，并借鉴专业AI文献分析其作为测量工具的特性，随后进行实证分析以量化评估输出的不稳定性和影响因素，最终开发出一个关注方差、规范化且可审计的综合协议。
results: 实证分析揭示了LLM评估输出存在显著的不稳定性，这源于提示措辞、提供的情境、采样程序、提取方法以及模型间的差异。开发了一个全面、关注方差、规范化且可审计的协议，并提供了灵活实施的实用指导。
conclusion: 通过建立这些方法学标准，旨在将基于LLM的商业文本语料库评估从目前随意的状态提升为适合学术研究的严谨、可操作和可审计的测量方法。

title: Permission Manifests for Web Agents
authors: Samuele Marro, Alan Chan, Xinxing Ren, Lewis Hammond, Jesse Wright, Gurjyot Wanga, Tiziano Piccardi, Nuno Campos, Tobin South, Jialin Yu, Alex Pentland, Philip Torr, Jiaxin Pei
abstract: The rise of Large Language Model (LLM)-based web agents represents a significant shift in automated interactions with the web. Unlike traditional crawlers that follow simple conventions, such as robots.txt, modern agents engage with websites in sophisticated ways: navigating complex interfaces, extracting structured information, and completing end-to-end tasks. Existing governance mechanisms were not designed for these capabilities. Without a way to specify what interactions are and are not allowed, website owners increasingly rely on blanket blocking and CAPTCHAs, which undermine beneficial applications such as efficient automation, convenient use of e-commerce services, and accessibility tools. We introduce agent-permissions.json, a robots.txt-style lightweight manifest where websites specify allowed interactions, complemented by API references where available. This framework provides a low-friction coordination mechanism: website owners only need to write a simple JSON file, while agents can easily parse and automatically implement the manifest's provisions. Website owners can then focus on blocking non-compliant agents, rather than agents as a whole. By extending the spirit of robots.txt to the era of LLM-mediated interaction, and complementing data use initiatives such as AIPref, the manifest establishes a compliance framework that enables beneficial agent interactions while respecting site owners' preferences.
comment: Authored by the Lightweight Agent Standards Working Group https://las-wg.org/
translation: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的 Web 代理的兴起代表了自动化网络交互的重大转变。与遵循简单约定（如 robots.txt）的传统爬虫不同，现代代理以复杂的方式与网站互动：导航复杂界面、提取结构化信息以及完成端到端任务。现有的治理机制并非为这些能力而设计。在没有指定允许和禁止的交互方式的情况下，网站所有者越来越多地依赖全面封锁和 CAPTCHA，这损害了有益的应用，如高效自动化、电子商务服务的便利使用和辅助功能工具。我们引入了 agent-permissions.json，这是一个类似 robots.txt 的轻量级清单，网站可以在其中指定允许的交互，并在可用时补充 API 引用。该框架提供了一种低摩擦的协调机制：网站所有者只需编写一个简单的 JSON 文件，代理就可以轻松解析并自动实施清单的规定。然后，网站所有者可以专注于阻止不合规的代理，而不是整个代理。通过将 robots.txt 的精神扩展到 LLM 介导的交互时代，并补充 AIPref 等数据使用倡议，该清单建立了一个合规框架，能够在尊重网站所有者偏好的同时，实现有益的代理交互。
tldr: 为了管理 LLM 代理复杂的网络交互，我们创建了 agent-permissions.json，一个简单的 JSON 权限清单，网站可以用它来告诉代理可以做什么和不可以做什么，以取代不必要的 CAPTCHA 和全面封锁。
ai_comments: 该论文的主要创新在于提出了一个轻量级的、类似 robots.txt 的权限清单机制 (agent-permissions.json)，以应对 LLM 驱动的 Web 代理带来的新型交互挑战。其重要性在于提供了一种低摩擦的协调机制，平衡了代理的自动化需求与网站所有者的控制偏好。局限性在于其有效性依赖于代理的自动遵守，并且可能需要与现有的数据使用倡议（如 AIPref）相结合才能形成更全面的治理框架。
motivation: 现有的网络治理机制（如 robots.txt）未针对 LLM 驱动的 Web 代理的复杂能力进行设计。缺乏指定允许或禁止的交互的方式，导致网站所有者越来越多地依赖全面封锁和 CAPTCHA，这损害了有益的自动化应用。
method: 引入了 agent-permissions.json，一个类似 robots.txt 的轻量级清单，网站所有者可以在其中指定允许的交互，并在可用时补充 API 引用。代理可以轻松解析并自动实施该清单的规定。
results: 建立了一个低摩擦的协调机制，网站所有者只需编写一个简单的 JSON 文件，代理就能自动解析并执行权限清单的规定，从而使网站所有者能够专注于阻止不合规的代理，而不是整个代理。
conclusion: 该清单扩展了 robots.txt 的精神到 LLM 介导的交互时代，并补充了 AIPref 等数据使用倡议，建立了一个合规框架，能够在尊重网站所有者偏好的同时，实现有益的代理交互。

title: A Lay User Explainable Food Recommendation System Based on Hybrid Feature Importance Extraction and Large Language Models
authors: Melissa Tessa, Diderot D. Cidjeu, Rachele Carli, Sarah Abchiche, Ahmad Aldarwishd, Igor Tchappi, Amro Najjar
abstract: Large Language Models (LLM) have experienced strong development in recent years, with varied applications. This paper uses LLMs to develop a post-hoc process that provides more elaborated explanations of the results of food recommendation systems. By combining LLM with a hybrid extraction of key variables using SHAP, we obtain dynamic, convincing and more comprehensive explanations to lay user, compared to those in the literature. This approach enhances user trust and transparency by making complex recommendation outcomes easier to understand for a lay user.
zh_title: 基于混合特征重要性提取和大语言模型的普通用户可解释食品推荐系统
translation: 近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）取得了强大的发展，并有了各种应用。本文利用LLM开发了一个事后处理过程，为食品推荐系统的结果提供更详尽的解释。通过将LLM与使用SHAP的混合关键变量提取相结合，我们获得了比文献中更动态、更有说服力和更全面的、面向普通用户的解释。该方法通过使复杂推荐结果对普通用户更容易理解，增强了用户信任和透明度。
tldr: 研究人员使用大语言模型（LLM）和SHAP特征重要性提取的组合方法，为食品推荐系统创建了更详细、更易懂的事后解释，旨在提高普通用户的信任和系统的透明度。
ai_comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于将大语言模型（LLM）与SHAP（Shapley Additive Explanations）混合特征重要性提取相结合，为食品推荐系统生成了更动态、更有说服力和更全面的事后解释。这解决了现有解释方法对非专业用户不够友好的问题。局限性在于其解释的“可信度”和“全面性”是基于混合特征重要性提取的质量，但该方法在实际部署中的效率和对特定领域知识的依赖程度并未在摘要中详细说明。
motivation: 现有的食品推荐系统解释方法对于普通用户来说不够直观和全面，因此需要一种方法来提供更生动、更具说服力的解释，以增强用户信任和透明度。
method: 通过结合使用大语言模型（LLM）和使用SHAP的混合特征重要性提取，开发了一种事后处理过程，用于为食品推荐系统的结果提供更详尽的解释。
results: 与现有文献中的方法相比，该混合方法能够生成动态的、令人信服的且更全面的解释，从而使用户更容易理解复杂的推荐结果。
conclusion: 通过将LLM与混合特征重要性提取（使用SHAP）相结合，该方法为食品推荐系统提供了更动态、更有说服力和更全面的解释，增强了用户信任和透明度，使复杂的结果对普通用户更容易理解。

title: LeafTutor: An AI Agent for Programming Assignment Tutoring
authors: Madison Bochard, Tim Conser, Alyssa Duran, Lazaro Martull, Pu Tian, Yalong Wu
abstract: High enrollment in STEM-related degree programs has created increasing demand for scalable tutoring support, as universities experience a shortage of qualified instructors and teaching assistants (TAs). To address this challenge, LeafTutor, an AI tutoring agent powered by large language models (LLMs), was developed to provide step-by-step guidance for students. LeafTutor was evaluated through real programming assignments. The results indicate that the system can deliver step-by-step programming guidance comparable to human tutors. This work demonstrates the potential of LLM-driven tutoring solutions to enhance and personalize learning in STEM education. If any reader is interested in collaboration with our team to improve or test LeafTutor, please contact Pu Tian (pu.tian@stockton.edu) or Yalong Wu (wuy@uhcl.edu).
zh_title: LeafTutor：一个用于编程作业辅导的人工智能代理
translation: 由于STEM相关学位课程入学人数众多，对可扩展的辅导支持的需求不断增加，因为大学面临合格的教职员工和助教短缺的问题。为了应对这一挑战，开发了LeafTutor，一个由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的人工智能辅导代理，以提供分步指导。LeafTutor通过真实的编程作业进行了评估。结果表明，该系统能够提供与人类导师相当的分步编程指导。这项工作展示了由LLM驱动的辅导解决方案在增强和个性化STEM教育学习方面的潜力。如果任何读者有兴趣与我们的团队合作改进或测试LeafTutor，请联系 Pu Tian (pu.tian@stockton.edu) 或 Yalong Wu (wuy@uhcl.edu)。
tldr: LeafTutor是一个使用LLM的AI工具，可以像人类导师一样一步步辅导学生编程作业，以应对大学辅导资源不足的问题。
ai_comments: LeafTutor的创新之处在于利用LLM提供可与人类导师媲美的分步编程指导，解决了STEM教育中辅导资源短缺的问题。其重要性在于展示了LLM驱动的辅导方案在增强和个性化学习方面的潜力。论文的局限性在于未详细说明评估的具体指标或规模。
motivation: STEM相关学位课程的高入学率增加了对可扩展辅导支持的需求，而大学面临合格的教职员工和助教短缺的问题。
method: 开发了一个名为LeafTutor的AI辅导代理，该代理由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动，旨在提供分步指导，并通过真实的编程作业对其进行评估。

conclusion: 该工作证明了由LLM驱动的辅导解决方案在增强和个性化STEM教育学习方面的潜力。

title: A Deep-SIC Channel Estimator Scheme in NOMA Network
authors: Sumita Majhi, Kaushal Shelke, Pinaki Mitra
abstract: In 5G and next-generation mobile ad-hoc networks, reliable handover is a key requirement, which guarantees continuity in connectivity, especially for mobile users and in high-density scenarios. However, conventional handover triggers based on instantaneous channel measurements are prone to failures and the ping-pong effect due to outdated or inaccurate channel state information. To address this, we introduce Deep-SIC, a knowledge-based channel prediction model that employs a Transformer-based approach to predict channel quality and optimise handover decisions. Deep-SIC is a unique model that utilises Partially Decoded Data (PDD), a byproduct of successive interference cancellation (SIC) in NOMA, as a feedback signal to improve its predictions continually. This special purpose enables learners to learn quickly and stabilise their learning. Our model learns 68\% faster than existing state-of-the-art algorithms, such as Graph-NOMA, while offering verifiable guarantees of stability and resilience to user mobility (Theorem~2). When simulated at the system level, it can be shown that our strategy can substantially enhance network performance: the handover failure rate can be reduced by up to 40\%, and the ping-pong effect can be mitigated, especially at vehicular speeds (e.g., 60 km/h). Moreover, Deep-SIC has a 20\% smaller normalised root mean square error (NRMSE) in low-SNR situations than state-of-the-art algorithms with linear computational complexity, $O(K)$. This work has introduced a new paradigm for robust and predictive mobility management in dynamic wireless networks.
zh_title: NOMA网络中的深度-SIC信道估计方案
translation: 在5G和下一代移动自组织网络中，可靠的切换是保证连接连续性的关键要求，尤其对于移动用户和高密度场景。然而，基于瞬时信道测量的传统切换触发机制容易因过时或不准确的信道状态信息而导致失败和乒乓效应。为解决此问题，我们引入了Deep-SIC，一个利用Transformer方法的基于知识的信道预测模型，用于预测信道质量和优化切换决策。Deep-SIC是一个独特的模型，它利用部分解码数据（PDD）——非正交多址接入（NOMA）中连续干扰消除（SIC）的副产品——作为反馈信号来不断改进其预测。这种特殊用途使学习者能够快速学习并稳定其学习过程。我们的模型比现有的最先进算法（如Graph-NOMA）学习速度快68%，同时提供了关于稳定性和抗用户移动性的可验证保证（定理2）。在系统级仿真中，可以证明我们的策略可以显著提高网络性能：切换失败率最多可降低40%，乒乓效应得到缓解，尤其是在车辆速度（例如60 km/h）下。此外，Deep-SIC在低信噪比情况下，其归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）比具有线性计算复杂度$O(K)$的最先进算法小20%。这项工作为动态无线网络中稳健和预测性的移动性管理引入了一个新范式。
tldr: Deep-SIC是一种利用NOMA的PDD反馈信号的Transformer模型，用于预测信道和优化切换决策，它比现有方法学习快68%，能将切换失败率降低40%，并在低信噪比下误差更小，是稳健移动性管理的新方法。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了基于Transformer的知识驱动模型Deep-SIC，并利用NOMA中的SIC副产品（PDD）作为持续反馈信号来优化信道预测和切换决策，这在利用网络内部信息进行预测方面具有独特性。其重要性在于解决了传统切换机制中信道信息不准确导致的切换失败和乒乓效应问题。局限性在于摘要中未详细说明模型在更复杂的网络拓扑或不同移动场景下的泛化能力。
motivation: 传统的基于瞬时信道测量的切换触发机制容易因过时或不准确的信道状态信息（CSI）而导致切换失败和乒乓效应，这在5G及下一代移动自组织网络中对可靠切换提出了关键要求。
method: 提出了一种名为Deep-SIC的基于知识的信道预测模型，该模型采用Transformer方法，并利用非正交多址接入（NOMA）中连续干扰消除（SIC）的副产品——部分解码数据（PDD）作为反馈信号来进行持续改进和预测。
results: Deep-SIC的学习速度比现有最先进算法（如Graph-NOMA）快68%，并提供了稳定性和抗用户移动性的保证。在系统级仿真中，切换失败率降低了高达40%，缓解了乒乓效应（尤其在60 km/h的车速下）。在低信噪比情况下，Deep-SIC的归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）比具有线性计算复杂度$O(K)$的最先进算法小20%。
conclusion: Deep-SIC引入了一种新的范式，用于动态无线网络中稳健且具有预测性的移动性管理，通过利用NOMA的特性显著提高了切换性能和信道估计精度。

title: Improving News Recommendations through Hybrid Sentiment Modelling and Reinforcement Learning
authors: Eunice Kingenga, Mike Wa Nkongolo
abstract: News recommendation systems rely on automated sentiment analysis to personalise content and enhance user engagement. Conventional approaches often struggle with ambiguity, lexicon inconsistencies, and limited contextual understanding, particularly in multi-source news environments. Existing models typically treat sentiment as a secondary feature, reducing their ability to adapt to users' affective preferences. To address these limitations, this study develops an adaptive, sentiment-aware news recommendation framework by integrating hybrid sentiment analysis with reinforcement learning. Using the BBC News dataset, a hybrid sentiment model combines VADER, AFINN, TextBlob, and SentiWordNet scores to generate robust article-level sentiment estimates. Articles are categorised as positive, negative, or neutral, and these sentiment states are embedded within a Q-learning architecture to guide the agent in learning optimal recommendation policies. The proposed system effectively identifies and recommends articles with aligned emotional profiles while continuously improving personalisation through iterative Q-learning updates. The results demonstrate that coupling hybrid sentiment modelling with reinforcement learning provides a feasible, interpretable, and adaptive approach for user-centred news recommendation.
comment: Masters in information technology, University of Pretoria
zh_title: 通过混合情感建模和强化学习改进新闻推荐
translation: 新闻推荐系统依赖于自动化的情感分析来个性化内容并增强用户参与度。传统方法在处理歧义、词典不一致以及有限的上下文理解方面经常遇到困难，尤其是在多源新闻环境中。现有模型通常将情感视为次要特征，降低了它们适应用户情感偏好的能力。为解决这些局限性，本研究开发了一个自适应的、感知情感的新闻推荐框架，该框架集成了混合情感分析和强化学习。使用BBC新闻数据集，一个混合情感模型结合了VADER、AFINN、TextBlob和SentiWordNet的分数，以生成稳健的文章级情感估计。文章被分类为积极、消极或中性，并将这些情感状态嵌入到Q学习架构中，以指导智能体学习最优推荐策略。所提出的系统有效地识别和推荐具有情感特征匹配的文章，并通过迭代的Q学习更新持续改进个性化。结果表明，将混合情感建模与强化学习相结合，为以用户为中心的新闻推荐提供了一种可行、可解释且自适应的方法。
tldr: 为了更好地个性化新闻推荐，研究人员将四种情感分析工具的集合（混合模型）与Q学习相结合，创建了一个能根据用户情感偏好推荐文章的自适应系统。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于结合了混合情感建模（集成四种现有工具）和强化学习（Q-learning）来解决传统新闻推荐中情感特征处理不足的问题。重要性在于提供了一种自适应且可解释的用户中心推荐方法。局限性方面，摘要未提及具体的性能对比指标或模型在处理极端复杂、多源、实时新闻流时的扩展性问题。
motivation: 传统新闻推荐系统在处理多源新闻环境中的情感歧义、词典不一致和有限的上下文理解方面存在困难，并且通常将情感视为次要特征，限制了其适应用户情感偏好的能力。
method: 开发了一个自适应的情感感知新闻推荐框架，该框架集成了混合情感分析和强化学习。混合情感模型结合了VADER、AFINN、TextBlob和SentiWordNet的分数来生成稳健的文章级情感估计。这些情感状态（积极、消极、中性）被嵌入到Q学习架构中，以指导智能体学习最优推荐策略。
results: 所提出的系统能够有效地识别和推荐具有情感特征匹配的文章，并通过迭代的Q学习更新持续改进个性化。实验结果表明了该方法的有效性。
conclusion: 将混合情感建模与强化学习相结合，为用户中心的新闻推荐提供了一种可行、可解释且自适应的方法。

title: A Secure Edge Gateway Architecture for Wi-Fi-Enabled IoT
authors: Daniyal Ganiuly, Nurzhau Bolatbek, Assel Smaiyl
abstract: This paper presents a Secure Edge Gateway Architecture for Wi-Fi-Enabled IoT designed to strengthen local network protection without altering existing infrastructure. The proposed gateway acts as an intermediate control point between Wi-Fi access points and the core network, monitoring traffic, isolating untrusted devices, and preventing common wireless attacks such as spoofing, deauthentication, and unauthorized access. The design focuses on adaptive traffic filtering and lightweight policy enforcement instead of complex analytical models, making it suitable for medium-sized network environments. The prototype gateway was deployed in a real office with around 70 total devices, including 28 IoT units such as sensors, cameras, and smart controllers. Over ten days of continuous operation, the system reduced successful spoofing incidents by 87% and improved recovery time after deauthentication by 42%, while increasing network latency by only 3.1% and reducing throughput by less than 4% compared to a baseline WPA3 configuration. These results confirm that implementing security functions at the edge layer can significantly improve the resilience of Wi-Fi-enabled IoT environments without introducing noticeable overhead or requiring specialized hardware.

title: Trust in LLM-controlled Robotics: a Survey of Security Threats, Defenses and Challenges
authors: Xinyu Huang, Shyam Karthick V B, Taozhao Chen, Mitch Bryson, Thomas Chaffey, Huaming Chen, Kim-Kwang Raymond Choo, Ian R. Manchester
abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into robotics has revolutionized their ability to interpret complex human commands and execute sophisticated tasks. However, such paradigm shift introduces critical security vulnerabilities stemming from the ''embodiment gap'', a discord between the LLM's abstract reasoning and the physical, context-dependent nature of robotics. While security for text-based LLMs is an active area of research, existing solutions are often insufficient to address the unique threats for the embodied robotic agents, where malicious outputs manifest not merely as harmful text but as dangerous physical actions. In this work, we present a systematic survey, summarizing the emerging threat landscape and corresponding defense strategies for LLM-controlled robotics. Specifically, we discuss a comprehensive taxonomy of attack vectors, covering topics such as jailbreaking, backdoor attacks, and multi-modal prompt injection. In response, we analyze and categorize a range of defense mechanisms, from formal safety specifications and runtime enforcement to multi-LLM oversight and prompt hardening. Furthermore, we review key datasets and benchmarks used to evaluate the robustness of these embodied systems. By synthesizing current research, this work highlights the urgent need for context-aware security solutions and provides a foundational roadmap for the development of safe, secure, and reliable LLM-controlled robotics.

title: Modeling the Mental World for Embodied AI: A Comprehensive Review
authors: Biyuan Liu, Daigang Xu, Lei Jiang, Wenjun Guo, Ping Chen
abstract:
As the application of Embodied AI Agents in avatars, wearable devices, and robotic systems continues to deepen, their core research challenges have gradually shifted from physical environment interaction to the accurate understanding of social interactions. Traditional physical world models (PWM) focus on quantifiable physical attributes such as space and motion, failing to meet the needs of social intelligence modeling. In contrast, the Mental World Model (MWM), as a structured representation of humans' internal mental states, has become the critical cognitive foundation for embodied agents to achieve natural human-machine collaboration and dynamic social adaptation. However, current MWM research faces significant bottlenecks: such as fragmented conceptual framework with vague boundaries between MWM and PWM, disjointed reasoning mechanisms for the technical pathways and applicable scenarios of different Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning paradigms, and detachment between evaluation and practice.
  To address these issues, this review systematically synthesizes over 100 authoritative studies to provide a comprehensive overview of MWM research for embodied AI. Its core contributions are threefold: First, it constructs a complete theoretical framework for MWM for the first time. Specifically, it distinguishes the essential differences between MWM and PWMs. Second, it systematically defines the key components of MWM through two paradigms for mental element representation. Third, it comprehensively analyzes two core ToM reasoning paradigms with 19 ToM methods. Finally, it also clarifies the integration trend of neuro-symbolic hybrid architectures, and synthesizes 26 ToM evaluation benchmarks. This work aims to promote the integration of embodied agents into human society and advance the in-depth development of human-machine collaborative interaction.

title: The Refutability Gap: Challenges in Validating Reasoning by Large Language Models
authors: Elchanan Mossel
abstract: Recent reports claim that Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved the ability to derive new science and exhibit human-level general intelligence. We argue that such claims are not rigorous scientific claims, as they do not satisfy Popper's refutability principle (often termed falsifiability), which requires that scientific statements be capable of being disproven. We identify several methodological pitfalls in current AI research on reasoning, including the inability to verify the novelty of findings due to opaque and non-searchable training data, the lack of reproducibility caused by continuous model updates, and the omission of human-interaction transcripts, which obscures the true source of scientific discovery. Additionally, the absence of counterfactuals and data on failed attempts creates a selection bias that may exaggerate LLM capabilities. To address these challenges, we propose guidelines for scientific transparency and reproducibility for research on reasoning by LLMs. Establishing such guidelines is crucial for both scientific integrity and the ongoing societal debates regarding fair data usage.
